a.example: I have a dog and a cat at home.
a.exampleZh: 我家里有一只狗和一只猫。

abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那辆旧车丢弃在路边。

ability.example: She has the ability to learn new languages very quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有非常快速地学习新语言的能力。

able.example: She is able to speak three languages well.
able.exampleZh: 她能流利地说三种语言。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for a child to sleep all day.
abnormal.exampleZh: 一个孩子整天睡觉是不正常的。

aboard.example: All the passengers were already aboard the plane when the storm began.
aboard.exampleZh: 暴风雨开始时，所有乘客都已经在飞机上了。

about.example: The children ran about the garden while we talked about the weather.
about.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里到处跑，我们则聊着天气。

above.example: The plane is flying above the clouds and we can see the sun.
above.exampleZh: 飞机飞行在云层上面，我们能看到太阳。

abroad.example: She plans to study abroad for a year after college.
abroad.exampleZh: 她打算大学毕业后到国外学习一年。

absent.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he had a bad cold.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天因为得了重感冒而没有去上学。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over all the people in his country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对他的国家里所有人拥有绝对的权力。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water through their roots, and a good book can absorb your attention.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过根部吸收水分，一本好书也能吸引你的注意力。

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract for most young students to understand.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个概念太抽象了，大多数年轻学生都理解不了。

abundant.example: The small garden gives us abundant fresh vegetables every summer.
abundant.exampleZh: 这个小花园每年夏天都给我们提供大量新鲜蔬菜。

abuse.example: Parents should never abuse their power over young children.
abuse.exampleZh: 父母绝不应该滥用他们对年幼孩子的权力。

academic.example: She has a strong academic background and teaches at a famous university.
academic.exampleZh: 她有很强的学术背景，在一所著名大学任教。

accent.example: She speaks English with a slight French accent, but everyone understands her easily.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带一点法国口音，但大家都能轻松听懂。

accept.example: I am happy to accept your kind offer of help.
accept.exampleZh: 我很乐意接受你善意的帮助。

access.example: The only access to the village is a narrow road.
access.exampleZh: 通往这个村庄的唯一通道是一条窄路。

accident.example: I had a small accident on my way to work this morning.
accident.exampleZh: 今天早上我在上班路上出了一点小事故。

accommodation.example: The hotel provides comfortable accommodation for all its guests.
accommodation.exampleZh: 这家酒店为所有客人提供舒适的住处。

accompany.example: I will accompany my mother to the hospital this afternoon.
accompany.exampleZh: 今天下午我会陪母亲去医院。

accomplish.example: She worked hard every day to accomplish her goal before the end of the year.
accomplish.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，要在年底前实现自己的目标。

account.example: I opened a bank account last week to save money for a new car.
account.exampleZh: 我上周开了一个银行账户，为买新车存钱。

accurate.example: This watch is very accurate and never gives me the wrong time.
accurate.exampleZh: 这块手表非常准确，从未给我显示过错误的时间。

accuse.example: They accused him of stealing money from the company last week.
accuse.exampleZh: 他们指控他上周从公司偷钱。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to getting up early every morning.
accustomed.exampleZh: 她习惯于每天早上早起。

ache.example: My head began to ache after I read for three hours.
ache.exampleZh: 我读了三个小时书之后，头开始疼了。

achieve.example: She worked hard every day to achieve her goal of becoming a doctor.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天努力，最终实现了成为医生的目标。

acid.example: Lemon juice contains acid, so it tastes very sour and sharp.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬汁含有酸，所以它尝起来很酸、很刺激。

acknowledge.example: She quickly acknowledged her mistake and promised to do better.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 她很快承认了自己的错误，并承诺会做得更好。

acquire.example: Children acquire language skills by listening to their parents every day.
acquire.exampleZh: 孩子们通过每天听父母说话而获得语言能力。

across.example: She walked across the bridge to meet her friends on the other side.
across.exampleZh: 她走过桥去另一边见她的朋友们。

act.example: We must act now before the problem gets worse.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前行动起来。

action.example: We must take action now to protect the environment.
action.exampleZh: 我们现在必须采取行动来保护环境。

active.example: She is an active member of the school music club.
active.exampleZh: 她是学校音乐社团的一名活跃成员。

activity.example: My favorite activity on weekends is reading books at home.
activity.exampleZh: 我周末最喜欢的活动是在家读书。

actor.example: The actor on the stage forgot his words for a moment.
actor.exampleZh: 舞台上的那位演员有一瞬间忘了台词。

actual.example: The actual cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
actual.exampleZh: 这次旅行的实际费用比我们预想的高。

adapt.example: It took me a few weeks to adapt to the new school.
adapt.exampleZh: 我花了几个星期才适应这所新学校。

add.example: Please add some sugar to my coffee.
add.exampleZh: 请往我的咖啡里加些糖。

addition.example: The addition of a new window made the room much brighter.
addition.exampleZh: 增加一扇新窗户让房间明亮了许多。

additional.example: We need additional time to finish this work.
additional.exampleZh: 我们需要额外的时间来完成这项工作。

address.example: Please write your name and address on this form.
address.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和地址。

adequate.example: The room is small but adequate for two people to live in.
adequate.exampleZh: 这个房间虽小，但足够两个人居住。

adjust.example: You can adjust the seat before you start driving the car.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以在开车前调整座椅。

administration.example: The administration of the school building is on the second floor.
administration.exampleZh: 学校大楼的管理部门在二楼。

admit.example: She admitted that she had made a mistake in the report.
admit.exampleZh: 她承认自己在报告中犯了一个错误。

adopt.example: The school decided to adopt a new reading plan for young students.
adopt.exampleZh: 学校决定为低年级学生采用一项新的阅读计划。

adult.example: Every adult should help children learn to read and write.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人都应该帮助孩子学习读写。

advance.example: The team made great progress and advanced the project ahead of schedule.
advance.exampleZh: 团队取得了很大进展，提前推进了项目。

advantage.example: One big advantage of this job is that I can work from home.
advantage.exampleZh: 这份工作的一个很大优势是我可以在家工作。

adventure.example: Our trip to the mountains was a great adventure for the whole family.
adventure.exampleZh: 我们的山区之行对全家人来说都是一次很棒的冒险。

advertise.example: They advertise the new phone on TV and online.
advertise.exampleZh: 他们在电视和网络上为这款新手机做广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about learning English.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于学英语的好建议。

advise.example: My teacher advised me to read more books before the exam.
advise.exampleZh: 老师建议我在考试前多读些书。

affair.example: The whole affair was over before anyone could explain what happened.
affair.exampleZh: 整件事在任何人能解释发生了什么之前就结束了。

affect.example: The bad weather can affect the crops in our fields.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气会影响我们田里的庄稼。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year because prices are too high.
afford.exampleZh: 今年我们买不起新车，因为价格太高了。

afraid.example: I am afraid of big dogs, so I never go near them.
afraid.exampleZh: 我害怕大狗，所以我从来不靠近它们。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们就回家了。

afternoon.example: I have a math class this afternoon at three.
afternoon.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一节数学课。

again.example: Please read the question again before you write your answer.
again.exampleZh: 在你写答案之前，请把题目再读一遍。

against.example: The whole team voted against the new plan.
against.exampleZh: 整个团队都投票反对这个新计划。

age.example: At the age of ten, he learned to swim in the river.
age.exampleZh: 十岁那年，他学会了在河里游泳。

agency.example: She works at a small travel agency near her home.
agency.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一家小型旅行社工作。

agent.example: The agent helped us buy the house last year.
agent.exampleZh: 这位代理人去年帮我们买了这栋房子。

aggressive.example: The aggressive dog barked at everyone who walked past the gate.
aggressive.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对每个经过大门的人狂吠。

ago.example: I moved to this city two years ago with my family.
ago.exampleZh: 两年前我和家人搬到了这座城市。

agree.example: I agree with you on this plan.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你在这个计划上的看法。

agreement.example: The two sides finally reached an agreement after a long talk.
agreement.exampleZh: 经过长时间的会谈，双方终于达成了一项协议。

agricultural.example: This agricultural region grows a lot of rice and corn every year.
agricultural.exampleZh: 这个农业地区每年种植大量水稻和玉米。

ahead.example: She walked ahead of us to find the right road.
ahead.exampleZh: 她走在我们前面，去找正确的路。

aid.example: The teacher gave him some aid after he fell in the playground.
aid.exampleZh: 他在操场上摔倒后，老师给了他一些帮助。

aim.example: Our aim is to finish the report before Friday.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的目标是在周五之前完成报告。

air.example: The air in the mountains is fresh and clean in the morning.
air.exampleZh: 早晨山里的空气清新洁净。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely at the airport after a long flight.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在长途飞行后安全降落在机场。

airline.example: The airline lost my bag, but they found it two days later.
airline.exampleZh: 航空公司弄丢了我的包，但两天后他们找到了。

airmail.example: I sent the letter by airmail so it would arrive faster.
airmail.exampleZh: 我把这封信通过航空邮件寄出，这样能更快到达。

airplane.example: The airplane flew high above the clouds for three hours.
airplane.exampleZh: 这架飞机在云层上方高高飞行了三个小时。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
airport.exampleZh: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。

alarm.example: The loud alarm woke me up early this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 今天早上响亮的闹钟把我早早叫醒了。

album.example: She keeps all her family photos in a small blue album.
album.exampleZh: 她把所有家庭照片都放在一本蓝色的小相册里。

alcohol.example: He does not drink alcohol because it is bad for his health.
alcohol.exampleZh: 他不喝酒，因为酒对他的健康有害。

alike.example: The two brothers look very much alike and often wear the same clothes.
alike.exampleZh: 这两兄弟长得很像，而且经常穿同样的衣服。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive and full of green leaves.
alive.exampleZh: 那棵老树仍然活着，长满了绿叶。

all.example: All the students in my class like to play football after school.
all.exampleZh: 我们班所有的学生都喜欢放学后踢足球。

allergic.example: I am allergic to cats, so I never visit my friend's house.
allergic.exampleZh: 我对猫过敏，所以我从不去朋友家。

allow.example: The teacher will allow us to leave class early today.
allow.exampleZh: 老师今天会允许我们提前下课。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning.
almost.exampleZh: 今天早上我差点错过了公交车。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the park.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在公园附近的一所小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our plans for next week.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，聊了聊下周的计划。

aloud.example: Please read the letter aloud so everyone can hear it.
aloud.exampleZh: 请把信出声读出来，让大家都能听见。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they learn to read simple words.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习读简单单词之前先学习字母表。

already.example: The train has already left, so we must wait for the next one.
already.exampleZh: 火车已经开走了，所以我们得等下一班。

also.example: She speaks French and she also speaks a little Spanish.
also.exampleZh: 她会说法语，而且也会说一点西班牙语。

alternative.example: We need an alternative plan because the first one is too expensive.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代方案，因为第一个方案太贵了。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
although.exampleZh: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是出去散步了。

altogether.example: The trip was not altogether bad, and we enjoyed most of it.
altogether.exampleZh: 这次旅行并不完全糟糕，我们大部分时间都玩得很开心。

always.example: She always drinks a cup of tea before she goes to work.
always.exampleZh: 她上班前总是喝一杯茶。

am.example: I am happy to see you again today.
am.exampleZh: 我今天很高兴再次见到你。

amazing.example: It was amazing to see so many stars in the clear night sky.
amazing.exampleZh: 在晴朗的夜空中看到这么多星星，真是太令人惊奇了。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the president to talk about peace between the two countries.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了总统，讨论两国之间的和平问题。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in her town.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助她所在小镇上的人们。

ambulance.example: The ambulance took the injured boy to the hospital quickly.
ambulance.exampleZh: 救护车迅速把受伤的男孩送到了医院。

among.example: She is the tallest girl among her classmates this year.
among.exampleZh: 她是今年她同学中最高的女孩。

amount.example: A large amount of water is needed every day.

amuse.example: The funny clown amuses the children at the party.
amuse.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑在聚会上逗孩子们开心。

analysis.example: The teacher asked us to write a short analysis of the poem.
analysis.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇关于这首诗的简短分析。

analyze.example: We need to analyze the data before we make a final decision.
analyze.exampleZh: 在做最终决定之前，我们需要分析这些数据。

ancient.example: This ancient tree is older than the whole village.
ancient.exampleZh: 这棵古老的树比整个村庄的历史还要久。

and.example: Tom and Mary like apples and they eat one every day.
and.exampleZh: 汤姆和玛丽喜欢苹果，而且他们每天吃一个。

anger.example: His rude words filled her with anger, but she stayed calm.
anger.exampleZh: 他的粗鲁话语让她怒火中烧，但她保持了冷静。

angle.example: From this angle, the old building looks much taller than before.
angle.exampleZh: 从这个角度看，这座老建筑比以前高多了。

angry.example: My father was very angry when I broke the window yesterday.
angry.exampleZh: 昨天我打碎窗户时，我父亲非常生气。

animal.example: The zoo has many kinds of animals, and children love to watch them.
animal.exampleZh: 动物园里有很多种动物，孩子们喜欢观看它们。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 昨天我和朋友们打篮球时伤了脚踝。

announce.example: The company will announce the new plan tomorrow morning.
announce.exampleZh: 公司将于明天上午宣布这项新计划。

annoy.example: His loud music began to annoy the neighbors late at night.
annoy.exampleZh: 他放的音乐很吵，深夜开始打扰到邻居们。

annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its workers in June.
annual.exampleZh: 公司每年六月为全体员工举行年度会议。

another.example: I don't like this book, so please show me another one.
another.exampleZh: 我不喜欢这本书，请再给我看一本。

answer.example: Please answer my question before we leave the office today.
answer.exampleZh: 请在我们今天离开办公室之前回答我的问题。

ant.example: A small ant is carrying a piece of food to its home.
ant.exampleZh: 一只小蚂蚁正把一块食物搬回家。

anxious.example: She felt anxious before the exam because she had not studied enough.
anxious.exampleZh: 考试前她感到焦虑，因为她没有充分复习。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson today?
any.exampleZh: 关于今天的课你有什么问题吗？

anybody.example: I don't think anybody here knows the answer to that question.
anybody.exampleZh: 我认为这里没有人知道那个问题的答案。

anyhow.example: Anyhow, we still need to finish the work before Friday.
anyhow.exampleZh: 不管怎样，我们仍然需要在周五之前完成这项工作。

anyone.example: Anyone can join our club if they like music.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何喜欢音乐的人都可以加入我们的俱乐部。

anything.example: You can choose anything you like from the menu today.
anything.exampleZh: 你可以从今天的菜单上挑任何你喜欢的东西。

anyway.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 我很累，但还是去参加了聚会。

anywhere.example: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 你可以在这个房间里的任何地方坐。

apart.example: They live apart now, but they still call each other every day.
apart.exampleZh: 他们现在分开住了，但仍然每天互相打电话。

apartment.example: Our apartment is small but very clean and bright.
apartment.exampleZh: 我们的公寓很小，但非常干净明亮。

apologize.example: You should apologize to her for being late this morning.
apologize.exampleZh: 你今早迟到了，应该向她道歉。

apology.example: He said sorry, but his apology did not sound honest to me.
apology.exampleZh: 他说了对不起，但他的道歉在我听来并不诚恳。

apparent.example: It soon became apparent that the plan would not work.
apparent.exampleZh: 很快就明显看出这个计划行不通。

appear.example: A smile appeared on her face when she heard the good news.
appear.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她脸上露出了笑容。

appearance.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone in the room.
appearance.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

apple.example: She eats an apple every morning before she goes to school.
apple.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前吃一个苹果。

application.example: You can submit your application online before the end of this month.
application.exampleZh: 你可以在本月底之前在线提交你的申请。

apply.example: You can apply for the job online and send your resume today.
apply.exampleZh: 你可以在网上申请这份工作，并今天发送你的简历。

appoint.example: The company will appoint a new manager next week.
appoint.exampleZh: 公司将在下周任命一位新经理。

appointment.example: I have an appointment with my doctor this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 我今天下午和医生有个预约。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my English homework today.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我非常感激你今天帮我做英语作业。

approach.example: We need a new approach to solve this problem.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。

appropriate.example: It is not appropriate to wear shorts to a formal interview.
appropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤去正式面试是不合适的。

approval.example: The new plan received the approval of everyone at the meeting.
approval.exampleZh: 这个新计划得到了会上所有人的赞成。

approve.example: I am glad that my parents approve of my new plan.
approve.exampleZh: 我很高兴父母赞成我的新计划。

approximately.example: The trip takes approximately two hours by train from here.
approximately.exampleZh: 从这里坐火车去大约需要两个小时。

apron.example: The cook put on a clean apron before making the soup.
apron.exampleZh: 厨师在做汤之前穿上了干净的围裙。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking anyone.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师没有问任何人就做出了一个武断的决定。

arch.example: We walked through the stone arch into the quiet garden.
arch.exampleZh: 我们穿过石头拱门，走进了安静的花园。

architect.example: The architect showed us the plans for the new library.
architect.exampleZh: 建筑师给我们看了新图书馆的设计图。

architecture.example: She studies architecture at a famous school and loves old buildings.
architecture.exampleZh: 她在一所著名的学校学习建筑学，并且喜欢古老的建筑。

arctic.example: The arctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
arctic.exampleZh: 北极地区非常寒冷，终年覆盖着冰雪。

are.example: You are my best friend and we are always happy together.
are.exampleZh: 你是我最好的朋友，我们在一起总是很开心。

area.example: This area of the city is very quiet at night.
area.exampleZh: 城市的这个区域晚上非常安静。

argue.example: They argue about money almost every day after dinner.
argue.exampleZh: 他们几乎每天晚饭后都为钱争吵。

argument.example: Her argument was clear and strong, so everyone agreed with her.
argument.exampleZh: 她的论点清晰有力，所以大家都同意她的看法。

arise.example: Many problems arise when students try to learn a new language alone.
arise.exampleZh: 当学生独自学习一门新语言时，许多问题就会出现。

arm.example: He broke his arm last week and cannot play basketball.
arm.exampleZh: 他上周摔断了胳膊，现在不能打篮球。

armchair.example: My grandfather likes to read the newspaper in his favorite armchair.
armchair.exampleZh: 我爷爷喜欢坐在他最喜欢的扶手椅上看报纸。

army.example: A large army marched through the city early this morning.
army.exampleZh: 今天清晨，一支庞大的军队穿过城市。

around.example: There are many small shops around our school.
around.exampleZh: 我们学校周围有很多小商店。

arrange.example: She will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting tomorrow.
arrange.exampleZh: 她将为明天的会议布置好桌椅。

arrest.example: The police arrested the man near the bank this morning.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察今天早上在银行附近逮捕了那名男子。

arrival.example: Her arrival at the party made everyone very happy.
arrival.exampleZh: 她到达聚会现场让大家都很高兴。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the station at six o'clock.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们将在六点到达车站。

arrow.example: The arrow hit the target right in the middle.
arrow.exampleZh: 那支箭正好射中了靶子的正中央。

art.example: She studies art at school and paints pictures every weekend.
art.exampleZh: 她在学校学习美术，每个周末都画画。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the newspaper yesterday.
article.exampleZh: 我昨天在报纸上读到了一篇关于健康食物的有趣文章。

artificial.example: The flowers in the vase look nice, but they are artificial.
artificial.exampleZh: 花瓶里的花看起来很好看，但它们是假的。

artist.example: The artist paints beautiful pictures of the sea every morning.
artist.exampleZh: 这位艺术家每天早上都画美丽的海景画。

as.example: She sang as she walked home from school.
as.exampleZh: 她一边从学校走回家，一边唱着歌。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed when she forgot her best friend's birthday again.
ashamed.exampleZh: 当她又一次忘记最好朋友的生日时，她感到很羞愧。

asia.example: Asia is the largest continent in the world and has many countries.
asia.exampleZh: 亚洲是世界上最大的大陆，有许多国家。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 她退到一边，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: I want to ask my teacher a question after class.
ask.exampleZh: 我想在下课后问老师一个问题。

asleep.example: The baby is asleep in her small bed.
asleep.exampleZh: 婴儿在她的小床上睡着了。

aspect.example: This is one important aspect of the problem we should not ignore.
aspect.exampleZh: 这是这个问题中我们不应忽视的一个重要方面。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' progress through small tests and daily homework.
assess.exampleZh: 老师通过小测验和日常作业来评估学生的进步。

assign.example: The teacher will assign each student a simple task for the weekend.
assign.exampleZh: 老师会给每个学生布置一个周末的简单任务。

assist.example: The nurse assisted the doctor during the operation and stayed late to help.
assist.exampleZh: 手术期间护士协助医生，并留下来帮忙到很晚。

assistant.example: My assistant will help you finish the report today.
assistant.exampleZh: 我的助手今天会帮你完成这份报告。

associate.example: I always associate this song with my happy school days.
associate.exampleZh: 我总是把这首歌和我快乐的学校时光联系起来。

association.example: She is a member of the local sports association.
association.exampleZh: 她是当地体育协会的一名成员。

assume.example: Many people assume that the new plan will save time and money.
assume.exampleZh: 很多人假定这项新计划会节省时间和金钱。

assumption.example: Our plan is based on the assumption that prices will stay the same.
assumption.exampleZh: 我们的计划基于价格将保持不变的假设。

astonish.example: The size of the cake astonished all the children at the party.
astonish.exampleZh: 蛋糕的尺寸让派对上的所有孩子都感到惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut waved at the crowd before getting into the rocket.
astronaut.exampleZh: 那名宇航员在进入火箭前向人群挥手。

astronomy.example: My brother studies astronomy and often watches stars at night.
astronomy.exampleZh: 我哥哥学天文学，经常在晚上观察星星。

at.example: We will meet at the station at nine tomorrow morning.
at.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点在车站见面。

athlete.example: The young athlete trains hard every day to become stronger and faster.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻的运动员每天刻苦训练，为了变得更强、更快。

atlantic.example: We flew across the Atlantic Ocean to visit our friends in London.
atlantic.exampleZh: 我们飞越大西洋去伦敦看望朋友。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere at night.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅晚上有一种温暖友好的氛围。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest part of a chemical element.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是化学元素中最小的部分。

attach.example: Please attach the file to the email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 发出邮件之前，请把文件附上。

attack.example: The dog may attack if you get too close to its food.
attack.exampleZh: 如果你靠它的食物太近，那条狗可能会攻击你。

attain.example: With hard work, she was able to attain her goal in just two years.
attain.exampleZh: 通过努力，她仅用两年就实现了自己的目标。

attempt.example: She made a brave attempt to finish the hard work alone.
attempt.exampleZh: 她勇敢地尝试独自完成这项艰难的工作。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow morning and then attend to my sick mother.
attend.exampleZh: 明天上午我将出席会议，然后照顾我生病的母亲。

attention.example: Please pay close attention to the teacher and write down the important words.
attention.exampleZh: 请密切注意老师，并记下重要的单词。

attitude.example: Her positive attitude helps her make friends easily at her new school.
attitude.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助她在新学校轻松交到朋友。

attract.example: The beautiful garden attracts many birds and visitors every spring.
attract.exampleZh: 这座美丽的花园每年春天都吸引许多鸟儿和游客。

attractive.example: The little town is very attractive in autumn.
attractive.exampleZh: 这个小镇在秋天非常迷人。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

august.example: My family always takes a long vacation together in August.
august.exampleZh: 我们一家人总是在八月一起度长假。

aunt.example: My aunt makes delicious cakes for us every Sunday afternoon.
aunt.exampleZh: 我姑母每个星期天下午都给我们做美味的蛋糕。

australia.example: My cousin moved to Australia last year to study at a university there.
australia.exampleZh: 我的表弟去年搬到澳大利亚，在那里的大学读书。

author.example: The author of this book lives in a small town.
author.exampleZh: 这本书的作者住在一个小镇上。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the streets clean.
authority.exampleZh: 当地政府负责保持街道清洁。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶变成红色和金色。

available.example: The book is available at the school library.
available.exampleZh: 这本书在学校图书馆可以借到。

avenue.example: This wide avenue leads to the city park and the train station.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条宽阔的大街通向城市公园和火车站。

average.example: The average temperature in this city is about twenty degrees.
average.exampleZh: 这个城市的平均气温大约是二十度。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar if you want to stay healthy.
avoid.exampleZh: 如果你想保持健康，就应该避免吃太多糖。

awake.example: I am still awake, but my brother is already asleep.
awake.exampleZh: 我还醒着，但我弟弟已经睡着了。

award.example: The school will award a prize to the best student this year.
award.exampleZh: 学校今年将给最优秀的学生颁发一个奖项。

aware.example: She was not aware of the danger until it was too late.
aware.exampleZh: 直到为时已晚，她才意识到危险。

away.example: She walked away from the noisy crowd and found a quiet place.
away.exampleZh: 她离开喧闹的人群，找到了一个安静的地方。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed at home all day.
awful.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

awkward.example: It was awkward when I forgot her name at the party.
awkward.exampleZh: 我在聚会上忘了她的名字，那场面很尴尬。

ax.example: He used an ax to cut the old tree into small pieces.
ax.exampleZh: 他用斧子把那棵老树砍成小块。

b.example: The teacher gave me a B on my English test.
b.exampleZh: 老师在我的英语考试中给了我一个 B。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping quietly in a small bed.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在小床上安静地睡觉。

back.example: Please step back and let the children walk through the door first.
back.exampleZh: 请后退一步，让孩子们先通过这扇门。

background.example: She has a strong background in music and loves to sing.
background.exampleZh: 她有很强的音乐背景，并且喜欢唱歌。

backward.example: The old computer is backward and too slow for modern games.
backward.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑很落后，运行现代游戏太慢了。

bacon.example: I like to eat bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday.
bacon.exampleZh: 星期天早餐我喜欢吃培根和鸡蛋。

bacteria.example: Washing your hands well helps stop harmful bacteria from spreading to other people.
bacteria.exampleZh: 好好洗手有助于阻止有害细菌传播给其他人。

bad.example: Smoking is bad for your health, so please stop it.
bad.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康有害，所以请戒掉它。

badly.example: She did badly on the test because she was very tired.
badly.exampleZh: 她考试考得很差，因为她非常累。

badminton.example: My sister and I play badminton in the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每个星期天早上都在公园里打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put her books and pens in her new school bag.
bag.exampleZh: 她把书和笔放进了她的新书包里。

baggage.example: She carried too much baggage and could not walk fast.
baggage.exampleZh: 她带了太多行李，走不快。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake cookies for us on Sunday mornings.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日早上为我们烤饼干。

balance.example: It is hard to balance work and family life.
balance.exampleZh: 平衡工作和家庭生活很难。

balcony.example: We drank tea on the small balcony and watched the busy street below.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们在小阳台上喝茶，看着下面繁忙的街道。

ball.example: The little boy kicked the red ball across the green grass.
ball.exampleZh: 小男孩把红色的球踢过绿草地。

ballet.example: She loves ballet and takes a dance class every Saturday morning.
ballet.exampleZh: 她喜欢芭蕾舞，每周六上午都去上舞蹈课。

balloon.example: The child let go of the red balloon and watched it float away.
balloon.exampleZh: 孩子松开了红气球，看着它飘走了。

ballpoint.example: I bought a cheap ballpoint for school, but it ran out of ink.
ballpoint.exampleZh: 我为上学买了一支便宜的圆珠笔，但它没墨水了。

bamboo.example: The panda sits under the tall bamboo and eats its leaves.
bamboo.exampleZh: 熊猫坐在高高的竹子下吃竹叶。

ban.example: The school bans phones in class to help students focus.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机，以帮助学生集中注意力。

banana.example: The little monkey eats a yellow banana every morning.
banana.exampleZh: 这只小猴子每天早上都吃一根黄色的香蕉。

band.example: The band played loud music at the party last night.
band.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚在聚会上演奏了很响的音乐。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on his arm and told him to rest.
bandage.exampleZh: 护士在他手臂上缠上干净的绷带，并让他休息。

bank.example: We sat on the river bank and watched the boats go by.
bank.exampleZh: 我们坐在河岸上，看着船只驶过。

banker.example: The banker helped my father get a loan for his small business.
banker.exampleZh: 那位银行家帮我父亲为他的小生意获得了一笔贷款。

bar.example: We met at a small bar near the station after work.
bar.exampleZh: 下班后我们在车站附近的一家小酒吧见了面。

barbecue.example: We had a barbecue in the park with our friends last Saturday.
barbecue.exampleZh: 上周六我们和朋友在公园里进行了一次烧烤野餐。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair short before the summer holiday.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师在暑假前把我的头发剪短了。

bare.example: The walls were bare, so we put up a few pictures.
bare.exampleZh: 墙上光秃秃的，所以我们挂了几幅画。

bargain.example: She got a great bargain on that old table at the market.
bargain.exampleZh: 她在市场上买那张旧桌子时捡了个大便宜。

bark.example: The dog began to bark loudly at the stranger near the gate.
bark.exampleZh: 狗开始对着大门附近的陌生人大声吠叫。

base.example: The small team set up its base near the river last year.
base.exampleZh: 这个小团队去年在河边建立了基地。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
baseball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和他的朋友们打棒球。

basic.example: Food and water are basic needs for every person on Earth.
basic.exampleZh: 食物和水是地球上每个人最基本的需求。

basin.example: She filled the basin with warm water to wash her face.
basin.exampleZh: 她往洗脸盆里倒满温水洗脸。

basis.example: This idea forms the basis of our new plan.
basis.exampleZh: 这个想法构成了我们新计划的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a small basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜苹果放进桌子上的一个小篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends after school every day.
basketball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天放学后和朋友们一起打篮球。

bat.example: The boy hit the ball with a wooden bat in the park.
bat.exampleZh: 男孩在公园里用木制球棒击球。

bath.example: She takes a warm bath every night before going to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: She likes to bathe the baby in warm water every evening.
bathe.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天晚上用温水给宝宝洗澡。

bathroom.example: There is a small bathroom next to my bedroom.
bathroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室旁边有一个小浴室。

battery.example: My phone battery is low, so I need to charge it soon.
battery.exampleZh: 我的手机电池电量不足，所以我需要尽快充电。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle to protect their city.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们为保护他们的城市进行了一场漫长的战斗。

bay.example: The small boat is safe in the bay near our town.
bay.exampleZh: 小船在我们镇附近的海湾里很安全。

be.example: It is good to be kind to your friends.

beach.example: We like to walk on the beach and look at the sea.
beach.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在海滩上散步，看看大海。

bean.example: My mother puts red bean in the soup every winter.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈每年冬天都在汤里放红豆。

bear.example: I cannot bear to see the little bear cry in the cold.
bear.exampleZh: 我不忍心看到那只小熊在寒冷中哭泣。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and he likes to tell stories.
beard.exampleZh: 我爷爷留着长长的白胡子，他喜欢讲故事。

beast.example: The wild beast lived deep in the dark forest.
beast.exampleZh: 那头野兽住在黑暗的森林深处。

beat.example: Our team beat the stronger side by two goals last night.
beat.exampleZh: 我们队昨晚以两球击败了更强的对手。

beautiful.example: She lives in a beautiful house near the lake.
beautiful.exampleZh: 她住在湖边一栋漂亮的房子里。

beauty.example: The beauty of the lake surprised everyone on our first morning there.
beauty.exampleZh: 湖边的美景让我们第一天早上的每个人都感到惊喜。

because.example: I stayed at home because it was raining hard all day.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为一整天都在下大雨。

become.example: He wants to become a doctor after he finishes school next year.
become.exampleZh: 他想明年毕业之后成为一名医生。

bed.example: The children were tired, so they went to bed early.
bed.exampleZh: 孩子们累了，所以早早上床睡觉。

bedroom.example: My bedroom is small but very clean and quiet.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室很小，但非常干净安静。

bee.example: A busy bee flew from flower to flower in the sunny garden.
bee.exampleZh: 一只忙碌的蜜蜂在阳光明媚的花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

beef.example: The beef in this soup is very tender and tastes good.
beef.exampleZh: 这碗汤里的牛肉很嫩，味道也不错。

beer.example: We drank cold beer and talked for hours at the small bar.
beer.exampleZh: 我们在一家小酒吧里喝着冰啤酒，聊了好几个小时。

before.example: Wash your hands before you eat dinner with the family.
before.exampleZh: 和家人吃晚饭前要先洗手。

beg.example: The old man had to beg for food on the cold street.
beg.exampleZh: 那位老人不得不在寒冷的街上乞讨食物。

beggar.example: The poor beggar asked me for some bread and hot soup.
beggar.exampleZh: 那个可怜的乞丐向我要了一些面包和热汤。

begin.example: We will begin the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点开始会议。

beginning.example: The beginning of the story is a little slow but very interesting.
beginning.exampleZh: 故事的开头有点慢，但非常有趣。

behalf.example: She spoke at the meeting on behalf of her whole team.
behalf.exampleZh: 她代表整个团队在会上发言。

behave.example: Children should behave well when they visit other people's homes.
behave.exampleZh: 孩子们去别人家做客时应该表现得有礼貌。

behavior.example: The teacher praised the students for their good behavior in class today.
behavior.exampleZh: 老师表扬了学生们今天在课堂上良好的表现。

behind.example: The little boy hid behind the door and waited for his mother.
behind.exampleZh: 小男孩躲在门后等他妈妈。

being.example: As a human being, she needs love and respect.
being.exampleZh: 作为一个人，她需要爱与尊重。

belief.example: Her belief in hard work helped her succeed at school.
belief.exampleZh: 她对努力工作的信念帮助她在学校取得了成功。

believe.example: I believe you, but I need to see the facts myself.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信你，但我需要亲自看看事实。

bell.example: The bell rang loudly and all the students ran out of the classroom.
bell.exampleZh: 铃声大作，所有学生都跑出了教室。

belly.example: My little brother ate too much candy and now his belly hurts.
belly.exampleZh: 我弟弟吃了太多糖果，现在他的肚子疼。

belong.example: These books belong to my sister, and she reads them every day.
belong.exampleZh: 这些书属于我妹妹，她每天都读它们。

below.example: The temperature dropped below zero last night and the lake froze.
below.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度以下，湖面结冰了。

belt.example: He tightened his belt before lifting the heavy box onto the truck.
belt.exampleZh: 他在把重箱子抬上卡车前系紧了腰带。

bench.example: An old man sat on a wooden bench in the park and fed the birds.
bench.exampleZh: 一位老人坐在公园的木长椅上喂鸟。

bend.example: The road bends sharply to the left after the old bridge.
bend.exampleZh: 过了那座旧桥后，这条路向左急拐弯。

beneath.example: The old cat is sleeping beneath the kitchen table.
beneath.exampleZh: 那只老猫正睡在厨房餐桌下面。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 规律运动对你的身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can bring great benefits to your health.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的健康大有益处。

bent.example: He is bent on becoming a doctor and studies hard every day.
bent.exampleZh: 他下定决心要当医生，每天都在努力学习。

beside.example: She sat beside the window and read a book all afternoon.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，整个下午都在看书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also studies French and Japanese at school.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还在学校学习法语和日语。

best.example: She is my best friend, and she always helps me after school.
best.exampleZh: 她是我最好的朋友，放学后她总是帮助我。

bet.example: I bet he will arrive before noon because the traffic is light today.
bet.exampleZh: 我敢说他会在中午前到，因为今天路上车不多。

better.example: She did better on the second test after studying harder.
better.exampleZh: 她更努力地学习后，第二次考试考得更好了。

between.example: The small park lies between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 这个小公园位于学校和图书馆之间。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond those green hills, far from the busy city.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于那些绿色山丘的那一边，远离繁忙的城市。

bicycle.example: My father rides a bicycle to work every morning.
bicycle.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上骑自行车去上班。

big.example: Our new house has a big kitchen and a very big garden.
big.exampleZh: 我们的新房子有一个大厨房和一个很大的花园。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every morning before eight.
bike.exampleZh: 我每天早上八点前骑自行车去学校。

bill.example: The waiter brought the bill after we finished our dinner.
bill.exampleZh: 我们吃完晚饭后，服务员拿来了账单。

billion.example: The company is worth more than one billion dollars today.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司如今价值超过十亿美元。

bingo.example: Bingo is a simple game that many people enjoy at parties.
bingo.exampleZh: 宾戈是一种简单的游戏，许多人在聚会上都喜欢玩。

biology.example: I want to study biology because I love learning about plants and animals.
biology.exampleZh: 我想学习生物学，因为我喜欢了解植物和动物。

bird.example: A small bird is singing on the tree in our garden.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我们花园的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last week.
birth.exampleZh: 她上周生下了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My birthday is in May, and my family always has a small party.
birthday.exampleZh: 我的生日在五月，家人总是会办一个小派对。

birthplace.example: This small town is the birthplace of the famous writer.
birthplace.exampleZh: 这个小镇是那位著名作家的出生地。

biscuit.example: My mother bought a box of biscuits for us to eat with tea.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妈妈买了一盒饼干，让我们配茶吃。

bishop.example: The bishop spoke kindly to the children after the morning church service.
bishop.exampleZh: 早晨的教堂礼拜结束后，主教和蔼地对孩子们讲话。

bit.example: I am a bit tired after the long walk today.
bit.exampleZh: 今天走了很长的路，我有点累了。

bite.example: The dog tried to bite the ball, but it rolled away.
bite.exampleZh: 那只狗试图咬住球，但球滚开了。

bitter.example: This medicine is very bitter, but it helps me feel better.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药很苦，但它让我感觉好一些。

black.example: She wore a black coat and carried a small black bag to work.
black.exampleZh: 她穿着一件黑色外套，带着一个黑色小包去上班。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard with a piece of white chalk.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师用一根白粉笔把生词写在了黑板上。

blame.example: Don't blame me for the mistake; it was not my fault.
blame.exampleZh: 别把错误怪到我头上，那不是我的错。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the form.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在表格顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket on the bed because the night was cold.
blanket.exampleZh: 因为夜里很冷，她在床上盖了一条温暖的毯子。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed again after he washed it.
bleed.exampleZh: 他手上的伤口在清洗之后又开始流血了。

blend.example: She likes to blend fresh fruit with yogurt for breakfast.
blend.exampleZh: 她喜欢把新鲜水果和酸奶混合起来当早餐。

bless.example: I bless the kind people who helped my family.
bless.exampleZh: 我祝福那些帮助过我家的善良人们。

blind.example: The blind man uses a white stick to walk safely.
blind.exampleZh: 那位盲人用一根白手杖安全地行走。

block.example: A big block of ice blocked the road near my house.
block.exampleZh: 一大块冰堵住了我家附近的路。

blood.example: The doctor took some blood from his arm to run a test.
blood.exampleZh: 医生从他手臂上取了一些血去化验。

bloody.example: The soldier came back from the bloody battle with a wounded arm.
bloody.exampleZh: 那名士兵从血腥的战斗中归来，手臂受了伤。

bloom.example: The garden is in full bloom, and the flowers look beautiful this spring.
bloom.exampleZh: 花园里百花盛开，今年春天的花朵看起来很美。

blouse.example: She wore a white blouse and a long blue skirt to work.
blouse.exampleZh: 她穿了一件白色女衬衫和一条蓝色长裙去上班。

blow.example: The wind began to blow hard, and the old tree fell down.
blow.exampleZh: 风开始猛烈地刮，那棵老树倒下了。

blue.example: She felt blue after her best friend moved away to another city.
blue.exampleZh: 她最好的朋友搬到另一个城市后，她感到很沮丧。

board.example: The board met this morning to discuss the new school budget.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天上午开会讨论新的学校预算。

boat.example: We went across the lake by boat and saw many birds.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘小船穿过湖面，看到了许多鸟。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体强壮又健康。

boil.example: The water will boil in a few minutes, so please wait.
boil.exampleZh: 水几分钟后就会沸腾，请稍等。

bold.example: She made a bold decision to change her whole career.
bold.exampleZh: 她做出了一个大胆的决定，彻底改变了自己的职业。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field and soldiers moved everyone away.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在田里被发现，士兵把所有人都疏散开了。

bond.example: The shared love of music formed a strong bond between the two sisters.
bond.exampleZh: 对音乐的共同热爱在姐妹俩之间形成了牢固的纽带。

bone.example: The dog buried a bone in the soft ground behind the house.
bone.exampleZh: 狗把一根骨头埋在了房子后面松软的地里。

bonus.example: The workers got a bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 工人们在年底拿到了一笔奖金。

book.example: I want to book a table for two at the restaurant tonight.
book.exampleZh: 我想预订今晚餐厅的一张双人桌。

bookshop.example: I bought this old dictionary at a small bookshop near my school.
bookshop.exampleZh: 我在学校附近的一家小书店买了这本旧词典。

boot.example: She put her boots by the door after a long walk in the rain.
boot.exampleZh: 在雨中走了很久之后，她把靴子放在了门边。

border.example: The river forms the border between the two small countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河构成了这两个小国之间的边界。

bored.example: The children were bored because the long trip had no games.
bored.exampleZh: 孩子们感到厌烦，因为这次长途旅行没有游戏可玩。

boring.example: This movie is so boring that I fell asleep twice.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了两次。

born.example: She was born in a small village near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小村庄。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
borrow.exampleZh: 我能借用一下你的笔吗？

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板让我在周五前完成这份报告。

both.example: Both of my parents like to walk in the park.
both.exampleZh: 我父母两人都喜欢在公园里散步。

bother.example: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me for a minute?
bother.exampleZh: 不好意思打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？

bottle.example: She put the cold water in a bottle before the long walk.
bottle.exampleZh: 出发走长路之前，她把凉水装进了一个瓶子。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high if you throw it at the wall.
bounce.exampleZh: 如果你把球扔到墙上，它会弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the city and will leave in ten minutes.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往那座城市，将在十分钟后出发。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two small villages.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小村庄之间的天然分界线。

bow.example: The little girl gave a bow after her dance.
bow.exampleZh: 小女孩跳完舞后鞠了一躬。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup in a large bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一只大碗里。

box.example: She put the old letters in a box and carried it upstairs.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧信件放进一个盒子里，然后把它搬到了楼上。

boy.example: The boy is playing football with his friends in the park.
boy.exampleZh: 那个男孩正在公园里和朋友们踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company after they learned about its poor working conditions.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人在得知该公司恶劣的工作条件后决定抵制它。

brain.example: She uses her brain to solve difficult math problems every day.
brain.exampleZh: 她每天都用大脑解决困难的数学题。

brake.example: He hit the brake hard when a dog ran into the road.
brake.exampleZh: 一只狗跑上马路时，他猛踩刹车。

branch.example: The bank has a new branch near my house.
branch.exampleZh: 这家银行在我家附近有一个新分行。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is popular with young people.
brand.exampleZh: 这个牌子的咖啡很受年轻人欢迎。

brave.example: The brave boy helped the old man cross the busy street.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的男孩帮助老人穿过了繁忙的街道。

bravery.example: Her bravery in the dark forest saved the whole team.
bravery.exampleZh: 她在漆黑森林中的勇敢救了整个队伍。

bread.example: She buys fresh bread from the small shop near her house every morning.
bread.exampleZh: 她每天早上都从家附近的小店买新鲜面包。

break.example: Be careful with that glass, or you will break it.
break.exampleZh: 小心那个玻璃杯，否则你会把它打破。

breakfast.example: My mother makes breakfast for us every morning before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上学前为我们做早餐。

breath.example: She took a deep breath before she opened the door.
breath.exampleZh: 她打开门前深吸了一口气。

breathe.example: I like to breathe the fresh air in the park every morning.
breathe.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早上在公园里呼吸新鲜空气。

breathless.example: After running up the stairs, she was breathless and had to sit down.
breathless.exampleZh: 跑上楼梯后，她气喘吁吁，不得不坐下来。

brick.example: The old house is made of red brick and has a small garden.
brick.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用红砖建成的，还有一个小花园。

bride.example: The bride looked happy as she walked into the small church with her father.
bride.exampleZh: 新娘在父亲的陪伴下走进那座小教堂时，看起来很开心。

bridge.example: The new bridge helps people cross the river safely every day.
bridge.exampleZh: 这座新桥帮助人们每天安全地过河。

brief.example: The teacher gave a brief talk about the new class rules.
brief.exampleZh: 老师就新的班规做了简短的讲话。

bright.example: The bright morning sun made the children happy.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的晨阳让孩子们很开心。

brilliant.example: She is a brilliant young scientist with many new ideas.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她是一位才华横溢的年轻科学家，有很多新想法。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把你的笔记本带到课上。

broad.example: The river is broad and deep near the old bridge.
broad.exampleZh: 这条河在旧桥附近又宽又深。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football match live tonight.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚将现场直播这场足球比赛。

brochure.example: I picked up a travel brochure about the beaches in southern Spain.
brochure.exampleZh: 我拿了一本关于西班牙南部海滩的旅游宣传册。

broken.example: My phone is broken, so I cannot call my mother today.
broken.exampleZh: 我的手机坏了，所以今天不能给妈妈打电话。

broom.example: She used an old broom to sweep the dry leaves off the front porch.
broom.exampleZh: 她用一把旧扫帚把前廊上的干树叶扫掉。

brother.example: My brother is two years older than me and he plays basketball well.
brother.exampleZh: 我哥哥比我大两岁，他篮球打得很好。

brown.example: The little dog has brown eyes and likes to run in the park.
brown.exampleZh: 这只小狗有棕色的眼睛，喜欢在公园里奔跑。

brunch.example: On Sunday we had brunch with our friends at a small cafe.
brunch.exampleZh: 星期天我们和朋友们在一家小咖啡馆吃了早午餐。

brush.example: She uses a small brush to paint the walls in her room.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子粉刷她房间的墙壁。

bucket.example: He filled the bucket with water from the old well.
bucket.exampleZh: 他从那口老井里打了一桶水。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建造一所新学校。

building.example: The old building on our street is now a small library.
building.exampleZh: 我们街上的那栋旧楼现在是一家小图书馆。

bulb.example: She turned off the light bulb and went to bed.
bulb.exampleZh: 她关掉灯泡，然后去睡觉了。

bull.example: The big black bull ran across the field toward the water.
bull.exampleZh: 那头大黑公牛穿过田野，朝水边跑去。

bullet.example: The police found a bullet on the floor near the broken window.
bullet.exampleZh: 警察在破碎窗户附近的地板上发现了一颗子弹。

bunch.example: She gave me a bunch of flowers and a big smile.
bunch.exampleZh: 她给了我一束花和一个灿烂的微笑。

burden.example: The extra work became a heavy burden on the small team.
burden.exampleZh: 额外的工作成了这个小团队的沉重负担。

burn.example: Be careful with that hot pan or you will burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个滚烫的锅，不然你会烫伤手。

burst.example: The balloon burst with a loud noise and scared the children.
burst.exampleZh: 气球砰的一声爆裂，吓到了孩子们。

bury.example: The dog likes to bury its bone in the soft garden soil.
bury.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在松软的花园泥土里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: The children hid behind a thick bush in the garden.
bush.exampleZh: 孩子们躲在花园里一丛茂密的灌木后面。

business.example: My father runs a small business in the city center.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心经营一家小公司。

busy.example: My mother is very busy with her work every day.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天工作都很忙。

but.example: I want to go out, but it is raining hard now.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是现在雨下得很大。

butcher.example: The butcher cuts fresh meat for us every morning.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫每天早上为我们切新鲜的肉。

butter.example: She spread butter on her toast and ate it quickly.
butter.exampleZh: 她把黄油涂在吐司上，然后很快吃掉了。

button.example: Please press the red button to open the door for me.
button.exampleZh: 请按红色按钮帮我开门。

buy.example: I want to buy a new bike for my son.
buy.exampleZh: 我想给我儿子买一辆新自行车。

by.example: The letter was written by my sister and sent by train.
by.exampleZh: 这封信是我妹妹写的，并通过火车寄出。

cab.example: We took a cab to the train station early this morning.
cab.exampleZh: 我们今天一早坐出租车去了火车站。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with pork and rice for dinner every Sunday.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期日都用卷心菜、猪肉和米饭做晚饭。

cable.example: The workers used a strong cable to pull the heavy box up.
cable.exampleZh: 工人们用一根结实的缆绳把那个重箱子拉了上去。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for an hour.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了一个小时。

cage.example: The zookeeper put the small bird back into its cage.
cage.exampleZh: 动物园管理员把那只小鸟放回了它的笼子里。

cake.example: My mother made a chocolate cake for my birthday.
cake.exampleZh: 我妈妈为我的生日做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

calculate.example: Let me calculate the total cost before we buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 在我们买票之前，让我先计算一下总费用。

calendar.example: I write all my meetings on the calendar by my desk.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把所有会议都写在桌边的日历上。

call.example: Please call me when you get home tonight.
call.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请给我打个电话。

calm.example: She stayed calm and told everyone to leave the building slowly.
calm.exampleZh: 她保持镇定，让大家慢慢离开大楼。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot sand under the bright sun.
camel.exampleZh: 骆驼在烈日下缓慢地走过滚烫的沙地。

camera.example: She bought a new camera to take pictures of her trip.
camera.exampleZh: 她买了一台新相机来拍摄旅行照片。

camp.example: We set up camp near the river and slept under the stars.
camp.exampleZh: 我们在河边扎营，在星空下入睡。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to keep the river clean.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场保护河流清洁的运动。

can.example: You can put the empty can in this box.
can.exampleZh: 你可以把空罐头放进这个盒子里。

canada.example: My uncle moved to Canada last year and found a new job there.
canada.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年搬到了加拿大，并在那里找到了一份新工作。

canal.example: The old canal carries water from the river to the nearby farms.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河把水从河里引到附近的农场。

cancel.example: They had to cancel the meeting because the manager was ill.
cancel.exampleZh: 他们不得不取消会议，因为经理生病了。

cancer.example: Her father died of lung cancer after smoking for many years.
cancer.exampleZh: 她父亲吸烟多年后死于肺癌。

candidate.example: She is a strong candidate for the job.
candidate.exampleZh: 她是这份工作的有力候选人。

candle.example: She lit a candle and put it on the table.
candle.exampleZh: 她点了一支蜡烛，把它放在桌上。

candy.example: The little boy ate too much candy and felt sick.
candy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩吃了太多糖果，感到不舒服。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天中午都在学校食堂吃午饭。

cap.example: Please put the cap back on the pen before you close your notebook.
cap.exampleZh: 请在你合上笔记本之前把笔帽盖回笔上。

capable.example: She is a capable teacher who always helps her students learn new things.
capable.exampleZh: 她是一位能干的老师，总是帮助她的学生学习新知识。

capacity.example: This small room has the capacity to hold twenty people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个小房间的容量可以容纳二十个人。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very large city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常大的城市。

captain.example: The captain of the ship told his team to stay calm.
captain.exampleZh: 船长告诉他的团队保持冷静。

capture.example: The police worked hard to capture the thief who stole the money.
capture.exampleZh: 警方努力抓获了那个偷钱的小偷。

car.example: My father drives his car to work every morning.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车去上班。

carbon.example: Carbon is a key element in all living things on Earth.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是地球上所有生物的关键元素。

card.example: She wrote a short note on a small card for her friend.
card.exampleZh: 她在一张小卡片上给朋友写了几句简短的话。

care.example: She cares for her old parents with great care every day.
care.exampleZh: 她每天悉心照顾年迈的父母。

career.example: She hopes to build a long career in medicine after she finishes school.
career.exampleZh: 她希望在完成学业后，在医学领域建立一段长期的职业生涯。

careful.example: Please be careful with the hot water in that cup.

careless.example: He is too careless with his homework and often makes small mistakes.
careless.exampleZh: 他做作业太粗心，经常犯小错误。

carpet.example: There is a soft carpet on the floor of our living room.
carpet.exampleZh: 我们客厅的地板上有一块柔软的地毯。

carriage.example: The old king rode through the village in a golden carriage.
carriage.exampleZh: 老国王乘坐一辆金色马车穿过村庄。

carrier.example: The carrier will deliver your package by train tomorrow morning.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家运输公司明天早上会用火车送你的包裹。

carrot.example: My mother puts a carrot in the soup and it tastes sweet.
carrot.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一根胡萝卜，味道很甜。

carry.example: She always carries a bottle of water in her bag to school.
carry.exampleZh: 她总是书包里带一瓶水去学校。

cart.example: She pushed the cart full of fresh vegetables through the busy market.
cart.exampleZh: 她推着装满新鲜蔬菜的手推车穿过繁忙的市场。

cartoon.example: My little brother watches a cartoon every morning before school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天早上上学前都会看一部动画片。

case.example: This is a difficult case, so we need more time.
case.exampleZh: 这是一个棘手的案例，所以我们需要更多时间。

cash.example: I paid the taxi driver in cash and walked home.
cash.exampleZh: 我用现金付了出租车司机车费，然后步行回家。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette with my favorite songs in the drawer.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里找到一盘录着我最喜欢的歌的旧磁带。

cast.example: The director cast a young actor in the lead role.
cast.exampleZh: 导演选派了一位年轻演员担任主角。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡矗立在河边的山上。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and talked with everyone.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着随便的衣服去参加聚会，和每个人都聊了聊。

cat.example: The black cat sleeps on my warm bed every afternoon.
cat.exampleZh: 那只黑猫每天下午都睡在我温暖的床上。

catalog.example: She looked in the library catalog to find the book.
catalog.exampleZh: 她在图书馆目录里查找那本书。

catch.example: He ran to catch the last bus home after work.
catch.exampleZh: 他下班后跑着去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category than the others on the shelf.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与书架上其他书不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps many cattle on his small farm in the valley.
cattle.exampleZh: 这位农民在山谷里的小农场上养了许多牛。

cause.example: The heavy rain caused a big problem for the whole team.
cause.exampleZh: 大雨给整个团队带来了一个大问题。

cave.example: The old man hid his food in a cave near the river.
cave.exampleZh: 那位老人把食物藏在河边的一个山洞里。

cd.example: I put the new cd into the player and listened to it.
cd.exampleZh: 我把新光盘放进播放机里听了起来。

cease.example: The factory will cease production next month because of falling sales.
cease.exampleZh: 由于销量下滑，这家工厂将于下月停止生产。

ceiling.example: The ceiling in my bedroom is very high.

celebrate.example: We always celebrate my grandmother's birthday with a big family dinner.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们总是用一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐来庆祝奶奶的生日。

celebration.example: The whole town came together for a big celebration after the team won the game.
celebration.exampleZh: 球队赢得比赛后，全镇人聚在一起举行了一场盛大的庆祝活动。

cell.example: The human body has many cells, and each cell has a special job.
cell.exampleZh: 人体有许多细胞，每个细胞都有特定的功能。

cent.example: This candy costs fifty cents, and I have only one cent left.
cent.exampleZh: 这颗糖要五十分，我只剩下一分了。

centigrade.example: The water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade.
centigrade.exampleZh: 水在一百摄氏度时沸腾。

central.example: The library is in the central part of the city.
central.exampleZh: 图书馆位于城市的中心地带。

centre.example: The new library is in the centre of town, near the market.
centre.exampleZh: 新图书馆在市中心，靠近市场。

century.example: This old church was built in the nineteenth century.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony was short, but everyone in the family loved it.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式很短，但家里的每个人都很喜欢。

certain.example: I am certain that this is the right answer.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定这是正确的答案。

certainly.example: I will certainly help you with your homework after dinner.
certainly.exampleZh: 晚饭后我一定会帮你做作业。

certificate.example: You need a birth certificate to get a passport for your child.
certificate.exampleZh: 你需要出生证明才能为孩子办理护照。

chain.example: The old dog is chained to a tree near the shop.
chain.exampleZh: 那只老狗被链子拴在商店附近的一棵树旁。

chair.example: The old man sat in a wooden chair beside the window.
chair.exampleZh: 老人坐在窗边的一把木椅上。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and asked everyone to sit down.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席宣布会议开始，并请大家坐下。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote our names on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔把我们的名字写在了黑板上。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge, but I enjoy it.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是一项巨大的挑战，但我很享受。

challenging.example: Learning to drive a car can be challenging at first.
challenging.exampleZh: 学开车一开始可能会很有挑战性。

champion.example: She became the national champion after years of hard training.
champion.exampleZh: 经过多年刻苦训练，她成为了全国冠军。

chance.example: There is a good chance that we will see him tomorrow.
chance.exampleZh: 我们明天见到他的可能性很大。

change.example: I need to change my shirt before we go out tonight.
change.exampleZh: 今晚出门前我需要换件衬衫。

channel.example: This TV channel shows news and sports from around the world.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道播放来自世界各地的新闻和体育节目。

chapter.example: I read the first chapter of this book last night.
chapter.exampleZh: 我昨晚读了这本书的第一章。

character.example: His kind character makes everyone in the office trust him.
character.exampleZh: 他善良的性格让办公室里的每个人都信任他。

characteristic.example: Patience is a characteristic of good teachers.
characteristic.exampleZh: 耐心是好老师的一个特征。

charge.example: The hotel will charge you extra for breakfast and parking.
charge.exampleZh: 酒店会就早餐和停车向你额外收费。

chart.example: The teacher drew a chart to show how the weather changes each month.
chart.exampleZh: 老师画了一张图表，用来展示天气每个月如何变化。

chase.example: The small dog likes to chase the ball across the yard.
chase.exampleZh: 那只小狗喜欢在院子里追着球跑。

chat.example: Let's chat over coffee about your new job.
chat.exampleZh: 我们边喝咖啡边聊聊你的新工作吧。

cheap.example: This shirt is cheap, but the cloth feels a little rough.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件衬衫很便宜，但布料摸起来有点粗糙。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test but the teacher saw him.
cheat.exampleZh: 他考试时想作弊，但老师看到了他。

check.example: Please check your answers before handing in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 请在交试卷前核对你的答案。

cheek.example: She touched his cheek and smiled at him.
cheek.exampleZh: 她摸了摸他的面颊，朝他笑了笑。

cheer.example: The crowd began to cheer when the team scored the winning goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 球队攻入制胜一球时，人群开始欢呼。

cheerful.example: She is always cheerful and makes everyone smile at work every day.
cheerful.exampleZh: 她总是兴高采烈的，每天上班都让每个人露出笑容。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for breakfast.
cheese.exampleZh: 我早餐喜欢在面包上放一些奶酪。

chemical.example: The chemical in this cleaner is too strong for your hands.
chemical.exampleZh: 这种清洁剂里的化学品对你的手来说太刺激了。

chemist.example: The chemist works in a small shop near my house.
chemist.exampleZh: 那位药剂师在我家附近的一家小店里工作。

chemistry.example: She studies chemistry at school and hopes to become a scientist.
chemistry.exampleZh: 她在学校学习化学，希望成为一名科学家。

cheque.example: I paid the hotel bill by cheque this morning.
cheque.exampleZh: 今天早上我用支票支付了酒店账单。

cherry.example: The little girl picked a red cherry from the tree in the garden.
cherry.exampleZh: 小女孩从花园的树上摘了一颗红樱桃。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Saturday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我和弟弟每周六下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
chest.exampleZh: 他把手放在胸口上，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: Please chew your food slowly before you swallow it.
chew.exampleZh: 请慢慢咀嚼食物再吞下去。

chicken.example: My mother cooks chicken with rice for dinner every Sunday.
chicken.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚饭都做鸡肉配米饭。

chief.example: She is the chief doctor at our small town hospital.
chief.exampleZh: 她是我们小镇医院的首席医生。

child.example: Every child in the class received a small book from the teacher.
child.exampleZh: 班上的每个孩子都从老师那里收到了一本小书。

childhood.example: I have many happy memories of my childhood in the countryside.
childhood.exampleZh: 我对在乡下度过的童年有许多快乐的回忆。

chocolate.example: My sister gave me a small box of chocolate for my birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我妹妹送了我一小盒巧克力作为生日礼物。

choice.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee this morning.
choice.exampleZh: 今天早上你可以在茶和咖啡之间做选择。

choir.example: Our school choir will sing three songs at the concert tonight.
choir.exampleZh: 我们学校的合唱团今晚将在音乐会上演唱三首歌。

choose.example: You can choose any book you like from the shelf.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从书架上挑选任何一本你喜欢的书。

chopsticks.example: In China, people use chopsticks to eat rice and noodles.
chopsticks.exampleZh: 在中国，人们用筷子吃米饭和面条。

chorus.example: The whole class sang the chorus together at the school concert.
chorus.exampleZh: 全班同学在学校音乐会上一起唱了副歌。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian who goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是基督徒，每个星期天都去教堂。

christmas.example: We open gifts early on Christmas morning and visit our grandparents later.
christmas.exampleZh: 圣诞节早上我们先拆礼物，之后去看望祖父母。

church.example: The old church stands at the end of our street, and many people go there on Sundays.
church.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂坐落在我们街道的尽头，许多人在星期天去那里。

cigar.example: My grandfather likes to sit on the porch and smoke a cigar after dinner.
cigar.exampleZh: 我祖父喜欢晚饭后坐在门廊上抽一支雪茄。

cigarette.example: My father smokes one cigarette after dinner every evening.
cigarette.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚上晚饭后抽一支香烟。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to see a new film.
cinema.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去电影院看了一部新电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle on the floor and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在地板上围成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The racing cars went around the circuit three times.
circuit.exampleZh: 赛车绕着赛道跑了三圈。

citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in the local election.
citizen.exampleZh: 每位公民都有权在地方选举中投票。

city.example: The city is very busy and noisy in the morning.
city.exampleZh: 这座城市早上非常忙碌和喧闹。

civil.example: Every civil case in this city goes through the local court.
civil.exampleZh: 这座城市的每一起民事案件都要经过当地法院审理。

civilian.example: The soldiers helped the civilians leave the dangerous city before the fighting started.
civilian.exampleZh: 士兵们帮助平民在战斗开始前离开了那座危险的城市。

claim.example: The company claims that its new product is safe for children.
claim.exampleZh: 该公司声称其新产品对儿童是安全的。

clap.example: The whole class began to clap loudly when the singer finished her song.
clap.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，全班同学开始大声鼓掌。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and we have English class every morning.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生，每天早上都有英语课。

classic.example: This old film is a classic that many people still enjoy today.
classic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一部经典，如今仍有很多人喜欢。

classical.example: She enjoys listening to classical music while she studies in the evening.
classical.exampleZh: 她喜欢在晚上学习时听古典音乐。

classmate.example: My classmate sits next to me and helps me with math.
classmate.exampleZh: 我的同班同学坐在我旁边，还帮我学数学。

classroom.example: Our classroom is clean and bright, and we read books there every morning.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们的教室干净明亮，我们每天早上在那里读书。

clean.example: Please keep your room clean and help me clean the kitchen.
clean.exampleZh: 请保持你的房间干净，并帮我打扫厨房。

clear.example: The sky is clear, so we can see the stars tonight.
clear.exampleZh: 天空很晴朗，所以今晚我们能看见星星。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了我的房间钥匙。

clever.example: She is a clever girl and can solve hard problems quickly.
clever.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的女孩，能很快解决难题。

climb.example: We climbed the hill before the sun came up.
climb.exampleZh: 我们在太阳升起之前爬上了小山。

clinic.example: She took her sick son to the clinic near their home.
clinic.exampleZh: 她带生病的儿子去了家附近的诊所。

clock.example: I looked at the clock and saw it was already eight o'clock.
clock.exampleZh: 我看了看钟，发现已经八点了。

clone.example: Scientists made a clone of the sheep to study how genes work.
clone.exampleZh: 科学家复制了这只羊，以研究基因如何运作。

close.example: Please close the door because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
close.exampleZh: 请关上门，因为宝宝正在隔壁房间睡觉。

cloth.example: She wiped the table with a clean cloth after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后，她用一块干净的抹布擦了桌子。

clothes.example: I wash my clothes every weekend because I like clean shirts.
clothes.exampleZh: 我每个周末都洗衣服，因为我喜欢干净整洁的衬衫。

cloud.example: Dark clouds covered the sky before the storm began.
cloud.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云遮住了天空。

club.example: He joined a chess club at school and made many new friends there.
club.exampleZh: 他在学校加入了一个国际象棋社团，并在那里结识了许多新朋友。

clumsy.example: He is too clumsy to carry the glass without dropping it.
clumsy.exampleZh: 他太笨手笨脚了，端玻璃杯总是会掉。

coach.example: Our coach takes the team to the long-distance coach station every Sunday morning.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的教练每周日早上带队伍去长途汽车站。

coal.example: The old train still burns coal to make steam for its engine.
coal.exampleZh: 那列老火车仍然烧煤来产生蒸汽驱动引擎。

coast.example: We drove along the coast and stopped to watch the sunset.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸开车，并停下来看日落。

coat.example: She put on her warm coat and went out to meet her friends.
coat.exampleZh: 她穿上暖和的外套，出门去见朋友们。

cock.example: The old cock wakes everyone up early every morning on the farm.
cock.exampleZh: 那只老公鸡每天早上在农场里把大家都叫醒。

cocoa.example: I like to drink hot cocoa on cold winter mornings.
cocoa.exampleZh: 我喜欢在寒冷的冬日早晨喝热可可。

code.example: Please keep your password code secret and never share it with anyone.
code.exampleZh: 请对你的密码保密，绝不要与任何人分享。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯咖啡。

coin.example: The old man put a coin into the machine and got a ticket.
coin.exampleZh: 老人把一枚硬币放进机器，得到了一张票。

coke.example: My father drinks a cold coke after work every hot summer day.
coke.exampleZh: 每个炎热的夏日，我父亲下班后都会喝一瓶冰可乐。

cold.example: Sam has a bad cold today and he must stay in bed.
cold.exampleZh: 山姆今天得了重感冒，他必须卧床休息。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck in the park.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗在公园里脖子上戴着一个红色的项圈。

colleague.example: My colleague helped me finish the report before the meeting.
colleague.exampleZh: 我的同事在会议前帮我完成了这份报告。

collect.example: She likes to collect old stamps from many different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 她喜欢收集来自许多不同国家的旧邮票。

college.example: My brother is going to college next year to study art.
college.exampleZh: 我哥哥明年要上大学学习艺术。

collision.example: The two cars had a serious collision on the busy road this morning.
collision.exampleZh: 今天早上两辆汽车在繁忙的路上发生了严重的碰撞。

colony.example: This small town began as a colony of workers from the north.
colony.exampleZh: 这个小镇最初是来自北方的工人们的聚居地。

colour.example: The bright colour of the sky makes everyone happy today.
colour.exampleZh: 天空明亮的颜色让今天每个人都很开心。

comb.example: I use a comb to make my hair tidy every morning.
comb.exampleZh: 我每天早上用梳子把头发梳理整齐。

combination.example: The safe can only be opened with the right combination of numbers.
combination.exampleZh: 这个保险箱只能用正确的数字组合打开。

combine.example: You can combine the two small rooms to make one big room.
combine.exampleZh: 你可以把这两个小房间合并成一个大房间。

come.example: Please come to my house after school today.

comfort.example: A warm cup of tea brings me great comfort on cold days.
comfort.exampleZh: 在寒冷的日子里，一杯热茶给我带来极大的舒适。

comfortable.example: This old chair is very comfortable to sit in.
comfortable.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子坐着很舒服。

command.example: The general commands a large army and has full command of the situation.
command.exampleZh: 这位将军统率着一支庞大的军队，并完全掌控着局势。

comment.example: Her comment on my new dress was kind and very helpful.
comment.exampleZh: 她对我新裙子的评论很友善，也非常有帮助。

commerce.example: Online commerce has grown very fast in the past few years.
commerce.exampleZh: 在线商业在过去几年里发展得非常快。

commercial.example: The new commercial for the phone is funny and very short.
commercial.exampleZh: 这则手机新广告很有趣，而且很短。

commission.example: The bank charges a small commission for changing money.
commission.exampleZh: 银行兑换货币收取少量手续费。

commit.example: She did not want to commit to the new job right away.
commit.exampleZh: 她不想马上承诺接受这份新工作。

committee.example: The school committee will meet on Monday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 学校委员会将于周一开会讨论这项新计划。

common.example: This is a common problem for many young people today.
common.exampleZh: 这是当今许多年轻人常见的问题。

communicate.example: Good teachers communicate with their students in a simple and clear way.
communicate.exampleZh: 好老师会用简单清楚的方式与学生交流。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and children can solve many problems at home.
communication.exampleZh: 父母和孩子之间的良好沟通能解决家里的许多问题。

community.example: Our community holds a small market every Saturday morning.
community.exampleZh: 我们社区每周六上午举办一个小型集市。

companion.example: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
companion.exampleZh: 在长途散步时，我的狗是我最好的伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a big company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家大公司工作。

compare.example: If you compare the two plans, you will see the second is much cheaper.
compare.exampleZh: 如果你把这两个方案比较一下，就会发现第二个便宜得多。

comparison.example: The comparison between the two cities shows that both are growing fast.
comparison.exampleZh: 对这两座城市的比较表明，两者都在快速发展。

compete.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with big supermarkets on price.
compete.exampleZh: 小商店发现在价格上很难与大型超市竞争。

competent.example: She is a competent teacher who explains difficult ideas very clearly.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一位称职的老师，能把难懂的概念讲得非常清楚。

competition.example: The competition at the school sports day was very strong this year.
competition.exampleZh: 今年学校运动会的竞争非常激烈。

complain.example: She always complains about the noise from the street at night.
complain.exampleZh: 她总是抱怨夜里街上的噪音。

complete.example: We need a complete plan before we start the work.
complete.exampleZh: 我们需要一个完整的计划才能开始工作。

complex.example: This math problem is too complex for young students to solve.
complex.exampleZh: 这道数学题对年轻学生来说太复杂了，他们无法解决。

complicated.example: This game has complicated rules, so I need help.
complicated.exampleZh: 这个游戏的规则很复杂，所以我需要帮助。

component.example: Each component of the machine is easy to replace and repair.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都很容易更换和修理。

compose.example: The teacher asked us to compose a short song for the school show.
compose.exampleZh: 老师让我们为学校演出创作一首短歌。

composition.example: The composition of this painting is simple but very beautiful.
composition.exampleZh: 这幅画的构图简单但非常美。

compound.example: The word compound can mean a chemical substance, a group of buildings, or to make something worse.
compound.exampleZh: compound 这个词可以指化学物质、一组建筑，也可以表示使某事变得更糟。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of difficult texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对难懂文本的理解力。

compromise.example: The two sides finally reached a compromise after a long talk.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过长时间的谈话，双方最终达成了妥协。

compute.example: We can compute the total cost before we buy the tickets.
compute.exampleZh: 我们可以在买票之前计算一下总费用。

computer.example: I use my computer every day for school and work.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用电脑上学和办公。

comrade.example: My father often talks about an old comrade from his army days.
comrade.exampleZh: 我父亲经常谈起他当兵时的一位老战友。

conceited.example: He is too conceited to listen to anyone else's advice.
conceited.exampleZh: 他太自负了，听不进别人的任何建议。

concentrate.example: She cannot concentrate on her homework when the TV is on.
concentrate.exampleZh: 电视开着的时候她无法专心做作业。

concept.example: The teacher explained the concept with a simple picture.
concept.exampleZh: 老师用一张简单的图解释了这个概念。

concern.example: The news about the factory closing raised concern among all the workers.
concern.exampleZh: 工厂即将关闭的消息引起了所有工人的担忧。

concert.example: We went to a concert in the park last Saturday evening.
concert.exampleZh: 上周六晚上我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

conclude.example: We can conclude from the data that the plan is working well.
conclude.exampleZh: 从数据中我们可以断定，这个计划正在顺利奏效。

conclusion.example: We reached the same conclusion after reading the whole report.
conclusion.exampleZh: 读完整个报告后，我们得出了同样的结论。

condition.example: Good living conditions are important for children's health and happiness.
condition.exampleZh: 良好的生活条件对孩子的健康和幸福很重要。

conduct.example: The teacher praised his good conduct during the school trip.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师表扬了他在学校旅行中的良好品行。

conductor.example: The conductor checked our tickets before the train left the busy station.
conductor.exampleZh: 列车员在火车离开繁忙的车站前检查了我们的车票。

conference.example: She went to a big conference in Beijing last week with her team.
conference.exampleZh: 上周她和她的团队去北京参加了一个大型会议。

confident.example: She feels confident about the exam because she studied hard.
confident.exampleZh: 她对这次考试很有信心，因为她学习很努力。

confirm.example: Please confirm your order by email before Friday.
confirm.exampleZh: 请在周五之前通过电子邮件确认你的订单。

conflict.example: There is a conflict between what he says and what he does.
conflict.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在矛盾。

confuse.example: The two words are easy to confuse because they look almost the same.
confuse.exampleZh: 这两个词很容易混淆，因为它们看起来几乎一样。

congratulate.example: I want to congratulate you on your new job and wish you good luck.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我想祝贺你获得新工作，并祝你好运。

congratulation.example: We sent him a short message of congratulation after he won the prize.
congratulation.exampleZh: 他获奖后，我们给他发了一条简短的祝贺信息。

connect.example: Please connect the printer to your computer before you start the work.
connect.exampleZh: 开始工作前，请先把打印机连接到你的电脑上。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between daily exercise and good health.
connection.exampleZh: 每天锻炼与身体健康之间有很强的联系。

conscience.example: His conscience told him to tell the truth about the broken window.
conscience.exampleZh: 他的良心告诉他要说出打破窗户的真相。

conscious.example: She was conscious of the danger but stayed calm.
conscious.exampleZh: 她意识到了危险，但仍然保持冷静。

consensus.example: The group finally reached a consensus after a long and friendly discussion.
consensus.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好的讨论，这个小组终于达成了一致意见。

consent.example: Her parents gave consent for the school trip next week.
consent.exampleZh: 她的父母同意了下周的学校旅行。

consequence.example: Every choice has a consequence, so think before you act.
consequence.exampleZh: 每个选择都有后果，所以行动前要三思。

conservative.example: My grandfather is very conservative and does not like change.
conservative.exampleZh: 我祖父非常保守，不喜欢变化。

consider.example: Please consider my idea carefully before you make the final decision.
consider.exampleZh: 请在做出最终决定之前认真考虑一下我的想法。

considerate.example: It was very considerate of you to call and ask about my mother.
considerate.exampleZh: 你打电话来询问我母亲的情况，真是太体贴了。

consist.example: The team consists of five members from different countries.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由来自不同国家的五名成员组成。

constant.example: She gave him constant help during his long and difficult year.
constant.exampleZh: 在他漫长而艰难的一年里，她始终如一地帮助他。

construct.example: They plan to construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在这条河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The new road is still under construction and will open next year.
construction.exampleZh: 这条新路仍在建设中，将于明年开放。

consult.example: You should consult your doctor before taking this new medicine.
consult.exampleZh: 服用这种新药之前，你应该咨询医生。

consume.example: Cars consume a lot of fuel when they drive in heavy traffic.
consume.exampleZh: 汽车在拥堵路段行驶时会消耗大量燃料。

contact.example: Please contact me by email if you have any questions.
contact.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请通过电子邮件联系我。

contain.example: This box contains all the old photos of our family.
contain.exampleZh: 这个盒子装着我们家的所有旧照片。

container.example: Please put the rest of the soup into a clean container.
container.exampleZh: 请把剩下的汤倒进一个干净的容器里。

contemporary.example: She likes contemporary music, and her brother is her contemporary at school.
contemporary.exampleZh: 她喜欢当代音乐，而她哥哥是她在学校的同龄人。

content.example: The content of this book is easy to understand and quite useful.
content.exampleZh: 这本书的内容通俗易懂，而且相当实用。

contest.example: She won the singing contest last year and became very popular.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年赢得了歌唱比赛，并变得非常受欢迎。

context.example: You can often guess a new word's meaning from the context.
context.exampleZh: 你通常可以从上下文中猜出一个生词的意思。

continent.example: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是世界上第二大的大陆。

continue.example: We will continue the game after a short break.
continue.exampleZh: 我们休息一会儿后继续比赛。

contract.example: The company signed a new contract with a small local supplier last week.
contract.exampleZh: 这家公司上周与当地一家小型供应商签订了一份新合同。

contrary.example: His opinion is contrary to mine, but we still talk every day.
contrary.exampleZh: 他的看法与我的相反，但我们仍然每天交谈。

contrast.example: There is a big contrast between the two brothers.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两兄弟之间有很大的反差。

contribute.example: Everyone in the class contributed some money to help the sick child.
contribute.exampleZh: 班上每个人都捐了一些钱来帮助那个生病的孩子。

contribution.example: Everyone in the team made a small contribution to the project.
contribution.exampleZh: 团队里的每个人都为这个项目做出了一点贡献。

control.example: She cannot control her anger when her children fight.
control.exampleZh: 孩子们打架时，她无法控制自己的怒火。

convenience.example: This small shop is open late for the convenience of local people.
convenience.exampleZh: 这家小店营业到很晚，为的是方便当地居民。

convenient.example: The new bus line makes it convenient for students to get to school.
convenient.exampleZh: 新的公交线路让学生上学变得很方便。

conventional.example: He did not want to follow the conventional way of doing things.
conventional.exampleZh: 他不想遵循传统的做事方式。

conversation.example: We had a long conversation about our future plans.
conversation.exampleZh: 我们就未来的计划进行了一次长谈。

convey.example: Words can convey feelings that are hard to say out loud.
convey.exampleZh: 言语可以传达那些难以大声说出口的感受。

cook.example: My mother can cook very good food for us every day.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天都能为我们做很好吃的饭菜。

cookie.example: My little sister likes to eat a warm cookie with milk after school.
cookie.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢放学后配着牛奶吃一块热乎的曲奇饼。

cool.example: The soup is too hot, so let it cool for a few minutes.
cool.exampleZh: 汤太烫了，让它凉几分钟吧。

cope.example: I cannot cope with all this work alone.
cope.exampleZh: 我无法独自应付所有这些工作。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page for every student.
copy.exampleZh: 请为每位学生复印一份这一页。

core.example: The core of the problem is that we lack enough time.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心是我们缺少足够的时间。

corn.example: My mother likes to cook corn for dinner.
corn.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢做玉米当晚餐。

corner.example: The cat sat in the corner of the room and watched us.
corner.exampleZh: 猫坐在房间的角落里看着我们。

corporate.example: The corporate office is on the tenth floor of that tall building.
corporate.exampleZh: 公司办公室在那栋高楼的第十层。

correct.example: Please correct your mistakes before you hand in the homework.
correct.exampleZh: 请在你交作业之前改正你的错误。

cost.example: The trip cost us a lot of money, but we enjoyed it.
cost.exampleZh: 这次旅行花费了我们很多钱，但我们玩得很开心。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the school party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一套漂亮的戏装去参加学校的聚会。

cosy.example: This small cosy room feels warm and friendly on cold winter nights.
cosy.exampleZh: 这个温暖舒适的小房间在寒冷的冬夜里让人感到温暖又亲切。

cottage.example: My grandmother lives in a small cottage near the river.
cottage.exampleZh: 我奶奶住在河边的一座小村舍里。

cotton.example: The shirt is made of soft cotton and feels very comfortable in summer.
cotton.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是柔软的棉布做的，夏天穿起来很舒服。

cough.example: He had a bad cough last night, so he stayed home from school.
cough.exampleZh: 他昨晚咳得很厉害，所以就待在家里没去上学。

could.example: She said she could finish the work before dinner tonight.
could.exampleZh: 她说她能在今晚晚饭前完成这项工作。

council.example: The city council will meet tomorrow to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市政委员会将于明天开会讨论新公园事宜。

count.example: Please count the books on the table and tell me the total.
count.exampleZh: 请数一下桌子上的书，然后告诉我总数。

counter.example: She put the money on the counter and left the shop quickly.
counter.exampleZh: 她把钱放在柜台上，然后迅速离开了商店。

country.example: My family lives in a small country with many green hills and rivers.
country.exampleZh: 我的家人住在一个有许多青山和河流的小国。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow their own vegetables.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，自己种蔬菜。

county.example: My grandparents live in a small county near the river.
county.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一个小县里。

couple.example: The couple lives in a small house near the river.
couple.exampleZh: 这对夫妇住在河边的一栋小房子里。

courage.example: It takes great courage to speak the truth in front of everyone.
courage.exampleZh: 在所有人面前说出真相需要极大的勇气。

course.example: This English course is easy and we all like it.
course.exampleZh: 这门英语课程很简单，我们都很喜欢。

court.example: The judge told everyone in the court to stand up and wait quietly.
court.exampleZh: 法官让法庭里的每个人都站起来安静等待。

courtyard.example: The children are playing a game in the courtyard.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在庭院里玩游戏。

cousin.example: My cousin and I often play basketball after school.
cousin.exampleZh: 我和我的表弟放学后经常一起打篮球。

cover.example: Snow covered the whole garden last night, so the children stayed inside.
cover.exampleZh: 昨晚大雪覆盖了整个花园，所以孩子们待在了室内。

cow.example: The cow gives us fresh milk every morning on the farm.
cow.exampleZh: 农场里的这头奶牛每天早上都给我们提供新鲜的牛奶。
