crash.example: The two cars crashed into each other on the icy road this morning.
crash.exampleZh: 今天早上两辆汽车在结冰的路面上相撞了。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every match on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球着迷，每场比赛都在电视上看。

cream.example: She likes cream in her coffee and cream cakes on Sundays.
cream.exampleZh: 她喜欢在咖啡里加奶油，星期天还爱吃奶油蛋糕。

create.example: The new factory will create many jobs for people in our town.
create.exampleZh: 这家新工厂将为我们镇上的人们创造许多就业机会。

creative.example: She is a creative writer who loves to tell funny stories.
creative.exampleZh: 她是一位有创造力的作家，喜欢讲有趣的故事。

credit.example: You can buy the phone on credit and pay a little each month.
credit.exampleZh: 你可以赊账买这部手机，每月付一点钱。

crew.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship safe.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员努力保持船只安全。

crime.example: The police are trying to stop crime in this city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正努力阻止这座城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal near the bank last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在银行附近抓住了那名罪犯。

crisis.example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis this year.
crisis.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正面临严重的经济危机。

criterion.example: The teacher explained the main criterion for judging the science projects.
criterion.exampleZh: 老师说明了评判科学项目的主要标准。

critic.example: The film critic said the new movie was too long and boring.
critic.exampleZh: 那位影评人说这部新电影太长、太无聊了。

critical.example: The doctor said her condition is critical and she needs surgery now.
critical.exampleZh: 医生说她的情况很危急，现在需要手术。

criticize.example: My teacher criticized my essay but also showed me how to improve it.
criticize.exampleZh: 老师批评了我的作文，但也告诉我如何改进。

crop.example: Farmers harvest their crops in autumn and then plant new seeds.
crop.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割庄稼，然后播下新的种子。

cross.example: Be careful when you cross the busy street in front of the school.
cross.exampleZh: 在学校前面穿过那条繁忙的马路时要小心。

crossing.example: Please wait for the green light before you walk across the crossing.
crossing.exampleZh: 过人行横道前请等绿灯。

crossroads.example: Our company is at a crossroads and must decide its future soon.
crossroads.exampleZh: 我们公司正处于重大抉择关头，必须尽快决定未来的方向。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered outside the station to wait for the team.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在车站外等候队伍。

crowded.example: The bus was so crowded that I could not find a seat.
crowded.exampleZh: 公交车非常拥挤，我找不到座位。

crown.example: The queen wore a beautiful gold crown at the big ceremony.
crown.exampleZh: 女王在盛大的典礼上戴着一顶美丽的金冠。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a little dog alone in the cold rain.
cruel.exampleZh: 把一只小狗独自留在冰冷的雨中是很残忍的。

cruelty.example: The cruelty of the old king made the whole country afraid of him.
cruelty.exampleZh: 老国王的残暴让全国上下都害怕他。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she dropped her toy on the floor.
cry.exampleZh: 婴儿把玩具掉到地上时开始哭了起来。

cube.example: The teacher gave each student a small wooden cube for the math game.
cube.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生一个用于数学游戏的小木块。

cuisine.example: French cuisine is famous all over the world for its rich sauces.
cuisine.exampleZh: 法国菜因其浓郁的酱汁而闻名世界。

culture.example: I like learning about the culture of other countries.
culture.exampleZh: 我喜欢了解其他国家的文化。

cup.example: She poured hot tea into a clean cup on the table.
cup.exampleZh: 她把热茶倒进桌上的一个干净杯子里。

cupboard.example: The cups are in the cupboard above the sink.
cupboard.exampleZh: 杯子在水槽上方的橱柜里。

cure.example: The new drug can cure this disease, but it takes time.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药能治愈这种病，但需要时间。

curious.example: The curious child asked many simple questions about the stars.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的孩子问了许多关于星星的简单问题。

currency.example: The dollar is the main currency used in that country.
currency.exampleZh: 美元是那个国家使用的主要货币。

current.example: The current in the river is strong, so we should not swim here.
current.exampleZh: 河水的水流很急，所以我们不应该在这里游泳。

curse.example: The old woman began to curse loudly when the boys broke her window.
curse.exampleZh: 男孩们打破了她的窗户，老妇人便开始大声咒骂。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning sun into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road curves to the left after the bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 过了桥后，这条路向左弯曲。

cushion.example: She put a soft cushion behind her back to sit more comfortably.
cushion.exampleZh: 她在背后垫了一个软靠垫，好坐得更舒服一些。

custom.example: It is the custom here to eat rice at every meal.
custom.exampleZh: 这里的习惯是每餐都吃米饭。

customer.example: The shop always gives its customers a small gift at Christmas.
customer.exampleZh: 这家商店在圣诞节总是送给顾客一份小礼物。

customs.example: You must show your passport at customs before you leave the airport.
customs.exampleZh: 离开机场前，你必须在海关出示护照。

cut.example: She cut the paper into small pieces for the art class.
cut.exampleZh: 她把纸剪成小块，用于美术课。

cycle.example: The water cycle moves water from the sea to the sky and back again.
cycle.exampleZh: 水循环把水从海洋带到天空，再回到海洋。

daily.example: Reading the news in the daily paper helps me start my morning.
daily.exampleZh: 读日报上的新闻能帮我开启一天的生活。

dairy.example: The small dairy sells fresh milk and cheese to people in the village.
dairy.exampleZh: 这家小乳制品店向村里的人出售新鲜牛奶和奶酪。

damage.example: The storm did serious damage to many houses in the small town.
damage.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给小镇上的许多房屋造成了严重损害。

damp.example: My clothes still feel damp because I left them outside in the rain.
damp.exampleZh: 我的衣服还是潮潮的，因为我把它们落在外面淋了雨。

dance.example: We like to dance together in the park every Sunday morning.
dance.exampleZh: 我们喜欢每周日早上一起在公园跳舞。

danger.example: The old bridge is in danger of falling down after the flood.
danger.exampleZh: 洪水过后，这座旧桥有倒塌的危险。

dangerous.example: It is dangerous to swim in this river alone.
dangerous.exampleZh: 独自在这条河里游泳很危险。

dare.example: I dare you to tell your teacher the truth about the broken window.
dare.exampleZh: 我敢打赌你不敢把打破窗户的事实告诉老师。

dark.example: The room was very dark, so we turned on a small light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间很黑，所以我们打开了一盏小灯。

data.example: The scientists collected a lot of data for their new study.
data.exampleZh: 科学家们为他们的新研究收集了大量数据。

date.example: Please write the date on the top of your paper before class starts.
date.exampleZh: 请在课前把日期写在试卷的顶部。

daughter.example: My daughter likes to draw pictures of our cat.
daughter.exampleZh: 我女儿喜欢画我们家的猫。

dawn.example: We left the house at dawn and walked to the quiet lake.
dawn.exampleZh: 我们黎明时离开家，走到了安静的湖边。

day.example: I work eight hours a day from Monday to Friday.
day.exampleZh: 我从周一到周五每天工作八小时。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead and has no leaves.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树已经死了，没有叶子了。

deaf.example: My grandfather is deaf in one ear, so we speak loudly to him.
deaf.exampleZh: 我的祖父一只耳朵聋了，所以我们跟他说话很大声。

deal.example: We made a deal with the local farmers to buy fresh vegetables every week.
deal.exampleZh: 我们与当地农民达成协议，每周购买新鲜蔬菜。

dear.example: My dear friend gave me a beautiful book for my birthday.
dear.exampleZh: 我亲爱的朋友在我生日时送了我一本漂亮的书。

death.example: His death made everyone in the small town very sad.
death.exampleZh: 他的死让小镇上的每个人都十分悲痛。

debate.example: The students had a long debate about the new school rules.
debate.exampleZh: 学生们就新的校规进行了长时间的辩论。

debt.example: He still has a large debt to pay off this year.
debt.exampleZh: 他今年还有一大笔债务要还清。

decade.example: The town has changed a lot over the past decade.
decade.exampleZh: 这个小镇在过去十年里变化很大。

decide.example: We must decide where to go for lunch today.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须决定今天去哪里吃午饭。

decision.example: She made a quick decision to take the early train home.
decision.exampleZh: 她很快做出决定，坐早班火车回家。

declare.example: The teacher declared that the test would be on Friday.
declare.exampleZh: 老师宣布考试将在星期五进行。

decline.example: Sales began to decline slowly after the busy summer season ended.
decline.exampleZh: 繁忙的夏季结束后，销售额开始缓慢下降。

decorate.example: We decorate the living room with flowers and lights every New Year.
decorate.exampleZh: 每年新年我们都会用鲜花和彩灯装饰客厅。

decoration.example: The decoration on the Christmas tree is very beautiful.
decoration.exampleZh: 圣诞树上的装饰品非常漂亮。

decrease.example: The number of cars on the road will decrease next year.
decrease.exampleZh: 明年路上的汽车数量将会减少。

deep.example: The lake is very deep and the water looks dark blue.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖很深，水看起来是深蓝色的。

deer.example: We saw a young deer drinking water by the river this morning.
deer.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一只小鹿在河边喝水。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and finally defeated the strong team from the next town.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，最终击败了邻镇的那支强队。

defend.example: The soldiers will defend the small town from attack.
defend.exampleZh: 士兵们将保卫这个小镇，抵御进攻。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we can make any plans.
definite.exampleZh: 我们需要一个明确的答复，然后才能制定任何计划。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 我星期六晚上一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the word before the test.
definition.exampleZh: 老师在考试前对那个单词给出了清晰的定义。

delay.example: Heavy rain may delay our flight by two hours today.
delay.exampleZh: 大雨可能会使我们的航班今天延误两个小时。

delete.example: Please delete the old files from your computer before you leave.
delete.exampleZh: 请你离开前把电脑里的旧文件删除。

deliberately.example: She deliberately left the door open so the cat could come in.
deliberately.exampleZh: 她故意把门开着，好让猫能进来。

delicate.example: The delicate glass cup broke when it fell off the table.
delicate.exampleZh: 那个精致的玻璃杯从桌上掉下来时碎了。

delicious.example: This apple pie is very delicious, and my children love it.
delicious.exampleZh: 这个苹果派非常美味，我的孩子们很喜欢它。

delight.example: The children laughed with delight when they saw the new puppy.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到新小狗时高兴地笑了。

deliver.example: The postman will deliver the letters to your house tomorrow morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 邮递员明天早上会把信送到你家。

demand.example: The workers demand better pay and safer working conditions.
demand.exampleZh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people can choose their leaders by voting.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主国家，人们可以通过投票选举领导人。

democratic.example: The country held a democratic election last year.
democratic.exampleZh: 这个国家去年举行了一次民主选举。

demonstrate.example: The teacher used a simple experiment to demonstrate how water becomes ice.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的实验来演示水是如何变成冰的。

deny.example: She did not deny that she had made a mistake.
deny.exampleZh: 她没有否认自己犯了错误。

depart.example: The last train will depart from the station at nine tonight.
depart.exampleZh: 末班列车今晚九点从车站出发。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a small company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司的销售部工作。

depend.example: Whether we go out tomorrow will depend on the weather.
depend.exampleZh: 我们明天是否出去将取决于天气。

dependent.example: Children are still dependent on their parents for food and money.
dependent.exampleZh: 孩子们在食物和金钱上仍然依赖父母。

depth.example: The depth of the lake is about twenty metres.
depth.exampleZh: 这个湖的深度大约是二十米。

describe.example: Can you describe your new teacher in a few words?
describe.exampleZh: 你能用几句话描述一下你的新老师吗？

description.example: Please give me a short description of the man you saw last night.
description.exampleZh: 请简要描述一下你昨晚看到的那个男人。

desert.example: They left the small town and drove into the hot desert.
desert.exampleZh: 他们离开了小镇，开车驶入炎热的沙漠。

deserve.example: Good teachers deserve respect from all their students.
deserve.exampleZh: 好老师值得所有学生的尊重。

design.example: She will design a simple garden for the new house.
design.exampleZh: 她将为新房子设计一个简单的花园。

desirable.example: A quiet room is desirable when you study for an exam.
desirable.exampleZh: 备考时，一个安静的房间是很理想的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well.
desire.exampleZh: 她有一个学好英语的强烈愿望。

desk.example: There are some books and a small lamp on my desk.
desk.exampleZh: 我的书桌上有一些书和一盏小台灯。

desperate.example: He was desperate for money, so he took any job he could find.
desperate.exampleZh: 他急需用钱，所以任何能找到的工作他都接。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, we still went to school this morning.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，我们今天早上还是去上学了。

dessert.example: We shared a sweet dessert after dinner at the small restaurant.
dessert.exampleZh: 我们在那家小餐馆吃完晚饭后分享了一份甜点。

destination.example: Our final destination is a small town near the sea.
destination.exampleZh: 我们最终的目的地是海边的一座小镇。

destroy.example: The big fire destroyed the old house near the river last night.
destroy.exampleZh: 昨晚大火烧毁了河边的那座老房子。

destruction.example: The storm caused great destruction in the small village.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场风暴给这个小村庄造成了巨大的破坏。

detail.example: She checked every detail of the plan before the meeting.
detail.exampleZh: 开会前她检查了计划的每一个细节。

detective.example: The detective looked carefully at the room and found an important clue.
detective.exampleZh: 侦探仔细查看了房间，发现了一条重要线索。

determine.example: The weather will determine whether we go to the beach tomorrow.
determine.exampleZh: 天气将决定我们明天是否去海滩。

develop.example: Small towns can develop into busy cities over time.
develop.exampleZh: 小镇随着时间推移可以发展成繁忙的城市。

development.example: The development of new technology has changed our daily lives.
development.exampleZh: 新技术的发展改变了我们的日常生活。

devote.example: She devotes most of her free time to helping old people.
devote.exampleZh: 她把大部分空闲时间都用于帮助老人。

devotion.example: Her devotion to the children made her a much loved teacher.
devotion.exampleZh: 她对孩子们的关爱使她成为一位深受爱戴的老师。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board to explain the water cycle.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一张简单的示意图来解释水循环。

dial.example: She dialed the wrong number and had to call again.
dial.exampleZh: 她拨错了号码，只好再打一次。

dialogue.example: The two countries began a dialogue to solve the trade problem.
dialogue.exampleZh: 两国开始对话以解决贸易问题。

diamond.example: She wore a beautiful diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在派对上手指上戴着一枚漂亮的钻戒。

diary.example: She writes in her diary every night before she goes to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

dictionary.example: I often look up new English words in my dictionary after class.
dictionary.exampleZh: 我经常在课后用我的词典查新的英语单词。

die.example: Many old trees die in the dry summer.
die.exampleZh: 许多老树在干燥的夏天枯死。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and daily exercise are very important.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说健康的饮食和每天锻炼非常重要。

differ.example: My opinion may differ from yours, but we can still be friends.
differ.exampleZh: 我的意见可能与你的不同，但我们仍然可以做朋友。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two sisters in height.
difference.exampleZh: 这两姐妹在身高上有很大的差异。

different.example: My sister and I have very different tastes in music and clothes.
different.exampleZh: 我和姐姐在音乐和衣服方面的品味非常不同。

difficult.example: This math problem is difficult, so I need more time.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题很难，所以我需要更多时间。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty finding the right bus to the airport.
difficulty.exampleZh: 我找到去机场的正确公交车有些困难。

dig.example: The workers had to dig a deep hole for the new tree.
dig.exampleZh: 工人们得为新树挖一个深坑。

digest.example: It takes time to digest all the new information from the meeting.
digest.exampleZh: 消化会议上所有的新信息需要时间。

digital.example: Many students use digital tools to study at home every day.
digital.exampleZh: 许多学生每天在家使用数字工具学习。

dignity.example: She faced her illness with quiet dignity and never lost her smile.
dignity.exampleZh: 她以平静的尊严面对疾病，从未失去笑容。

dilemma.example: She faced a real dilemma when both job offers came at the same time.
dilemma.exampleZh: 两份工作邀请同时到来，她面临真正的两难境地。

dimension.example: The room's small dimensions make it hard to fit a large table.
dimension.exampleZh: 这个房间尺寸很小，很难放下一张大桌子。

dinner.example: We had dinner with our friends at a small restaurant last night.
dinner.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和朋友们在一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

dinosaur.example: The children were excited to see the big dinosaur in the museum.
dinosaur.exampleZh: 孩子们看到博物馆里的大恐龙很兴奋。

dip.example: She likes to dip her bread in the hot soup.
dip.exampleZh: 她喜欢把面包蘸着热汤吃。

diploma.example: She put her diploma on the wall after she finished school last year.
diploma.exampleZh: 她去年完成学业后就把毕业文凭挂在了墙上。

direct.example: Please give me a direct answer to my simple question.
direct.exampleZh: 请对我的简单问题给我一个直接的回答。

direction.example: Please ask someone for directions if you get lost in the city.
direction.exampleZh: 如果你在城市里迷路了，请向别人问路。

director.example: The director asked the whole team to finish the new film by Friday.
director.exampleZh: 导演要求整个团队在周五前完成这部新电影。

dirt.example: His shoes were covered with dirt after the long walk.
dirt.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，他的鞋上沾满了泥土。

dirty.example: Don't sit on the dirty floor; wash your hands after playing outside.
dirty.exampleZh: 不要坐在地板上，它很脏；在外面玩完后要洗手。

disability.example: His disability does not stop him from living a happy and full life.
disability.exampleZh: 他的残疾并没有阻止他过上幸福而充实的生活。

disadvantage.example: One disadvantage of this plan is that it costs too much money.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个缺点是要花太多钱。

disagree.example: My parents often disagree about which movie we should watch.
disagree.exampleZh: 我父母常常因为该看哪部电影而意见不合。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned grey.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变得灰暗。

disappoint.example: I hope this movie will not disappoint you tonight.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望这部电影今晚不会让你失望。

disaster.example: The storm was a big disaster for the small town.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场风暴对小镇来说是一场大灾难。

disc.example: She put the disc into the computer to save her photos.
disc.exampleZh: 她把光盘放进电脑里以保存她的照片。

discount.example: The store gave me a small discount on the new shoes.
discount.exampleZh: 这家店给我那双新鞋打了一点折扣。

discourage.example: Do not let one small failure discourage you from trying again.
discourage.exampleZh: 不要让一次小小的失败就使你气馁，不再尝试。

discover.example: She was surprised to discover a small cafe near her new office.
discover.exampleZh: 她惊讶地发现新办公室附近有一家小咖啡馆。

discovery.example: This discovery may help doctors treat sick children in poor countries.
discovery.exampleZh: 这一发现可能有助于医生治疗贫困国家的患病儿童。

discriminate.example: We must not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
discriminate.exampleZh: 我们绝不能因为肤色而歧视他人。

discuss.example: We will discuss the plan after lunch in the meeting room.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们午饭后在会议室讨论这个计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about our travel plans last night.
discussion.exampleZh: 昨晚我们关于旅行计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.example: The doctor said this disease is easy to treat if found early.
disease.exampleZh: 医生说这种病如果发现得早是容易治疗的。

dish.example: She put the hot soup in a large white dish on the table.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在一个大白盘里，放在桌上。

disk.example: She saved the photos on a disk and put it in her bag.
disk.exampleZh: 她把照片保存到一张磁盘上，然后把它放进了包里。

dislike.example: Many children dislike eating vegetables, but they like fruit very much.
dislike.exampleZh: 很多孩子不喜欢吃蔬菜，但他们很喜欢水果。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers because they were always late.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名工人，因为他们总是迟到。

distance.example: The distance between our two houses is only a short walk.
distance.exampleZh: 我们两家之间的距离只需走一小段路。

distant.example: He lives in a distant city and rarely visits his family.
distant.exampleZh: 他住在一座遥远的城市，很少回家看望家人。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between these two kinds of tea.
distinct.exampleZh: 这两种茶之间有一个明显的区别。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look so similar.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们看起来太像了。

distribute.example: Teachers distribute the new books to all students in the classroom.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师在教室里把新书分发给所有学生。

district.example: Our school is in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 我们学校位于河边一个安静的区。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间里学习时请不要打扰我。

dive.example: He likes to dive into the pool on hot summer days.
dive.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏日里，他喜欢跳进泳池。

diverse.example: Our school has students from diverse countries and cultures around the world.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们学校有来自世界各地不同国家和文化背景的学生。

divide.example: Please divide the cake into eight equal pieces for the children.
divide.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕分成八等份给孩子们。

division.example: The teacher made a fair division of the work among the students.
division.exampleZh: 老师把工作公平地分配给了学生们。

do.example: What do you do on weekends when the weather is nice?
do.exampleZh: 天气好的周末你做什么？

doctor.example: My doctor told me to drink more water and get more rest.
doctor.exampleZh: 我的医生让我多喝水、多休息。

document.example: Please keep all your documents in a safe place at home.
document.exampleZh: 请把你所有的证件都放在家里安全的地方。

dog.example: My dog runs to the door every time the bell rings.
dog.exampleZh: 每次门铃响，我的狗都会跑到门口。

doll.example: The little girl hugs her doll and smiles at her mother.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩抱着她的洋娃娃，对妈妈微笑。

dollar.example: I only have one dollar in my pocket today.
dollar.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一美元。

domestic.example: She uses domestic water and electricity every day at home.
domestic.exampleZh: 她每天在家里使用家庭用水和电。

donate.example: Many people donate blood to help sick children in the hospital.
donate.exampleZh: 许多人献血来帮助医院里生病的孩子。

door.example: Please close the door quietly when you leave the room tonight.
door.exampleZh: 今晚离开房间时请轻轻关上门。

doorway.example: She stood in the doorway and waited for the rain to stop.

dormitory.example: My dormitory room is on the third floor and has two windows.
dormitory.exampleZh: 我的宿舍房间在三楼，有两扇窗户。

dot.example: There is a small red dot in the middle of the white paper.
dot.exampleZh: 白纸中间有一个小红点。

double.example: The price of this room is double what we paid last year.
double.exampleZh: 这个房间的价格是我们去年支付的两倍。

doubt.example: I doubt that he will come to the meeting on time today.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今天不会准时来参加会议。

down.example: The cat climbed down the tree and ran across the green grass.
down.exampleZh: 那只猫从树上爬下来，跑过了绿色的草地。

download.example: I need to download the new app before my trip tomorrow.
download.exampleZh: 我需要在明天旅行前下载这个新应用。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs near the front door this morning.
downstairs.exampleZh: 今天早上我把包落在楼下前门附近了。

downtown.example: My family went downtown to buy some new clothes for the winter.
downtown.exampleZh: 我家人去市中心买了一些过冬的新衣服。

dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs and some bread at the small shop.
dozen.exampleZh: 她在那家小商店买了一打鸡蛋和一些面包。

draft.example: She wrote a first draft of the report before the meeting.
draft.exampleZh: 她在会议前写了报告的第一稿。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the floor.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板。

draw.example: She can draw a small horse with just a pencil.
draw.exampleZh: 她只用一支铅笔就能画出一匹小马。

dream.example: I often dream about flying over the sea and seeing new places.
dream.exampleZh: 我常常梦见飞越海洋，看到新的地方。

dress.example: She wears a beautiful red dress to the party every year.
dress.exampleZh: 她每年都穿一条漂亮的红色连衣裙去参加聚会。

drill.example: The teacher asked us to drill the new words before the test.
drill.exampleZh: 老师让我们在考试前操练这些新单词。

drink.example: Please drink more water every day because your body needs it.
drink.exampleZh: 请每天多喝水，因为你的身体需要水。

drive.example: She drives her children to school every morning.
drive.exampleZh: 她每天早上开车送孩子们上学。

driver.example: The driver stopped the car in front of the small hotel.
driver.exampleZh: 司机把车停在了小旅馆前面。

drop.example: A few drops of rain fell on the window, so I closed it.
drop.exampleZh: 几滴雨落在窗户上，所以我把窗户关上了。

drown.example: The loud music drowned out what she was saying to me.
drown.exampleZh: 嘈杂的音乐淹没了她对我说的话。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help him sleep at night.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药，帮助他晚上入睡。

drum.example: He played the drum with his hands at the school concert.
drum.exampleZh: 他在学校音乐会上用手打鼓。

drunk.example: He was too drunk to drive his car home last night.
drunk.exampleZh: 他昨晚醉得没法开车回家。

dry.example: The hot sun will dry your wet clothes very quickly.
dry.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳会很快把你的湿衣服晒干。

duck.example: The duck quickly lowered its head to avoid the low branch.
duck.exampleZh: 那只鸭子迅速低下头，躲开了低矮的树枝。

due.example: The rent is due on the first day of each month.
due.exampleZh: 房租在每月的第一天到期。

dull.example: The long meeting was so dull that I almost fell asleep.
dull.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议太枯燥了，我差点睡着。

dumpling.example: My mother makes dumpling soup for us every Sunday morning.
dumpling.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都给我们做饺子汤。

during.example: I fell asleep during the movie last night.
during.exampleZh: 昨晚看电影的时候我睡着了。

dusk.example: The sky turns orange and red at dusk.
dusk.exampleZh: 黄昏时天空变成橙色和红色。

dust.example: The old books on the shelf are covered with thick dust.
dust.exampleZh: 书架上的旧书上积满了厚厚的灰尘。

dusty.example: The old books on the shelf are dusty and hard to read.
dusty.exampleZh: 书架上的旧书满是灰尘，难以阅读。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dvd.example: I bought a new DVD of my favorite movie yesterday.
dvd.exampleZh: 我昨天买了一张我最喜欢的电影的新DVD影碟。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic music scene that attracts many young people.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这座城市有着充满活力的音乐氛围，吸引了很多年轻人。

dynasty.example: The Tang dynasty is famous for its poetry and art.
dynasty.exampleZh: 唐朝以其诗歌和艺术而闻名。

eagle.example: A large eagle flew over the mountain and looked for food.
eagle.exampleZh: 一只大鹰飞过山峦，寻找食物。

ear.example: She whispered the secret into my ear so no one else could hear.
ear.exampleZh: 她在我耳边低声说出这个秘密，这样别人就听不到了。

early.example: She wakes up early every morning to catch the first bus.
early.exampleZh: 她每天早上很早起床去赶第一班公交车。

earn.example: She works hard to earn money for her family.
earn.exampleZh: 她努力工作为家人挣钱。

earth.example: The earth turns around the sun once every year.
earth.exampleZh: 地球每年绕太阳转一圈。

earthquake.example: The big earthquake last night broke many old houses and roads in our town.
earthquake.exampleZh: 昨晚的大地震毁坏了我们镇上的许多老房子和道路。

ease.example: A good teacher can ease the pressure on students and help them learn with ease.
ease.exampleZh: 好老师能减轻学生的压力，并帮助他们轻松地学习。

east.example: The sun rises in the east every morning and gives us light.
east.exampleZh: 太阳每天早晨从东方升起，给我们带来光明。

eastern.example: The eastern part of the city has many small shops and quiet streets.
eastern.exampleZh: 这座城市的东部地区有许多小商店和安静的街道。

easy.example: This test is easy, so you can finish it quickly.
easy.exampleZh: 这次测试很容易，所以你能很快完成。

eat.example: We usually eat dinner together at home and talk about our day.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常在家一起吃晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

echo.example: The sound of my voice came back as an echo from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 我的声音从空荡的大厅里传回来，变成了回声。

economy.example: A strong economy helps create more jobs for people in every town.
economy.exampleZh: 强劲的经济有助于为每个城镇的人们创造更多就业机会。

edge.example: She sat on the edge of the bed and slowly put on her shoes.
edge.exampleZh: 她坐在床边，慢慢地穿上鞋子。

education.example: Education helps people build a better life and support their families.
education.exampleZh: 教育帮助人们创造更好的生活并养家糊口。

effect.example: The new law had a big effect on small businesses in our town.
effect.exampleZh: 这项新法律对我们镇上的小企业产生了很大影响。

effective.example: The new medicine is very effective against this common cold.
effective.exampleZh: 这种新药对治疗这种普通感冒非常有效。

effort.example: It took a lot of effort to finish the work on time.
effort.exampleZh: 按时完成这项工作需要付出很大的努力。

egg.example: I eat one egg every morning before I go to work.
egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前吃一个鸡蛋。

eight.example: My sister is eight years old and she loves to draw.
eight.exampleZh: 我妹妹八岁，她喜欢画画。

either.example: You can take either road, but neither one is very short.
either.exampleZh: 两条路你走哪条都行，但哪条都不太近。

elder.example: You should listen to your elder brother and respect your elders.
elder.exampleZh: 你应该听哥哥的话，并且尊敬长辈。

elect.example: The class will elect a new leader next week.
elect.exampleZh: 班级下周将选举一位新班长。

election.example: The people will vote in the election next week.
election.exampleZh: 人们将在下周的选举中投票。

electric.example: This electric car is quiet and easy to drive in the city.
electric.exampleZh: 这辆电动汽车很安静，在城市里开起来也很轻松。

electricity.example: Our home uses less electricity when we turn off the lights.
electricity.exampleZh: 我们关灯时，家里用的电就更少。

electronic.example: This electronic dictionary helps students learn new English words quickly.
electronic.exampleZh: 这本电子词典帮助学生快速学习新的英语单词。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant dress to the party last night.
elegant.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条优雅的连衣裙去参加聚会。

elephant.example: The elephant walked slowly to the river and drank some water.
elephant.exampleZh: 大象慢慢走到河边，喝了些水。

elevator.example: We took the elevator to the tenth floor because the stairs were too slow.
elevator.exampleZh: 我们乘电梯到了十楼，因为走楼梯太慢了。

else.example: Is there anything else you want to say before we leave?
else.exampleZh: 在我们离开之前，你还有别的什么要说吗？

embarrass.example: Please do not embarrass me in front of my new friends.
embarrass.exampleZh: 请不要在我的新朋友面前让我难堪。

embassy.example: The new embassy is near the river, and many people work there every day.
embassy.exampleZh: 新大使馆在河边，每天有很多人在那里工作。

embrace.example: She gave her old friend a warm embrace at the airport.
embrace.exampleZh: 她在机场给了老朋友一个温暖的拥抱。

emerge.example: New problems emerge when the old rules no longer work.
emerge.exampleZh: 当旧规则不再起作用时，新的问题就会出现。

emergency.example: Please call this number in an emergency and someone will help you.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况请拨打这个号码，会有人帮助你。

emission.example: The new law aims to cut the emission of harmful gases from factories.
emission.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在减少工厂有害气体的排放。

emotion.example: She could not hide her emotion when she heard the good news.
emotion.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她无法掩饰自己的情绪。

emotional.example: She became very emotional when she said goodbye to her old friends.
emotional.exampleZh: 她和老朋友告别时变得非常激动。

emperor.example: The emperor lived in a large palace with his family.
emperor.exampleZh: 皇帝和他的家人住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

emphasis.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on reading every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 我们老师非常强调每天阅读。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师常常强调每天阅读的重要性。

empire.example: The old empire was very large and had many rich cities.
empire.exampleZh: 这个古老帝国幅员辽阔，拥有许多富庶的城市。

employ.example: The company plans to employ more workers next year.
employ.exampleZh: 公司计划明年雇用更多工人。

employee.example: Every employee must wear a name badge at work.
employee.exampleZh: 每位员工上班时都必须佩戴姓名牌。

employer.example: Her employer lets her work from home on Fridays.
employer.exampleZh: 她的雇主允许她每周五在家工作。

empty.example: The old house was empty, so we cleaned it and moved in.
empty.exampleZh: 那栋老房子是空的，所以我们打扫干净后搬了进去。

enable.example: This new app will enable students to learn English more easily.
enable.exampleZh: 这个新应用将使学生能够更轻松地学习英语。

encourage.example: Our teacher always encourages us to ask questions in class.
encourage.exampleZh: 我们的老师总是鼓励我们在课堂上提问。

end.example: The end of the movie was sad, so we all cried.
end.exampleZh: 电影的结局很悲伤，所以我们都哭了。

ending.example: The story has a happy ending that everyone enjoyed.
ending.exampleZh: 这个故事有一个大家都喜欢的圆满结局。

endless.example: The road through the desert seemed endless to the tired travelers.
endless.exampleZh: 对疲惫的旅行者来说，穿过沙漠的这条路似乎没有尽头。

enemy.example: He has no enemies at school because he is always kind to others.
enemy.exampleZh: 他在学校里没有敌人，因为他总是对别人很友善。

energetic.example: My grandfather is still very energetic and works in his garden every morning.
energetic.exampleZh: 我爷爷仍然精力充沛，每天早上都在花园里干活。

energy.example: Solar energy is clean and can power our homes for many years.
energy.exampleZh: 太阳能很清洁，可以为我们的家庭供电很多年。

engage.example: She likes to engage in sports after school with her friends.
engage.exampleZh: 她喜欢放学后和朋友们一起参加体育运动。

engine.example: The engine of the old car made a loud noise this morning.
engine.exampleZh: 今天早上，那辆旧汽车的发动机发出了很大的噪音。

engineer.example: My father is an engineer and he designs small machines for a local factory.
engineer.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名工程师，他为当地一家工厂设计小型机器。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，我很喜欢在公园里看书。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the small garden behind our house this spring.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们打算今年春天把屋后的小花园扩大。

enough.example: We have enough food and water for everyone in the group.
enough.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供群体里的每个人使用。

ensure.example: We must ensure that all the doors are locked before we leave.
ensure.exampleZh: 我们离开前必须确保所有的门都锁好了。

enter.example: Please knock before you enter the room and close the door quietly.
enter.exampleZh: 进房间前请先敲门，然后轻轻把门关上。

enterprise.example: She started a small enterprise with her brother last year.
enterprise.exampleZh: 去年她和弟弟一起创办了一家小型企业。

entertain.example: They often entertain friends at home on weekends.
entertain.exampleZh: 他们周末常在家招待朋友。

entertainment.example: Movies and music are popular forms of entertainment for many families.
entertainment.exampleZh: 电影和音乐是许多家庭常见的娱乐形式。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for the new project made everyone work harder.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对这项新项目的热情让每个人都更加努力。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning her small house from top to bottom.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天时间把她的小房子从上到下打扫了一遍。

entrance.example: We waited for our friends at the main entrance of the school.
entrance.exampleZh: 我们在学校正门等朋友们。

entry.example: The main entry to the building is locked after ten at night.
entry.exampleZh: 这栋大楼的主入口在晚上十点后上锁。

envelope.example: She sealed the letter in a white envelope and mailed it.
envelope.exampleZh: 她把信封在一个白色信封里，然后寄了出去。

environment.example: We should all work together to protect the environment for future generations.
environment.exampleZh: 我们都应该共同努力，为子孙后代保护环境。

envy.example: She felt envy when her friend won the prize.
envy.exampleZh: 她的朋友获奖时，她感到嫉妒。

equal.example: All students should have equal chances to learn and to succeed.
equal.exampleZh: 所有学生都应有平等的学习与成功机会。

equality.example: The two teams played with equality and respect, and nobody felt left out.
equality.exampleZh: 两支队伍以平等和尊重的态度比赛，没有人感到被冷落。

equip.example: This training will equip you with the basic skills you need.
equip.exampleZh: 这项培训将使你具备所需的基本技能。

equipment.example: The workers need new equipment to finish the job safely.
equipment.exampleZh: 工人们需要新设备来安全地完成这项工作。

eraser.example: Please use an eraser to clean the words off the blackboard.
eraser.exampleZh: 请用黑板擦把黑板上的字擦掉。

error.example: The small error in my spelling caused a big problem.
error.exampleZh: 我的拼写中的一个小错误造成了一个大问题。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the people left the area.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山随时可能喷发，所以人们离开了这一地区。

escape.example: The cat tried to escape through the small open window.
escape.exampleZh: 那只猫试图从那扇开着的小窗户逃出去。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橙子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer holiday in the countryside.
essay.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于她在乡下暑假的短文。

europe.example: Many people travel to Europe every summer to see its old cities.
europe.exampleZh: 许多人每年夏天去欧洲看古老的城市。

european.example: My European friends like to travel to different countries by train.
european.exampleZh: 我的欧洲朋友喜欢坐火车去不同的国家旅行。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate student work at the end of each term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估学生的作业。

eve.example: On the eve of the exam, she reviewed her notes one last time.
eve.exampleZh: 考试前夕，她把笔记最后复习了一遍。

even.example: She did not even say goodbye before she left the office.
even.exampleZh: 她离开办公室前甚至没有说再见。

evening.example: We usually take a walk after dinner in the evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上吃完晚饭后去散步。

event.example: The school sports event was the biggest day of the year.
event.exampleZh: 学校的体育赛事是一年中最重要的日子。

eventually.example: After many tries, he eventually found the key under the old chair.
eventually.exampleZh: 试了很多次之后，他最终在那把旧椅子下面找到了钥匙。

ever.example: Have you ever seen a bigger fish than this one?
ever.exampleZh: 你曾经见过比这条更大的鱼吗？

every.example: Every student in my class has a new English book.
every.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都有一本新英语书。

everybody.example: Everybody in my class likes to play football after school.
everybody.exampleZh: 我们班上每个人都喜欢放学后踢足球。

everyday.example: Reading the news is part of my everyday morning routine.
everyday.exampleZh: 读新闻是我每天早晨的日常习惯。

everyone.example: Everyone in our class likes the new English teacher very much.
everyone.exampleZh: 我们班每个人都非常喜欢这位新英语老师。

everything.example: She told me everything about her trip to Japan last week.
everything.exampleZh: 她把上周去日本旅行的一切都告诉了我。

everywhere.example: There are small shops everywhere in this old town.
everywhere.exampleZh: 这座老城里到处都有小商店。

evidence.example: There is no evidence that he took the money.
evidence.exampleZh: 没有证据表明他拿了那笔钱。

evident.example: It is evident that she works very hard every day.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她每天都非常努力地工作。

evil.example: He did not believe that people are born evil.
evil.exampleZh: 他不相信人天生就是邪恶的。

evolution.example: The evolution of language is a slow and complex process.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变是一个缓慢而复杂的过程。

evolve.example: Languages slowly evolve over time as people use them in new ways.
evolve.exampleZh: 随着人们以新的方式使用语言，语言会随着时间慢慢演变。

exact.example: Please give me the exact time of the meeting tomorrow.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我明天会议的确切时间。

exactly.example: That is exactly what I wanted to say to him.
exactly.exampleZh: 那正是我想对他说的话。

exam.example: I have a math exam tomorrow, so I must study tonight.
exam.exampleZh: 我明天有一场数学考试，所以今晚必须得学习。

examination.example: The doctor gave him a careful examination and said he was fine.
examination.exampleZh: 医生给他做了仔细的检查，说他身体没问题。

examine.example: The doctor will examine her carefully before giving any medicine.
examine.exampleZh: 医生在开药前会仔细检查她的身体。

example.example: Can you give me an example of how to use this word?
example.exampleZh: 你能给我一个例子，说明这个词怎么用吗？

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher, and all her students love her class.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

except.example: Everyone went to the party except Tom, who stayed home to study.
except.exampleZh: 除了汤姆留在家里学习，其他人都去参加聚会了。

exception.example: Everyone must follow the rule, and there is no exception for anyone.
exception.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守这条规则，任何人都没有例外。

exchange.example: We can exchange phone numbers so we can stay in touch.
exchange.exampleZh: 我们可以交换电话号码，以便保持联系。

excite.example: The good news excited all the children in the small town.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息让小镇上所有的孩子都很兴奋。

excited.example: The children were very excited when they saw the big yellow bus.
excited.exampleZh: 孩子们看到那辆黄色的大公交车时非常兴奋。

excitement.example: There was a lot of excitement in the room when the team won.
excitement.exampleZh: 球队获胜时，房间里充满了兴奋的气氛。

exciting.example: The football game last night was very exciting for all of us.
exciting.exampleZh: 昨晚的足球比赛对我们所有人来说都非常刺激。

exclaim.example: She looked at the gift and exclaimed with joy.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看着礼物，高兴地惊叫起来。

exclude.example: The club excludes members who do not pay their fees on time.
exclude.exampleZh: 俱乐部把不按时缴费的会员拒之门外。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late to the meeting today.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我今天开会迟到。

exercise.example: My doctor says I need more exercise to stay healthy.
exercise.exampleZh: 我的医生说为了保持健康，我需要多锻炼。

exhaust.example: The long run exhausted him, and he needed rest soon.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长跑让他精疲力尽，他很快就需要休息。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit many old paintings next month for the public.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将向公众展出许多古老的画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition and saw many beautiful paintings.
exhibition.exampleZh: 我们去看了一个艺术展览，看到了许多美丽的画作。

exist.example: Many old trees exist in this quiet village near the river.
exist.exampleZh: 许多老树存在于这个河边安静的村庄里。

existence.example: Many people question the existence of life on other planets.
existence.exampleZh: 许多人质疑其他星球上是否存在生命。

exit.example: Please use the side exit when you leave the building.
exit.exampleZh: 你离开大楼时请走侧面的出口。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into new markets this year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划今年将业务扩展到新的市场。

expect.example: I expect to see my friends at the party tonight.
expect.exampleZh: 我期待今晚在派对上见到我的朋友们。

expectation.example: She has high expectations for her new job.
expectation.exampleZh: 她对这份新工作抱有很高的期望。

expense.example: The trip was a big expense for our family last year.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行去年对我们家来说是一笔很大的开支。

expensive.example: This watch is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这块手表太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has five years of work experience in the hotel industry.
experience.exampleZh: 她在酒店行业有五年工作经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in the science class today.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们今天在科学课上做了一个简单的实验。

expert.example: She is an expert at fixing old computers and phones.
expert.exampleZh: 她是修理旧电脑和手机的专家。

explain.example: Please explain the rules to me before we start the game.
explain.exampleZh: 请在开始游戏前向我解释一下规则。

explanation.example: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the new word.
explanation.exampleZh: 老师对这个新单词作了清楚的解释。

explode.example: The old car exploded with a loud noise on the busy street.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在繁忙的街道上随着一声巨响爆炸了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by paying them very little.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过支付极低的工资来剥削年轻工人。

explore.example: We plan to explore the old forest near our town this weekend.
explore.exampleZh: 我们计划这个周末去探索我们镇附近的那片古老森林。

export.example: China will export more electric cars to Europe next year.
export.exampleZh: 中国明年将向欧洲出口更多电动汽车。

expose.example: The report exposed serious problems in the local school system.
expose.exampleZh: 这份报告揭露了当地学校系统里的严重问题。

express.example: I want to express my thanks to everyone who helped me today.
express.exampleZh: 我想向今天帮助过我的每一个人表达我的感谢。

expression.example: Her expression changed when she heard the good news.
expression.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时，表情变了。

extend.example: They plan to extend the road to reach the small village next year.
extend.exampleZh: 他们计划明年把这条路延长到那个小村庄。

extra.example: You need to pay extra for the room with a sea view.
extra.exampleZh: 海景房你需要额外付费。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary talent for making people feel welcome.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她有一种非凡的天赋，能让人感到受欢迎。

extreme.example: The weather there is extreme, with very hot summers and freezing winters.
extreme.exampleZh: 那里的天气很极端，夏天非常炎热，冬天极其寒冷。

eye.example: Keep an eye on the children while they play in the garden.
eye.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里玩的时候，看着他们点儿。

fabric.example: The fabric of this old shirt is soft and very comfortable.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件旧衬衫的布料柔软，穿着很舒服。

fabulous.example: We had a fabulous time at the beach last weekend.
fabulous.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

face.example: She washed her face and then faced the cold morning wind.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了把脸，然后面对着清晨的冷风。

facial.example: She washed her facial skin with warm water every morning.
facial.exampleZh: 她每天早上用温水洗脸部的皮肤。

facility.example: The new sports facility has a pool and a large gym.
facility.exampleZh: 新的体育设施有一个游泳池和一个大健身房。

fact.example: It is a fact that she works very hard every day.
fact.exampleZh: 她每天工作非常努力，这是一个事实。

factor.example: Money was an important factor in his decision to move to another city.
factor.exampleZh: 钱是他决定搬到另一个城市的一个重要因素。

factory.example: My father works in a car factory near our home town.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家乡附近的一家汽车工厂工作。

faculty.example: The faculty of this school meets every Friday to discuss student progress.
faculty.exampleZh: 这所学校的全体教员每周五开会讨论学生的进步。

fade.example: The old blue curtains began to fade after many years in the sun.
fade.exampleZh: 那些旧的蓝色窗帘在阳光下晒了很多年后开始褪色。

fail.example: If you do not study, you will fail the test tomorrow.
fail.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，明天考试你就会不及格。

failure.example: The failure of the old machine caused a long delay at work.
failure.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的故障导致工作中出现了长时间的延误。

faint.example: The old man heard a faint sound and then fainted in the room.
faint.exampleZh: 老人听到一个微弱的声音，然后昏倒在房间里。

fair.example: It is not fair to blame him for the mistake.
fair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪他是不公平的。

fairly.example: She treats all her students fairly, and they all like her class.
fairly.exampleZh: 她公平地对待所有学生，他们都很喜欢她的课。

fairy.example: The little girl believes a fairy lives in the garden behind her house.
fairy.exampleZh: 那个小女孩相信她家屋后的花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.example: Her faith in her friends helped her through the hard times.
faith.exampleZh: 她对朋友的信任帮助她度过了艰难时期。

faithful.example: A faithful friend will always tell you the truth, even when it is hard.
faithful.exampleZh: 一个忠诚的朋友总会告诉你真相，即使这很难。

fake.example: He tried to fake his signature on the school form.
fake.exampleZh: 他试图在学校表格上伪造自己的签名。

fall.example: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn, and people often fall on wet stairs.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天树叶从树上落下，人们也常在湿滑的楼梯上跌倒。

false.example: This sentence is false because he never told me the truth.
false.exampleZh: 这句话是错误的，因为他从未告诉我真相。

fame.example: He did not care about fame and just wanted to help people.
fame.exampleZh: 他不在乎名声，只想帮助别人。

familiar.example: I am familiar with this street because I walk here every day.
familiar.exampleZh: 我对这条街很熟悉，因为我每天都走这里。

family.example: My family lives in a small house near the park.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人住在公园附近的一所小房子里。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful old bridges and quiet parks.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的古老桥梁和安静的公园而闻名。

fan.example: The fan on my desk keeps me cool while I study.
fan.exampleZh: 我学习时，桌上的风扇让我保持凉爽。

fancy.example: She wore a fancy dress to the party and everyone liked it.
fancy.exampleZh: 她穿了一条花哨的连衣裙去参加聚会，大家都很喜欢。

fantastic.example: The view from the top of the mountain was fantastic.
fantastic.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色美极了。

fantasy.example: As a child, she lived in a fantasy world full of dragons and magic.
fantasy.exampleZh: 小时候，她生活在一个充满龙与魔法的幻想世界里。

far.example: The school is not far from my home, so I walk there every day.
far.exampleZh: 学校离我家不远，所以我每天步行去那里。

fare.example: The bus fare is cheap, so I take the bus to work.
fare.exampleZh: 公交车费很便宜，所以我坐公交车上班。

farewell.example: We said farewell to our friends at the train station last night.
farewell.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在火车站与朋友们告别。

farm.example: My uncle works on a small farm and grows rice every year.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔在一个小农场工作，每年种水稻。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to feed his animals.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上早起喂他的牲畜。

fascinate.example: The magic show fascinated the children and they talked about it all day.
fascinate.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演让孩子们着迷，他们整天都在谈论它。

fashion.example: She always wears clothes that are in fashion this year.
fashion.exampleZh: 她总是穿今年流行的衣服。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: He runs fast, and his shoes are fast on the track.
fast.exampleZh: 他跑得很快，他的鞋在跑道上也很牢靠。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the car starts moving.
fasten.exampleZh: 汽车开动前，请系好安全带。

fat.example: This fat cat sleeps on the sofa all day and eats a lot.
fat.exampleZh: 这只胖猫整天睡在沙发上，还吃得很多。

fatal.example: A small mistake in the plan can be fatal to the whole team.
fatal.exampleZh: 计划中的一个小错误可能对整个团队来说是致命的。

fate.example: She believed it was her fate to become a doctor.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信成为医生是她的命运。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
father.exampleZh: 去年夏天，父亲教会了我骑自行车。

fault.example: The fault was mine, so I said sorry and fixed the problem.
fault.exampleZh: 过错在我，所以我道了歉并解决了问题。

favour.example: She asked her teacher for a favour and he agreed to help.
favour.exampleZh: 她请老师帮个忙，老师同意帮忙。

favourite.example: This is my favourite book, and I read it every night.
favourite.exampleZh: 这是我最喜爱的书，我每天晚上都读它。

fear.example: She has a great fear of dogs, but she never fears cats.
fear.exampleZh: 她非常怕狗，但她从不害怕猫。

feasible.example: The plan is feasible if we have enough time and money.
feasible.exampleZh: 如果我们有足够的时间和钱，这个计划是可行的。

feast.example: The whole village will feast together at the festival tonight.
feast.exampleZh: 今晚全村人将在节日上一起尽情享用大餐。

feather.example: The bird lost a small feather while flying over the garden.
feather.exampleZh: 那只鸟飞过花园时掉了一根小羽毛。

feature.example: Her best feature is her warm smile, which makes everyone feel welcome.
feature.exampleZh: 她最大的特点是温暖的笑容，这使每个人都感到受欢迎。

february.example: We will visit our grandparents in February when the weather gets warmer.
february.exampleZh: 二月天气变暖时，我们会去看望祖父母。

federal.example: The federal government makes laws that all states must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定的法律所有州都必须遵守。

fee.example: The school charges a small fee for each music lesson.
fee.exampleZh: 学校每节音乐课收取少量费用。

feed.example: She feeds the chickens every morning before she goes to school.
feed.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前去喂鸡。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English homework.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语作业给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel a little tired after work today.
feel.exampleZh: 今天下班后我觉得有点累。

feeling.example: I have a strange feeling that we have met before.
feeling.exampleZh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得我们以前见过面。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who often helps his neighbors.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是个友善的家伙，经常帮助邻居。

female.example: The female doctor helped many sick children in the small village.
female.exampleZh: 这位女医生在小村庄里帮助了许多生病的孩子。

fence.example: The farmer built a wooden fence around his small garden.
fence.exampleZh: 农夫在他的小花园周围建了一道木栅栏。

fertile.example: The soil near the river is very fertile and good for growing vegetables.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边的土壤非常肥沃，很适合种植蔬菜。

festival.example: Every spring our town holds a big music festival in the park.
festival.exampleZh: 每年春天，我们镇都会在公园里举办一场盛大的音乐节。

fetch.example: Please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen.
fetch.exampleZh: 请到厨房给我拿一杯水来。

fever.example: She has a high fever and needs to rest in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 她发高烧，今天需要卧床休息。

few.example: Only a few students came to class early this morning.
few.exampleZh: 今天早上只有几个学生早到了教室。

fibre.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables contain a lot of fibre.
fibre.exampleZh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜含有大量纤维。

field.example: The children are playing football in the big field behind the school.
field.exampleZh: 孩子们正在学校后面的大片场地上踢足球。

fierce.example: The dog looked fierce, but it was actually very friendly to everyone.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只狗看起来很凶猛，但它实际上对每个人都很友好。

fifteen.example: My sister is fifteen years old and she plays basketball every weekend.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，她每个周末都打篮球。

fifth.example: Our team finished fifth in the race last Sunday.
fifth.exampleZh: 我们队伍在上周日的比赛中获得了第五名。

fifty.example: My grandmother has lived in this small town for fifty years.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖母在这个小镇上住了五十年。

fight.example: The two brothers often fight, but they always make up soon after.
fight.exampleZh: 两兄弟经常打架，但他们总是在之后很快就和好。

fighter.example: The brave fighter flew his plane into the sky to protect the city.
fighter.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的战士驾驶飞机飞上天空，保护这座城市。

figure.example: The figure in the report shows how many people moved to the city.
figure.exampleZh: 报告中的数字显示了有多少人搬到了这座城市。

file.example: Please file these papers in the folder and keep the file safe.
file.exampleZh: 请把这些文件归档到文件夹里，并妥善保管这份档案。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water and put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请把杯子装满水，然后放在桌子上。

film.example: They will film a new movie in our town next month.
film.exampleZh: 他们下个月将在我们镇上拍摄一部新电影。

final.example: This is my final answer, and I will not change it.
final.exampleZh: 这是我最终的答案，我不会再改变了。

finally.example: After many tries, she finally passed the driving test.
finally.exampleZh: 经过多次尝试，她终于通过了驾驶考试。

finance.example: The company needs more finance to build a new factory this year.
finance.exampleZh: 公司今年需要更多资金来建一座新工厂。

financial.example: The company faces serious financial problems after losing its biggest customer.
financial.exampleZh: 公司在失去最大的客户后面临严重的财务问题。

find.example: I cannot find my keys anywhere in this room.
find.exampleZh: 我在这房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

finding.example: The new findings show that sleep is important for young children.
finding.exampleZh: 新的研究结果表明睡眠对幼儿很重要。

fine.example: The weather is fine today, so we will go to the park.
fine.exampleZh: 今天天气晴朗，所以我们要去公园。

finger.example: She cut her finger while cutting the bread.
finger.exampleZh: 她切面包时切到了手指。

finish.example: I finish my homework before dinner and then watch TV.
finish.exampleZh: 我在晚饭前完成作业，然后看电视。

fire.example: The fire in the old house burned for three hours last night.
fire.exampleZh: 昨晚那座老房子里的火烧了三个小时。

firefighter.example: The firefighter saved a small cat from the tall tree.
firefighter.exampleZh: 消防队员从大树上救下了一只小猫。

firm.example: She works for a small firm but has a firm belief in her future.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司工作，但对自己的未来有着坚定的信念。

first.example: This is my first time visiting the beautiful city with my family.
first.exampleZh: 这是我第一次和家人一起参观这座美丽的城市。

fish.example: My father likes to fish in the river near our home.
fish.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在我们家附近的河里钓鱼。

fisherman.example: The old fisherman goes out to sea early every morning.
fisherman.exampleZh: 这位老渔民每天早上很早就出海。

fishing.example: My father goes fishing with his friends every Sunday morning.
fishing.exampleZh: 我父亲每周日早上和朋友去钓鱼。

fit.example: These shoes fit me well and they are good for running.
fit.exampleZh: 这双鞋很合脚，而且适合跑步。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 规律运动对你的体能和健康都很重要。

five.example: My sister has five small cats and two big dogs at home.
five.exampleZh: 我姐姐家里有五只小猫和两只大狗。

fix.example: Can you fix my bike before the race starts tomorrow?
fix.exampleZh: 你能在明天比赛开始前把我的自行车修好吗？

flag.example: The national flag flies high above the school building every morning.
flag.exampleZh: 每天早晨，国旗高高飘扬在教学楼上方。

flame.example: The flame from the candle lit up the whole room.
flame.exampleZh: 蜡烛的火焰照亮了整个房间。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the whole sky last night.
flash.exampleZh: 昨晚一道明亮的闪电照亮了整个天空。

flat.example: The land near the river is flat, and they live in a small flat nearby.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的土地很平坦，他们住在附近的一套小公寓里。

flee.example: The thief tried to flee from the police but fell down.
flee.exampleZh: 小偷试图逃离警察，但摔倒了。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was late, so we waited at the airport.
flight.exampleZh: 我们飞往北京的航班延误了，所以我们在机场等候。

float.example: The red boat floats quietly on the calm blue water.
float.exampleZh: 那只红色的小船静静地漂浮在平静的蓝色水面上。

flock.example: A large flock of birds flew over the lake this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早上，一大群鸟飞过了湖面。

flood.example: The flood after the storm destroyed many houses and roads in the village.
flood.exampleZh: 暴风雨后的洪水毁坏了村里的许多房屋和道路。

floor.example: The kitchen floor is wet because someone dropped a glass.
floor.exampleZh: 厨房地板是湿的，因为有人打碎了一个玻璃杯。

flour.example: She put some flour and water in a bowl to make bread.
flour.exampleZh: 她在碗里放了一些面粉和水来做面包。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the small town and past the old bridge.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓地流过小镇，经过那座旧桥。

flower.example: The flower in our garden is very beautiful and smells sweet.
flower.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那朵花非常漂亮，闻起来很香。

flu.example: My brother stayed home from school last week because he had the flu.
flu.exampleZh: 我弟弟上周因为得了流感而待在家里没去上学。

fluent.example: She speaks fluent English because she has lived in Canada for three years.
fluent.exampleZh: 她英语说得很流利，因为她在加拿大住过三年。

fly.example: We can fly to Beijing and see the Great Wall this summer.
fly.exampleZh: 今年夏天我们可以乘飞机去北京看长城。

focus.example: Please focus on your homework and turn off the TV.
focus.exampleZh: 请把注意力集中在作业上，把电视关掉。

fog.example: The thick fog made it hard to see the road ahead.
fog.exampleZh: 浓雾让人很难看清前方的路。

fold.example: Please fold the paper in half and put it in the envelope.
fold.exampleZh: 请把纸对折，然后放进信封里。

folk.example: My grandmother loves folk music, and her family often sings together.
folk.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢民间音乐，她的家人经常一起唱歌。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我会给你指路。

following.example: The following day, we went to the park with my family.
following.exampleZh: 第二天，我们和家人一起去了公园。

food.example: We need to buy enough food for the whole family this weekend.
food.exampleZh: 这个周末我们需要为全家人买足够的食物。

fool.example: Don't be a fool and believe everything he says.
fool.exampleZh: 别当傻瓜，不要相信他说的每一句话。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to go out in such heavy rain.
foolish.exampleZh: 他在这么大的雨里出门，真是太傻了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk up the hill.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的山路上来后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和他的朋友们踢足球。

for.example: I bought a gift for my mother because it is her birthday today.
for.exampleZh: 我给妈妈买了一份礼物，因为今天是她的生日。

forbid.example: My parents forbid me to play computer games on school nights.
forbid.exampleZh: 我父母不许我在上学期间的晚上玩电脑游戏。

force.example: The police had to use force to stop the fighting crowd.
force.exampleZh: 警察不得不使用武力来制止打斗的人群。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check his temperature.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上量体温。

foreign.example: She likes to learn foreign languages and often listens to songs from other countries.
foreign.exampleZh: 她喜欢学习外语，并且经常听其他国家的歌曲。

foreigner.example: Many foreigners come to China to study Chinese and learn about its culture.
foreigner.exampleZh: 许多外国人来中国学习中文并了解中国文化。

forest.example: We walked through the forest and saw many tall trees.
forest.exampleZh: 我们穿过森林，看到了许多高大的树木。

forever.example: I will always remember the happy days we spent together forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我们一起度过的快乐时光。

forge.example: He tried to forge his father's signature on the school letter.
forge.exampleZh: 他试图在学校信件上伪造他父亲的签名。

forget.example: I often forget my keys at home when I leave in a hurry.
forget.exampleZh: 我匆忙出门时经常把钥匙忘在家里。

forgive.example: I hope you can forgive me for being late again today.
forgive.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我今天又迟到了。

fork.example: At the fork in the road, turn left toward the small village.
fork.exampleZh: 在岔路口向左转，朝那个小村庄走。

form.example: Please fill in this form with your name and address.
form.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名和地址。

formal.example: We need to write a formal letter to the school.
formal.exampleZh: 我们需要给学校写一封正式的信。

format.example: The report must follow a strict format before you send it.
format.exampleZh: 这份报告在发送前必须遵循严格的格式。

former.example: My former teacher still lives in our small town.
former.exampleZh: 我以前的老师仍然住在我们的小镇上。

formula.example: The scientist wrote a simple formula on the board for all students.
formula.exampleZh: 科学家在黑板上为所有学生写下一个简单的公式。

forth.example: She stepped forth from the dark room into the bright garden.
forth.exampleZh: 她从黑暗的房间里向前走到明亮的 garden 中。

fortnight.example: We will go to the beach for a fortnight next summer.
fortnight.exampleZh: 明年夏天我们会去海边待两星期。

fortunate.example: I feel fortunate to have such kind friends and a happy family.
fortunate.exampleZh: 有这么多善良的朋友和幸福的家庭，我感到很幸运。

fortune.example: He made a great fortune through hard work and good fortune.
fortune.exampleZh: 他靠努力和好运气赚了一大笔财富。

forty.example: My grandmother lives forty miles away, so we visit her every month.
forty.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在四十英里外，所以我们每个月都去看她。

forward.example: Please move forward slowly and look at the bright signs ahead.
forward.exampleZh: 请慢慢向前走，并看看前面那些明亮的标志。

foster.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
foster.exampleZh: 好老师会培养学生的求知热情。

found.example: They found a small school in the village last year.
found.exampleZh: 他们去年在村里创办了一所小学校。

foundation.example: A good education is the foundation of a happy life.
foundation.exampleZh: 良好的教育是幸福生活的基础。

fountain.example: The children love to play near the fountain in the park.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。

four.example: There are four seasons in a year.

fox.example: The fox ran into the trees before we could see it clearly.
fox.exampleZh: 我们还没来得及看清，那只狐狸就跑进了树林里。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the meeting today.
fraction.exampleZh: 今天只有一小部分学生来参加了会议。

frame.example: They used a wooden frame to build the old house.
frame.exampleZh: 他们用木制框架建造了那座老房子。

framework.example: This framework helps us understand how the parts work together.
framework.exampleZh: 这个框架帮助我们理解各部分如何协同运作。

free.example: The concert is free, and I am free tonight to go with you.
free.exampleZh: 这场音乐会免费，我今晚也有空和你一起去。

freedom.example: Everyone should have the freedom to choose their own path in life.
freedom.exampleZh: 每个人都应该拥有选择自己人生道路的自由。

freeway.example: We drove on the freeway for two hours to visit my grandparents.
freeway.exampleZh: 我们开了两个小时的高速公路去看望我的祖父母。

freeze.example: Water will freeze into ice when the temperature drops below zero.
freeze.exampleZh: 当温度降到零度以下时，水会结冰。

frequency.example: The frequency of trains to the city increases during rush hour.
frequency.exampleZh: 高峰时段开往市里的火车班次频率会增加。

frequent.example: My sister is a frequent visitor to the library near her home.
frequent.exampleZh: 我姐姐经常去她家附近的图书馆。

fresh.example: We bought fresh bread and fruit at the small shop near our house.
fresh.exampleZh: 我们在我家附近的那家小店买了新鲜的面包和水果。

freshman.example: Every freshman must attend the welcome meeting on Monday morning.
freshman.exampleZh: 每位大一新生都必须参加周一上午的欢迎会。

friday.example: We will have a math test next Friday morning.
friday.exampleZh: 我们下星期五上午有一场数学考试。

fridge.example: Please put the milk in the fridge before it gets warm.
fridge.exampleZh: 请把牛奶放进冰箱，以免变热。

friend.example: My best friend often helps me with my homework after school.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友经常在放学后帮我做作业。

friendly.example: The people in my new neighborhood are very friendly to everyone.
friendly.exampleZh: 我新社区里的人对每个人都很友好。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust and honest words.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在信任和诚实的话语之上。

frog.example: A small green frog jumped into the pond near our house.
frog.exampleZh: 一只绿色的小青蛙跳进了我们家附近的池塘里。

from.example: I got a letter from my old friend yesterday.
from.exampleZh: 我昨天收到了我老朋友寄来的一封信。

front.example: There is a small garden in front of our house.
front.exampleZh: 我们家前面有一个小花园。

frontier.example: Space is still a new frontier for scientists and engineers today.
frontier.exampleZh: 太空至今仍是科学家和工程师们的一个新前沿。

frost.example: The grass was white with frost this cold morning.
frost.exampleZh: 这个寒冷的早晨，草地上覆着一层白霜。

frown.example: Her mother frowned when she saw the dirty dishes in the sink.
frown.exampleZh: 她妈妈看到水槽里的脏盘子时皱起了眉头。

fruit.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables are good for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜对你的健康有益。

fruitful.example: The meeting was short but fruitful, and we made three clear plans.
fruitful.exampleZh: 这次会议时间不长但富有成效，我们制定了三项明确的计划。

frustrate.example: The long delay began to frustrate the passengers waiting at the gate.
frustrate.exampleZh: 漫长的延误开始让在登机口等候的乘客感到沮丧。

fry.example: I fry two eggs in the pan every morning.
fry.exampleZh: 我每天早上在平底锅里煎两个鸡蛋。

fuel.example: The car needs fuel before we drive to the city.
fuel.exampleZh: 在我们开车去城里之前，这辆车需要燃料。

fulfill.example: She worked hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of fresh water from the well.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了从井里打来的新鲜水。

fun.example: The party was great fun and everyone laughed all night.
fun.exampleZh: 那次聚会非常好玩，大家整晚都在笑。

function.example: The function of this small button is to turn the machine on.
function.exampleZh: 这个小按钮的功能是启动机器。

fund.example: She put most of her money into a fund for her children's education.
fund.exampleZh: 她把大部分钱存入了一个用于孩子教育的基金。

fundamental.example: Reading is a fundamental skill that every child needs at school.
fundamental.exampleZh: 阅读是每个孩子在学校都需要的一项基本技能。

funeral.example: Many people came to the church for his funeral on a cold morning.
funeral.exampleZh: 在一个寒冷的早晨，许多人来到教堂参加他的葬礼。

funny.example: It is funny that my cat always sleeps in that small box.
funny.exampleZh: 真奇怪，我的猫总是睡在那个小盒子里。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and big green eyes.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白毛和绿色的大眼睛。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new apartment with a table and two chairs.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们将为新公寓配置一张桌子和两把椅子。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 我们上周为客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need more time to study this problem further.
further.exampleZh: 我们需要更多时间来进一步研究这个问题。

furthermore.example: The room is small and clean; furthermore, it is very close to the station.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这个房间又小又干净，此外，它离车站很近。

future.example: She hopes to become a doctor in the future.
future.exampleZh: 她希望将来成为一名医生。

gain.example: He hoped to gain useful experience from his first job.
gain.exampleZh: 他希望从第一份工作中获得有用的经验。

galaxy.example: Our teacher showed us a picture of a large galaxy far away.
galaxy.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张遥远的大星系的图片。

gallery.example: We spent the whole afternoon looking at paintings in the new art gallery.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们整个下午都在新开的美术馆里看画。

gallon.example: I bought two gallons of milk at the store yesterday.
gallon.exampleZh: 我昨天在商店买了两加仑牛奶。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on card games with his friends every Friday night.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢每周五晚上和朋友们玩牌赌博。

game.example: The children play a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

gap.example: There is a small gap between the two walls.
gap.exampleZh: 两堵墙之间有一个小缺口。

garage.example: We keep the car in the garage, but the garage is full of boxes.
garage.exampleZh: 我们把车停在车库里，但车库里堆满了箱子。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin outside the door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放到门外的垃圾桶里。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她的小花园里种西红柿和花。

garlic.example: My mother puts fresh garlic in the soup to make it taste better.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放新鲜大蒜，让它味道更好。

garment.example: She wore a heavy wool garment to keep warm in winter.
garment.exampleZh: 她穿着一件厚重的羊毛外衣来御寒过冬。

gas.example: The balloon is full of gas and floats high in the sky.
gas.exampleZh: 气球里充满气体，高高地飘在天空中。

gate.example: Please wait for me at the main gate of the school.

gather.example: People gather in the park every morning to run and talk.
gather.exampleZh: 每天早上人们聚集在公园里跑步和聊天。

gay.example: The gay colors of the flowers made everyone in the room smile.
gay.exampleZh: 花朵鲜艳的色彩让房间里的每个人都笑了。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time and forgot everything else.
gaze.exampleZh: 她久久凝视着星空，把其他一切都忘了。

gear.example: The bike has ten gears, so it is easy to ride uphill.
gear.exampleZh: 这辆自行车有十个档位，所以骑上坡很轻松。

gender.example: Please write your name and gender on this form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in your body helps decide how you grow.
gene.exampleZh: 你身体里的每个基因都有助于决定你的成长方式。

general.example: The general idea is clear, but we need more details about the plan.
general.exampleZh: 总体思路是清楚的，但我们需要关于这个计划的更多细节。

generally.example: People generally eat more slowly at home than in restaurants.
generally.exampleZh: 人们在家里通常比在餐馆里吃得慢。

generate.example: The new factory will generate many jobs for people in our town.
generate.exampleZh: 这家新工厂将为我们镇上的人们创造许多就业机会。

generation.example: The older generation often has different ideas about how to live.
generation.exampleZh: 老一辈人对如何生活往往有不同的想法。

generous.example: She is very generous and often shares her lunch with us.
generous.exampleZh: 她非常大方，经常和我们分享她的午餐。

genetic.example: This eye color is genetic and comes from your parents.
genetic.exampleZh: 这种眼睛颜色是遗传的，来自你的父母。

genius.example: She is a genius at solving difficult math problems quickly.
genius.exampleZh: 她是个能快速解决数学难题的天才。

gentle.example: The gentle breeze made the warm afternoon feel very pleasant.
gentle.exampleZh: 轻柔的微风让温暖的午后感觉非常惬意。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman opened the door for us and smiled kindly.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老绅士为我们开门，并和蔼地笑了笑。

geography.example: We study geography to learn about mountains, rivers and countries.
geography.exampleZh: 我们学习地理是为了了解山脉、河流和国家。

geometry.example: The geometry problems in this book are easy to understand.
geometry.exampleZh: 这本书里的几何题很容易理解。

germ.example: Wash your hands to stop germs from spreading.
germ.exampleZh: 洗手可以阻止细菌传播。

german.example: My German friend speaks English and Chinese very well.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语和中文都说得很好。

gesture.example: She made a gesture with her hand to show me the way.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了个手势给我指路。

get.example: I want to get a new bike for my birthday.
get.exampleZh: 我想在生日时得到一辆新自行车。

ghost.example: She says she saw a ghost in the old house last night.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说她昨晚在那栋老房子里看见了一个鬼。

giant.example: A giant tree stands in the middle of the park.
giant.exampleZh: 公园中央矗立着一棵巨大的树。

gift.example: She has a gift for music and often sings for her friends.
gift.exampleZh: 她有音乐天赋，经常为朋友们唱歌。

gifted.example: She is a gifted singer, and everyone loves to hear her sing.
gifted.exampleZh: 她是一位有天赋的歌手，大家都喜欢听她唱歌。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her new red ball.
girl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩正在玩她的新红皮球。

give.example: Please give this book to your sister when you see her.
give.exampleZh: 你见到姐姐时请把这本书给她。

glad.example: I am glad to help you with your homework today.
glad.exampleZh: 我很乐意今天帮你做作业。

glance.example: She gave me a quick glance and then walked away.
glance.exampleZh: 她匆匆看了我一眼，然后就走开了。

glass.example: Please put the clean glass on the table next to the sink.
glass.exampleZh: 请把干净的玻璃杯放在水槽旁边的桌子上。

global.example: Climate change is a global problem that affects every country.
global.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个影响每个国家的全球性问题。

glory.example: She won great glory for her country at the Olympic Games.
glory.exampleZh: 她在奥运会上为她的国家赢得了巨大的荣誉。

glove.example: I wear warm gloves when it is cold outside.
glove.exampleZh: 外面冷的时候我会戴上暖和的手套。

glue.example: Please use glue to stick the paper to the wall.
glue.exampleZh: 请用胶水把纸粘到墙上。

go.example: I go to school by bus every morning with my sister.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上和姐姐一起坐公交车去学校。

goal.example: My goal is to learn English well this year.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是今年学好英语。

goat.example: The goat is eating grass on the hill behind our house.
goat.exampleZh: 那只山羊正在我们屋后的山坡上吃草。

god.example: The people prayed to their god for rain and good food.
god.exampleZh: 人们向他们的神祈求雨水和充足的食物。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger and smiled at everyone.
gold.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚金戒指，对每个人微笑。

golden.example: The leaves turn golden in the autumn sun.
golden.exampleZh: 叶子在秋日的阳光下变成金黄色。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每周日早上都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is very good at math and often helps her classmates.
good.exampleZh: 她数学很好，经常帮助同学。

goods.example: The truck brought goods to the small shop this morning.
goods.exampleZh: 今天早上卡车把货物送到了那家小店。

goose.example: The goose swims across the small pond with her baby ducks.
goose.exampleZh: 那只鹅带着她的小鸭子游过小池塘。

govern.example: Strong laws govern how companies use personal data.
govern.exampleZh: 严格的法律管控公司如何使用个人数据。

government.example: The government has built a new school near our town.
government.exampleZh: 政府在我们镇附近建了一所新学校。

governor.example: The governor visited our school and spoke to the students about reading.
governor.exampleZh: 州长参观了我们的学校，并对学生们讲了关于阅读的事。

gown.example: She wore a long white gown to the party last night.
gown.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一件白色长礼服去参加聚会。

grab.example: She tried to grab the last seat on the crowded bus.
grab.exampleZh: 她试图抓住拥挤公交车上最后一个座位。

grade.example: My sister is in the fifth grade and she loves her new teacher.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹上五年级，她很喜欢她的新老师。

gradual.example: The gradual change in the weather made everyone feel more comfortable.
gradual.exampleZh: 天气的逐渐变化让每个人都感觉更舒适了。

gradually.example: The weather gradually got warmer as spring arrived and the days grew longer.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天到来、白天变长，天气逐渐变暖了。

graduate.example: My sister will graduate from college next June and start looking for a job.
graduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐明年六月将从大学毕业，然后开始找工作。

grain.example: The farmer stores grain in a dry room every year.
grain.exampleZh: 农民每年把粮食储存在干燥的房间里。

gram.example: I need two hundred grams of sugar for this cake.
gram.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕我需要两百克糖。

grammar.example: I need to study English grammar before I take the test.
grammar.exampleZh: 我需要在我参加考试之前学习英语语法。

grand.example: The city has a grand new library near the park.
grand.exampleZh: 这座城市在公园附近有一座宏伟的新图书馆。

grandfather.example: My grandfather tells me funny stories about his old school days.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我的祖父给我讲他上学时的有趣故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother makes delicious soup for us every Sunday.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我的祖母每个星期天都给我们做美味的汤。

grant.example: The school granted her a small grant to study abroad.
grant.exampleZh: 学校授予她一笔小额补助金去留学。

grape.example: I ate a sweet grape from the bowl on the kitchen table.
grape.exampleZh: 我从厨房桌上的碗里吃了一颗甜葡萄。

graph.example: The teacher showed us a graph of the test scores.
graph.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张考试成绩的图表。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快领会了这节课的主要内容。

grass.example: The children like to play on the grass behind our house.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在我们房子后面的草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for your help with my homework today.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感谢你今天帮我做作业。

gravity.example: The gravity of the situation made everyone stop and think.
gravity.exampleZh: 局势的严重性让每个人都停下来思考。

great.example: This great teacher helps his students learn English every day.
great.exampleZh: 这位伟大的老师每天帮助他的学生学习英语。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cookies before dinner.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在晚饭前把饼干全吃光了。

green.example: She wore a green dress and carried a small bag.
green.exampleZh: 她穿了一条绿色连衣裙，手里拿着一个小包。

greet.example: She always greets her neighbors with a warm smile every morning.
greet.exampleZh: 她每天早上总是带着温暖的微笑和邻居们打招呼。

greeting.example: She gave me a warm greeting at the door.
greeting.exampleZh: 她在门口热情地问候了我。

grey.example: The old man has grey hair and a warm smile.
grey.exampleZh: 这位老人头发花白，笑容温暖。

grid.example: The city is laid out on a grid, so the streets are easy to follow.
grid.exampleZh: 这座城市是按照网格布局的，所以街道很容易认。

grocery.example: I stop at the grocery store on my way home from work.
grocery.exampleZh: 我下班回家的路上会去一趟食品杂货店。

ground.example: The children are playing on the ground in front of the house.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在房子前面的地上玩耍。

group.example: Our teacher put us into small groups to finish the class project together.
group.exampleZh: 老师把我们分成小组，一起完成课堂项目。

grow.example: Children grow taller when they eat well and sleep enough.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子吃得好、睡得够就会长得更高。

growth.example: The warm spring rain helped the fast growth of the young plants.
growth.exampleZh: 温暖的春雨促进了幼苗的快速生长。

guarantee.example: The shop guarantees that all its phones work well for one year.
guarantee.exampleZh: 这家商店保证其所有手机一年内正常使用。

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate every night.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵每晚守卫这扇大门。

guess.example: I guess she will come to the party tonight.
guess.exampleZh: 我猜她今晚会来参加聚会。

guest.example: We have a guest from Canada staying with us this week.
guest.exampleZh: 这周有一位来自加拿大的客人和我们住在一起。

guidance.example: She gave me useful guidance on how to study English.
guidance.exampleZh: 她就如何学习英语给了我有用的指导。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the way through the old city.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们穿过了老城区。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday last week.
guilty.exampleZh: 上周忘记母亲的生日，他感到很内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after he finishes his homework.
guitar.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天傍晚写完作业后都会弹吉他。

gun.example: The police found a gun in the man's bag near the door.
gun.exampleZh: 警察在门口附近那个人的包里发现了一把枪。

gym.example: I go to the gym with my friends after school every day.
gym.exampleZh: 我每天放学后和朋友们一起去健身房。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for young children.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对幼儿来说是一个好习惯。

hair.example: She washed her hair with warm water and a little soap.
hair.exampleZh: 她用温水和一点肥皂洗了头发。

half.example: She ate half of the cake and saved the rest for later.
half.exampleZh: 她吃了一半蛋糕，把剩下的留着以后吃。

hall.example: We waited in the hall before the show began.
hall.exampleZh: 演出开始前，我们在门厅里等候。

ham.example: I like to eat ham and eggs for breakfast.
ham.exampleZh: 我早餐喜欢吃火腿和鸡蛋。

hamburger.example: I ate a hamburger with my friend after school today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 今天放学后我和朋友一起吃了一个汉堡包。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in the garden.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用锤子修好了花园里那把坏掉的椅子。

hand.example: Please hand me the small map and my old phone.
hand.exampleZh: 请把那张小地图和我的旧手机递给我。

handbag.example: She put her phone and keys in her new handbag.
handbag.exampleZh: 她把手机和钥匙放进了她的新手提包里。

handsome.example: Her handsome brother gave a handsome gift to the poor family.
handsome.exampleZh: 她英俊的哥哥给了那个贫困家庭一份慷慨的礼物。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so her notes are easy to read.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的字又小又工整，所以她的笔记很容易读。

hang.example: She likes to hang her coat on the back of the door.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢把外套挂在门后。

happen.example: I happened to see your brother at the station yesterday morning.
happen.exampleZh: 昨天早上我碰巧在车站看到了你哥哥。

happiness.example: True happiness comes from the love of family and good friends.
happiness.exampleZh: 真正的幸福来自家人的爱和好朋友。

happy.example: The children are very happy to play in the park with their friends.
happy.exampleZh: 孩子们和朋友们在公园里玩得很开心。

harbor.example: The small boats stayed in the harbor until the storm passed.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船们一直停在港口里，直到暴风雨过去。

hard.example: This old bread is too hard to eat, but she works hard every day.
hard.exampleZh: 这块旧面包太硬了，吃不动，但她每天都很努力地工作。

hardly.example: I can hardly hear the teacher because the classroom is too noisy.
hardly.exampleZh: 我几乎听不见老师说话，因为教室里太吵了。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the long, cold winter.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在漫长寒冷的冬天里面临巨大的困难。

hardworking.example: She is a hardworking student who always finishes her homework on time.
hardworking.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

harm.example: Too much sun can harm your skin, so wear a hat.
harm.exampleZh: 晒太多太阳会伤害皮肤，所以要戴帽子。

harmful.example: Smoking is harmful to your health and to the people around you.
harmful.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康以及你周围的人都有害。

harmony.example: The small village lives in harmony with the forest around it.
harmony.exampleZh: 这个小村庄与周围的森林和谐共处。

harvest.example: Farmers harvest the rice in autumn and share the good news with their families.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，并与家人分享这个好消息。

has.example: She has two brothers and a small dog at home.
has.exampleZh: 她家里有两个兄弟和一只小狗。

hat.example: My hat fell off my head when the wind blew.
hat.exampleZh: 风吹过来时，我的帽子从头上的掉了下来。

hate.example: I hate waiting in long lines at the bank.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在银行排长队等候。

have.example: I have two brothers and we often eat dinner together.
have.exampleZh: 我有两个兄弟，我们经常一起吃晚饭。

he.example: He is my best friend at school and we play together every day.
he.exampleZh: 他是我在学校最好的朋友，我们每天都一起玩。

head.example: She turned her head and saw a bird on the top of the tree.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头，看见树顶上有一只鸟。

headache.example: I have a bad headache, so I cannot go to work today.
headache.exampleZh: 我头痛得厉害，所以今天不能去上班。

headline.example: I only read the headlines, so I don't know the details.
headline.exampleZh: 我只读了新闻摘要，所以不知道细节。

headmaster.example: The headmaster spoke to the students at the school meeting this morning.
headmaster.exampleZh: 今天早上，校长在学校集会上对学生们讲了话。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart and help you move on.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈受伤的心，并帮助你继续前行。

health.example: Regular exercise and good food are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 规律的锻炼和良好的饮食对你的健康很重要。

healthy.example: Eating vegetables every day helps you stay healthy and full of energy.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃蔬菜有助于你保持健康并充满活力。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿的歌声。

hearing.example: His hearing has gotten worse, so he often asks people to speak louder.
hearing.exampleZh: 他的听力变差了，所以他经常请别人说话大声一点。

heart.example: She put her hand on her heart and took a deep breath.
heart.exampleZh: 她把手放在心口，深吸了一口气。

heat.example: The heat from the sun makes the water in the pot very warm.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量使锅里的水变得非常温暖。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信她善良的祖母现在在天堂里。

heavy.example: The box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

heel.example: My left heel hurts after walking in these new shoes all day.
