heel.exampleZh: 穿着这双新鞋走了一整天，我的左脚后跟很疼。

height.example: The height of the mountain is about three thousand meters.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度约为三千米。

helicopter.example: The helicopter landed on the roof of the hospital to pick up the injured man.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机降落在医院楼顶，去接那位受伤的男子。

hello.example: Hello, my name is Tom and I am happy to meet you.
hello.exampleZh: 你好，我叫汤姆，很高兴认识你。

help.example: Can you help me carry these heavy boxes to the car?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些沉重的箱子搬到车上吗？

helpful.example: Your advice was very helpful when I moved to a new city.
helpful.exampleZh: 我搬到新城市时，你的建议非常有用。

hen.example: The hen lays a brown egg every morning in the small wooden box.
hen.exampleZh: 那只母鸡每天早上都在一个小木箱里下一个棕色的蛋。

her.example: I gave her the book and she said thank you.
her.exampleZh: 我把书给了她，她说了声谢谢。

here.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
here.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等叫到你的名字。

hero.example: The young boy wants to be a hero like his father.
hero.exampleZh: 这个小男孩想成为像他父亲一样的英雄。

heroic.example: The heroic firefighter saved three children from the burning house.
heroic.exampleZh: 那位英勇的消防员从着火的房子里救出了三个孩子。

hers.example: This book is mine, and that red bag on the desk is hers.
hers.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，桌上那个红色包是她的。

herself.example: She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled.
herself.exampleZh: 她看着镜子里的自己，笑了。

hesitate.example: I hesitate to ask her for help because she is very busy.
hesitate.exampleZh: 我不愿找她帮忙，因为她很忙。

hide.example: She tried to hide the small key under the old red book.
hide.exampleZh: 她试图把那把小钥匙藏在那本旧红书下面。

high.example: The tall tree is very high, and the bird flies high above it.
high.exampleZh: 那棵大树很高，鸟儿在它上方高高飞翔。

highway.example: The new highway makes it faster to drive to the city.
highway.exampleZh: 这条新公路让开车去城里更快了。

hill.example: We walked up the hill to see the whole town.
hill.exampleZh: 我们走上小山，看到了整个小镇。

him.example: I gave him a book for his birthday.
him.exampleZh: 我给了他一本书作为生日礼物。

himself.example: He made the whole dinner himself and washed all the dishes.
himself.exampleZh: 他自己做了整顿晚饭，还把所有盘子都洗了。

hire.example: They will hire two new teachers for the school next year.
hire.exampleZh: 他们明年将为学校雇用两名新老师。

his.example: His book is on the desk next to my bag.
his.exampleZh: 他的书在桌上，就在我的包旁边。

historian.example: The historian wrote a short book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于中国古代生活的小书。

historical.example: This old building has great historical value for our small town.
historical.exampleZh: 这座老建筑对我们的小镇有着重大的历史价值。

history.example: She likes to read books about the history of China.
history.exampleZh: 她喜欢读关于中国历史的书。

hit.example: The ball hit the window and broke the glass.
hit.exampleZh: 球击中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

hobby.example: My favorite hobby is reading books before I go to bed.
hobby.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的业余爱好是在睡觉前看书。

hold.example: Please hold this bag while I open the door for you.
hold.exampleZh: 请拿着这个包，我帮你开门。

hole.example: The rabbit ran into a deep hole in the ground.
hole.exampleZh: 兔子跑进了地上的一个深洞里。

holiday.example: We plan to visit our grandparents during the summer holiday this year.
holiday.exampleZh: 今年暑假我们打算去看望祖父母。

home.example: I go home after school and have dinner with my family.
home.exampleZh: 我放学后回家，和家人一起吃晚饭。

homework.example: I finish my homework before dinner every day.
homework.exampleZh: 我每天在晚饭前完成家庭作业。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth to her friends.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是对朋友说真话。

honey.example: My little girl likes honey on her bread every morning.
honey.exampleZh: 我的小女儿每天早上都喜欢在面包上抹蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you and your family today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天见到您和您的家人是我的莫大荣幸。

hook.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
hook.exampleZh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party on Saturday.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你能来参加我星期六的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: She is hopeful about the future and works hard every day.
hopeful.exampleZh: 她对未来抱有希望，每天都在努力工作。

horizon.example: The sun rose slowly above the horizon and the sky turned gold.
horizon.exampleZh: 太阳慢慢从地平线上升起，天空变成了金色。

horizontal.example: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
horizontal.exampleZh: 在页面中间画一条水平线。

horn.example: The old car has a loud horn that scares the birds.
horn.exampleZh: 那辆旧车有一个很响的喇叭，会吓到鸟。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed at home all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

horror.example: She ran from the dark house in horror, and we followed her quickly.
horror.exampleZh: 她惊恐地逃离那所黑房子，我们赶紧跟了上去。

horse.example: The farmer rides his brown horse across the wide field every morning.
horse.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上骑着他的棕色马穿过广阔的田野。

hospital.example: My mother works as a nurse in a large hospital near our home.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一家大医院当护士。

host.example: Our host made us feel welcome at the party last night.
host.exampleZh: 昨晚我们的主人在聚会上让我们感到很受欢迎。

hostile.example: The hostile dog barked loudly at everyone who walked past the gate.
hostile.exampleZh: 那只敌意的狗对每个经过大门的人大声吠叫。

hot.example: This soup is too hot to eat right now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，现在没法喝。

hotel.example: We stayed in a small hotel near the train station for two nights.
hotel.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近的一家小旅馆住了两晚。

hour.example: The meeting lasted about one hour and then we went home.
hour.exampleZh: 会议开了大约一个小时，然后我们就回家了。

house.example: They bought a small house near the park and often walk there.
house.exampleZh: 他们在公园附近买了一栋小房子，经常去那里散步。

household.example: Every household in this small town uses water carefully in summer.
household.exampleZh: 这个小镇上的每一户人家在夏天都节约用水。

housewife.example: My mother was a housewife and she took care of three children.
housewife.exampleZh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，她照顾着三个孩子。

housework.example: My mother does all the housework at home on weekends.
housework.exampleZh: 我妈妈周末在家里做所有的家务。

how.example: How do you usually go to school in the morning?
how.exampleZh: 你早上通常怎样去上学？

however.example: It was raining hard; however, we still went out for a walk.
however.exampleZh: 雨下得很大；然而，我们还是出去散步了。

hug.example: She gave her mother a warm hug at the airport before the long flight.
hug.exampleZh: 长途飞行前，她在机场给了妈妈一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: There is a huge tree in front of my house.
huge.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵巨大的树。

human.example: Human beings need clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
human.exampleZh: 人类需要干净的水和新鲜的空气来保持健康。

humble.example: He stays humble even after winning so many big prizes.
humble.exampleZh: 即使赢得了这么多大奖，他依然保持谦逊。

humor.example: Her sense of humor makes every long meeting feel short and happy.
humor.exampleZh: 她的幽默感让每一次漫长的会议都显得短暂而愉快。

humorous.example: He is a humorous teacher, so his classes are always fun.
humorous.exampleZh: 他是个幽默的老师，所以他的课总是很有趣。

hundred.example: There are about two hundred students in our school this year.
hundred.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有两百名学生。

hunger.example: After the long walk, the children felt a strong hunger.
hunger.exampleZh: 走了很长一段路后，孩子们感到非常饥饿。

hungry.example: The little boy was very hungry after playing football all afternoon.
hungry.exampleZh: 那个小男孩踢了一下午足球后非常饿。

hunt.example: We will hunt for a new house next spring.
hunt.exampleZh: 我们明年春天会寻找一所新房子。

hurry.example: I must hurry to catch the early bus to school.
hurry.exampleZh: 我必须赶紧去赶早班公交车上学。

hurt.example: My feet hurt after the long walk in new shoes.
hurt.exampleZh: 穿着新鞋走了很长的路后，我的脚很疼。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for us every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后都为我们做晚饭。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, two common elements on Earth.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，这两种元素在地球上很常见。

hypothesis.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a simple experiment.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 这位科学家用一个简单的实验验证了她的假说。

ice.example: The lake is covered with ice in winter.

iceberg.example: The ship hit a large iceberg and slowly began to sink.
iceberg.exampleZh: 那艘船撞上了一座大冰山，开始慢慢下沉。

icy.example: The icy road was very slippery, so we walked home slowly.
icy.exampleZh: 结冰的路面非常滑，所以我们慢慢地走回家。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class trip this year.
idea.exampleZh: 对于我们今年的班级旅行，我有一个好主意。

ideal.example: This small quiet park is an ideal place for a picnic with friends.
ideal.exampleZh: 这个安静的小公园是和朋友们野餐的理想场所。

identify.example: The police could not identify the man in the photo.
identify.exampleZh: 警方无法认出照片中的那名男子。

identity.example: Her identity as a teacher is very important to her.
identity.exampleZh: 她作为教师的身份对她非常重要。

idiom.example: This English idiom is hard to understand for many new learners.
idiom.exampleZh: 这个英语习语对许多初学者来说很难理解。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

ignorant.example: He is completely ignorant of the basic rules of this simple game.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对这个简单游戏的基本规则完全一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the small problems in your daily work.
ignore.exampleZh: 你不应该忽视日常工作中的小问题。

ill.example: He is ill today and cannot go to work.
ill.exampleZh: 他今天病了，不能去上班。

illegal.example: It is illegal to drive a car without a license.
illegal.exampleZh: 没有驾照开车是违法的。

illness.example: His illness kept him at home for two weeks last month.
illness.exampleZh: 上个月他的病让他在家待了两周。

illustrate.example: The teacher used a picture to illustrate how plants grow.
illustrate.exampleZh: 老师用一张图片说明植物是如何生长的。

image.example: She has a very clear image of what she wants to do.
image.exampleZh: 她对自己想做什么有非常清晰的设想。

imaginary.example: The child has an imaginary friend who goes everywhere with him.
imaginary.exampleZh: 这个孩子有一个想象中的朋友，无论他去哪里都跟着他。

imagination.example: Children need imagination to turn a simple box into a spaceship.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们需要想象力，才能把一个简单的纸箱变成宇宙飞船。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy she felt when she heard the news.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象她听到这个消息时有多高兴。

immediate.example: The doctor said her injury needed immediate care at the hospital.
immediate.exampleZh: 医生说她的伤需要在医院立即接受治疗。

immediately.example: Please call the doctor immediately because your father is not feeling well.
immediately.exampleZh: 请立即给医生打电话，因为你父亲感觉不舒服。

immigrant.example: The immigrant learned English quickly and found a job in the city.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民很快学会了英语，并在城里找到了一份工作。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on our small town.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路对我们的小镇产生了很大的影响。

imply.example: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
imply.exampleZh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他并不同意我们的意见。

import.example: Our country imports a lot of oil and food from other countries every year.
import.exampleZh: 我们国家每年从其他国家进口大量的石油和食品。

importance.example: Many people do not understand the importance of good sleep.
importance.exampleZh: 很多人不明白良好睡眠的重要性。

important.example: It is important to drink enough water every day.
important.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水很重要。

impose.example: The city imposes a small tax on every new car.
impose.exampleZh: 这座城市对每辆新车征收一小笔税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish all this work in one day.
impossible.exampleZh: 在一天之内完成所有这项工作量是不可能的。

impress.example: Her hard work and kind smile impressed everyone in the small team.
impress.exampleZh: 她的努力工作和亲切微笑给这个小团队的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

impression.example: Her first impression of the new teacher was very good.
impression.exampleZh: 她对新老师的第一印象非常好。

impressive.example: The tall building was very impressive to all the young students.
impressive.exampleZh: 那座高楼给所有年轻学生留下了非常深刻的印象。

improve.example: We must improve our English listening skills before the exam next month.
improve.exampleZh: 我们必须在考试前提高英语听力水平，考试就在下个月。

improvement.example: The new teacher noticed a big improvement in her students' reading skills.
improvement.exampleZh: 新老师注意到学生们的阅读能力有了很大进步。

in.example: She put the keys in her bag and went out.
in.exampleZh: 她把钥匙放进包里，然后出去了。

inch.example: The table is only a few inches away from the wall.
inch.exampleZh: 这张桌子离墙只有几英寸远。

incident.example: The police are looking into the incident that happened near the school yesterday.
incident.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨天在学校附近发生的那起事件。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free use of the gym.
include.exampleZh: 价格包括早餐和免费使用健身房。

income.example: Her monthly income is enough to cover rent and food.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入足够支付房租和食物。

increase.example: The number of students in our school will increase next year.
increase.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生人数明年会增加。

indeed.example: This book is indeed very useful for my English study.
indeed.exampleZh: 这本书对我的英语学习确实非常有用。

independence.example: She moved to a new city and learned to live with independence.
independence.exampleZh: 她搬到一个新的城市，学会了独立生活。

independent.example: She is an independent thinker who always asks good questions.
independent.exampleZh: 她是一个独立思考的人，总是能提出好问题。

index.example: The teacher told us to look at the index at the back of the book.
index.exampleZh: 老师让我们查看书后面的索引。

indicate.example: The dark clouds indicate that a heavy rain is coming soon.
indicate.exampleZh: 乌云表明一场大雨即将来临。

indirect.example: She gave me an indirect answer, so I still did not know the truth.
indirect.exampleZh: 她给了我一个间接的回答，所以我仍然不知道真相。

industry.example: The car industry gives many people jobs in our town.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车工业为我们镇上许多人提供了工作。

infer.example: We can infer from these facts that the plan will fail.
infer.exampleZh: 我们可以从这些事实推断出这个计划会失败。

inference.example: She made an inference about the answer from the clues.
inference.exampleZh: 她根据线索对答案做出了推论。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

informal.example: The meeting was informal, so everyone spoke freely and felt relaxed.
informal.exampleZh: 这次会议是非正式的，所以大家都畅所欲言，感到很放松。

information.example: This book gives you a lot of useful information about cooking.
information.exampleZh: 这本书为你提供了大量有用的烹饪信息。

initial.example: My initial plan was to walk, but the rain changed my mind.
initial.exampleZh: 我最初的计划是步行，但下雨让我改变了主意。

injury.example: The player missed two games because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 这名球员因膝伤缺席了两场比赛。

ink.example: The ink in my pen is almost gone, so I need a new one.
ink.exampleZh: 我钢笔里的墨水快用完了，所以我需要一支新的。

inn.example: We stayed at a small inn near the lake last summer.
inn.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。

inquiry.example: I made an inquiry about the price of the tickets.

insect.example: A small insect is walking slowly across the green leaf.
insect.exampleZh: 一只小昆虫正慢慢地爬过绿叶。

inside.example: The keys are inside the small bag on the desk.

insist.example: She insists on walking to school every day, even in the rain.
insist.exampleZh: 她坚持每天步行去学校，即使下雨也不例外。

inspire.example: Her kind words inspired me to keep going.
inspire.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语鼓舞了我继续前进。

install.example: We will install the new software on your computer tomorrow morning.
install.exampleZh: 我们明天早上会在你的电脑上安装新软件。

instance.example: This is a clear instance of how small changes can help.
instance.exampleZh: 这是一个明显的例子，说明小改动也能有帮助。

instead.example: I wanted tea, but we had no milk, so I drank water instead.
instead.exampleZh: 我本想喝茶，但没有牛奶，所以就喝了水。

instinct.example: She trusted her instinct and ran away from the danger.
instinct.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，逃离了危险。

institute.example: She works at a famous institute that studies climate change.
institute.exampleZh: 她在一家研究气候变化的著名研究所工作。

institution.example: The bank is an important institution in this small town.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是这个小镇上重要的公共机构。

instruct.example: Our teacher will instruct us how to use the new computer.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师将指导我们如何使用这台新电脑。

instruction.example: The teacher gave clear instructions before the students started the test.
instruction.exampleZh: 老师在学生开始考试前给出了明确的指示。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my heart.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的心脏。

insurance.example: I pay for car insurance every month because it keeps my family safe.
insurance.exampleZh: 我每个月都付汽车保险费，因为它能让我的家人安心。

intelligence.example: She has high intelligence and learns new things very quickly.
intelligence.exampleZh: 她智力很高，学新东西非常快。

intelligent.example: She is intelligent enough to solve this problem quickly.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她足够聪明，能很快解决这个问题。

intend.example: I intend to study English for one hour every day.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算每天学一小时英语。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my plan.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变我计划的打算。

interest.example: He has a strong interest in science and reads books about it every day.
interest.exampleZh: 他对科学有浓厚的兴趣，每天都读这方面的书。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting, and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我还想再读一遍。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere in my personal life again.
interfere.exampleZh: 请不要再干涉我的私生活了。

international.example: She works for an international company and often travels to other countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去其他国家出差。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and talk to friends.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天用互联网看新闻和与朋友聊天。

interpret.example: Can you interpret what the teacher just said for me?
interpret.exampleZh: 你能帮我解释一下老师刚才说的话吗？

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am talking on the phone.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

interval.example: There is a short interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 两节课之间有一段短暂的间隔。

interview.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning at nine.
interview.exampleZh: 我明天上午九点有一场求职面试。

into.example: She cut the cake into eight pieces for the children.
into.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成八块分给孩子们。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师。

introduction.example: This book has a short introduction at the beginning.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书的开头有一篇简短的引言。

invent.example: He invented a small machine to help his mother cook.
invent.exampleZh: 他发明了一台小机器来帮妈妈做饭。

invention.example: The invention of the wheel changed how people travel and work.
invention.exampleZh: 轮子的发明改变了人们出行和工作的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor made a small machine that helps clean the house.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台帮助打扫房子的小机器。

invitation.example: Thank you for the invitation to your birthday party.
invitation.exampleZh: 谢谢你邀请我参加你的生日聚会。

invite.example: I want to invite my best friend to my birthday party.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请我最好的朋友来参加我的生日聚会。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and meetings.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作将包含大量出差和会议。

iron.example: Iron is a strong metal, so workers use it to make bridges and machines.
iron.exampleZh: 铁是一种坚固的金属，所以工人们用它来造桥和机器。

island.example: We took a small boat to the island and swam all afternoon.
island.exampleZh: 我们坐小船去了那座岛，整个下午都在游泳。

issue.example: The new policy has become a major issue for many voters.
issue.exampleZh: 新政策已成为许多选民关注的主要问题。

it.example: It is a small cat and it likes to sleep on my bed.
it.exampleZh: 它是一只小猫，它喜欢睡在我的床上。

item.example: Each item on the list has a price next to it.
item.exampleZh: 清单上的每一项旁边都有价格。

its.example: The small dog keeps its bone in the back garden.
its.exampleZh: 那只小狗把它的骨头放在后花园里。

itself.example: The cat washed itself carefully after eating its food.
itself.exampleZh: 猫吃完食物后仔细地清洗了自己。

jacket.example: He put on a warm jacket before he went outside.
jacket.exampleZh: 他出门前穿上了一件暖和的夹克。

jail.example: The thief was sent to jail for two years after the trial.
jail.exampleZh: 审判后，那个小偷被送进监狱服刑两年。

jam.example: Mom made some apple jam and put it on my bread.
jam.exampleZh: 妈妈做了一些苹果酱，把它涂在我的面包上。

january.example: The new school term usually begins in January after the long winter holiday.
january.exampleZh: 新的学期通常在漫长的寒假之后的一月开始。

jar.example: She keeps the sugar in a glass jar on the kitchen shelf.
jar.exampleZh: 她把糖放在厨房架子上的一个玻璃罐里。

jaw.example: The boxer hit his jaw and he fell to the ground.
jaw.exampleZh: 拳击手打中了他的下巴，他倒在了地上。

jazz.example: My father loves to listen to jazz while he cooks dinner.
jazz.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在做饭时听爵士乐。

jeans.example: My new jeans are very comfortable, so I wear them almost every day.
jeans.exampleZh: 我的新牛仔裤很舒服，所以我几乎每天都穿。

jelly.example: The children ate red jelly with fruit in it after lunch.
jelly.exampleZh: 午饭后，孩子们吃了里面有水果的红色果冻。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Tokyo.
jet.exampleZh: 那架喷气式飞机在云层上方高高飞行，前往东京。

jewel.example: The queen wore a beautiful jewel on her crown.
jewel.exampleZh: 女王在王冠上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

job.example: My job is interesting and I work with nice people.
job.exampleZh: 我的工作很有趣，我和友善的人一起工作。

jog.example: I jog in the park every morning before work.
jog.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前在公园里慢跑。

join.example: I want to join the school music club this year.
join.exampleZh: 我想今年加入学校的音乐社团。

joint.example: The two companies signed a joint agreement to build the new road.
joint.exampleZh: 两家公司签署了一项联合协议来修建这条新路。

joke.example: He told a funny joke and everyone in the room laughed.
joke.exampleZh: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，房间里的每个人都笑了。

journalist.example: The journalist asked many questions at the meeting yesterday.
journalist.exampleZh: 那位新闻记者昨天在会议上问了很多问题。

journey.example: The journey to the mountains took three days by train.
journey.exampleZh: 去山区的旅程坐火车花了三天。

joy.example: Her face was full of joy when she saw the gift.
joy.exampleZh: 当她看到那份礼物时，脸上充满了欢乐。

judge.example: The judge told us to be quiet in the court today.
judge.exampleZh: 法官让我们今天在法庭上保持安静。

judgement.example: The judge will announce his judgement on the case tomorrow morning.
judgement.exampleZh: 法官将在明天上午宣布对本案的判决。

juice.example: I drink a glass of orange juice every morning before school.
juice.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯橙汁。

juicy.example: This ripe peach is very juicy and sweet.
juicy.exampleZh: 这个熟透的桃子非常多汁又甜。

july.example: We will go to the beach for two weeks in July.
july.exampleZh: 我们将在七月去海滩玩两周。

jump.example: The cat tried to jump over the small wall but fell.
jump.exampleZh: 那只猫试图跳过那堵矮墙，但摔了下来。

jungle.example: Many wild animals live in the jungle and find food there.
jungle.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在丛林里，并在那里寻找食物。

junior.example: My junior brother is learning to play the piano this year.
junior.exampleZh: 我年幼的弟弟今年正在学弹钢琴。

just.example: The bus came just as I reached the stop, and the driver was fair to everyone.
just.exampleZh: 我刚到车站，公交车就正好来了，而且司机对每个人都很公正。

justice.example: The people asked for justice after the long and unfair trial.
justice.exampleZh: 在漫长而不公正的审判之后，人们要求正义。

justify.example: He tried to justify his long absence with a weak excuse.
justify.exampleZh: 他试图用一个牵强的借口为自己的长期缺席辩解。

juvenile.example: The juvenile boy laughed at a very silly joke.
juvenile.exampleZh: 那个青少年男孩因为一个很傻的笑话而大笑。

kangaroo.example: The kangaroo jumped across the grass and carried its baby in a warm pouch.
kangaroo.exampleZh: 那只袋鼠跳过草地，把宝宝带在温暖的育儿袋里。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practices every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她热衷于学英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed when you leave the room.
keep.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请保持门关着。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to make tea for us.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上给我们烧水泡茶。

key.example: I lost my key, so I cannot open the front door.
key.exampleZh: 我把钥匙弄丢了，所以打不开前门。

keyboard.example: I type my homework on the keyboard every day after school.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天放学后都用键盘打作业。

kick.example: He kicked the ball hard and it flew over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢球，球飞过了墙。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to play ball in the park.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁的小孩喜欢在公园里打球。

kill.example: The cold weather can kill young plants in the garden.
kill.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会杀死花园里的幼苗。

kilo.example: The bag of rice weighs five kilos, so it is easy to carry.
kilo.exampleZh: 这袋米重五公斤，所以很容易拿。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice weighs about one kilogram.

kilometre.example: The school is only one kilometre from my house.
kilometre.exampleZh: 学校离我家只有一公里。

kind.example: She is very kind to her new classmates.
kind.exampleZh: 她对她的新同学非常和蔼。

kindness.example: Her kindness to the new students made them feel welcome at school.
kindness.exampleZh: 她对新同学的友善让他们在学校感到很受欢迎。

king.example: The king lives in a big castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for many years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 那位老国王统治他的王国很多年。

kiss.example: She gave her son a gentle kiss on the cheek before bed.
kiss.exampleZh: 睡前她在儿子的脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy is flying a red kite in the park today.
kite.exampleZh: 那个小男孩今天正在公园里放一只红色的风筝。

knee.example: He fell off his bike and hurt his left knee.
knee.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤了左膝盖。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down to tie her little son's shoes.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪下来给她小儿子的鞋子系鞋带。

knife.example: Please use this sharp knife to cut the cake for everyone.
knife.exampleZh: 请用这把锋利的小刀为大家切蛋糕。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for us in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢在冬天为我们编织暖和的毛衣。

knock.example: Please knock on the door before you come into my office.
knock.exampleZh: 进我办公室之前请先敲门。

know.example: I know this city very well because I lived here for years.
know.exampleZh: 我很了解这座城市，因为我在这里住过多年。

knowledge.example: She has good knowledge of Chinese history and culture.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她对中国历史和文化有很好的了解。

lab.example: The students did a simple experiment in the science lab yesterday.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们昨天在科学实验室里做了一个简单的实验。

label.example: Please put a label on every box before we ship them.
label.exampleZh: 在我们发货之前，请在每个箱子上贴一个标签。

labour.example: The workers said the labour was hard, but the pay was fair.
labour.exampleZh: 工人们说这活儿很辛苦，但报酬还算公道。

lack.example: Many small schools lack the money to buy new computers and books.
lack.exampleZh: 许多小学校缺乏购买新电脑和书籍的资金。

ladder.example: He put the ladder against the wall to reach the roof.
ladder.exampleZh: 他把梯子靠在墙上以便够到屋顶。

lady.example: The lady at the front desk helped me find my lost bag.
lady.exampleZh: 前台的那位女士帮我找到了丢失的包。

lag.example: Our small town still lags behind the big cities in public transport.
lag.exampleZh: 我们的小镇在公共交通方面仍然落后于大城市。

lake.example: The children swim in the lake every summer.
lake.exampleZh: 孩子们每年夏天都在这个湖里游泳。

lamb.example: The little lamb follows its mother across the green field.
lamb.exampleZh: 小羊羔跟着它的妈妈穿过绿色的田野。

lamp.example: She turned on the lamp and began to read her book.
lamp.exampleZh: 她打开灯，开始读她的书。

land.example: The plane will land on the small island in an hour.
land.exampleZh: 飞机将在一小时后降落在那个小岛上。

landscape.example: The landscape outside the train window is green and full of mountains.
landscape.exampleZh: 火车窗外的风景一片翠绿，到处都是山。

language.example: Learning a new language can be fun and useful.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言既有趣又有用。

lap.example: The little cat sat on her lap and fell asleep.
lap.exampleZh: 小猫坐在她的大腿上睡着了。

large.example: A large dog is running across the green field.
large.exampleZh: 一只大狗正跑过绿色的田野。

largely.example: The work is largely done, but a few small problems remain.
largely.exampleZh: 这项工作大部分已经完成，但还有几个小问题。

last.example: This is the last bus, and the trip lasts two hours.
last.exampleZh: 这是末班车，这段路程要持续两个小时。

late.example: Sorry I am late, but the bus was very slow today.
late.exampleZh: 抱歉我迟到了，但今天的公交车开得很慢。

lately.example: I have been very tired lately because of my new job.
lately.exampleZh: 最近因为新工作，我一直很累。

later.example: I will call you later when I get home from work.
later.exampleZh: 我下班回家后会稍后给你打电话。

latter.example: The latter option is cheaper and easier for most students to use.
latter.exampleZh: 后一种选择更便宜，也更容易让大多数学生使用。

laugh.example: The children laugh at the funny story in the book.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们被书里那个有趣的故事逗笑了。

launch.example: The company will launch a new phone next month.
launch.exampleZh: 公司下个月将推出一款新手机。

laundry.example: I need to take my dirty clothes to the laundry this afternoon.
laundry.exampleZh: 今天下午我需要把脏衣服送到洗衣店去。

law.example: Everyone must follow the law and be kind to others.
law.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守法律，并且善待他人。

lawyer.example: My sister is a lawyer and she works in a big city.
lawyer.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一名律师，她在一座大城市工作。

lay.example: She will lay the baby on the bed and then close the door.
lay.exampleZh: 她会把婴儿放在床上，然后关上门。

layer.example: The cake has three layers of chocolate and cream.
layer.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力和奶油。

lazy.example: My lazy brother never cleans his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 我懒惰的弟弟周末从不打扫自己的房间。

lead.example: She will lead the team to the new office.
lead.exampleZh: 她将带领团队去新办公室。

leader.example: The leader of our team is always kind and fair.
leader.exampleZh: 我们团队的领导者总是友善而公正。

leadership.example: Good leadership helps the whole team work together and finish the project on time.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导能力有助于整个团队通力合作，按时完成项目。

leading.example: She is a leading expert in computer science at our university.
leading.exampleZh: 她是我们大学计算机科学领域的领先专家。

leaf.example: A green leaf fell from the tall tree onto the wet ground.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片绿叶从高高的树上落到了湿漉漉的地上。

league.example: Our school joined a new sports league this year.
league.exampleZh: 我们学校今年加入了一个新的体育联赛。

leak.example: The old pipe began to leak water onto the kitchen floor.
leak.exampleZh: 那根旧管子开始漏水，水漏到了厨房地板上。

lean.example: He leaned his bike against the wall and ate a lean sandwich.
lean.exampleZh: 他把自行车靠在墙上，吃了一个瘦肉的 sandwich。

leap.example: She leaped over the small fence to catch the bus.
leap.exampleZh: 她跳过小栅栏去赶公交车。

learn.example: We learn new English words in class every day.
learn.exampleZh: 我们每天在课堂上学习新的英语单词。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the old book to his students.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授向学生们解释了那本古书。

least.example: This one is the least expensive, so I will buy it.
least.exampleZh: 这个最便宜，所以我打算买这个。

leather.example: She bought a soft leather bag for her mother's birthday.
leather.exampleZh: 她为母亲的生日买了一个柔软的皮革包。

leave.example: Please leave your bag here and don't forget to take your keys.
leave.exampleZh: 请把你的包留在这里，别忘了拿你的钥匙。

left.example: Turn left at the bank, and you will see the school.
left.exampleZh: 在银行那里向左转，你就会看到那所学校。

leg.example: My leg hurts after the long walk up the hill.
leg.exampleZh: 爬完那段长长的山路后，我的腿疼。

legacy.example: Our old school library is a legacy from the town's first mayor.
legacy.exampleZh: 我们旧的学校图书馆是镇上第一位市长留下的遗产。

legal.example: The legal team will help you understand the new rules.
legal.exampleZh: 法律团队会帮助你理解这些新规定。

leisure.example: I like to read books in my leisure time after work.
leisure.exampleZh: 下班后我喜欢在闲暇时间读书。

lemon.example: She put a slice of lemon in her tea and smiled.
lemon.exampleZh: 她在茶里放了一片柠檬，笑了笑。

lend.example: Can you lend me your bike for the weekend?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把自行车借给我用这个周末吗？

length.example: Please measure the length of the table before you buy the new cloth.
length.exampleZh: 买新桌布之前，请先量一下桌子的长度。

lens.example: The camera lens helps you take clear and sharp photos.
lens.exampleZh: 相机镜头能帮你拍出清晰锐利的照片。

less.example: I have less free time this week than last week.
less.exampleZh: 我这周的空闲时间比上周少。

lesson.example: Today's lesson taught us how to be careful with money.
lesson.exampleZh: 今天的课教会我们如何小心对待金钱。

let.example: Let me help you carry those heavy boxes upstairs.
let.exampleZh: 让我帮你把这些沉重的箱子搬上楼吧。

letter.example: I wrote a short letter to my old friend last night.
letter.exampleZh: 昨晚我给我的老朋友写了一封短信。

level.example: The water level in the river is higher than usual this year.
level.exampleZh: 今年河里的水位比往年高。

liable.example: Drivers are liable for any damage they cause in an accident.
liable.exampleZh: 司机对事故中造成的任何损失负有责任。

liberal.example: He has liberal views and often gives generous help to his friends.
liberal.exampleZh: 他思想开明，而且常常慷慨地帮助朋友。

liberty.example: Everyone should have the liberty to choose their own way of life.
liberty.exampleZh: 每个人都应该拥有选择自己生活方式的自由。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find a quiet place to read.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找了一个安静的阅读之处。

library.example: I go to the library every week to borrow new books.
library.exampleZh: 我每周都去图书馆借新书。

license.example: You must show your license before you can drive the car.
license.exampleZh: 开车前你必须出示你的驾照。

lie.example: The old dog likes to lie on the warm floor every afternoon.
lie.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢每天下午躺在温暖的地板上。

life.example: She spent her whole life helping others in her small town.
life.exampleZh: 她一生都在她的小镇上帮助他人。

lift.example: She lifted the heavy box and carried it into the elevator.
lift.exampleZh: 她举起那个沉重的箱子，把它搬进了电梯。

light.example: Please turn on the light so we can see the food.
light.exampleZh: 请打开灯，这样我们就能看到食物了。

like.example: I like this small blue bag and it looks like yours.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢这个蓝色的小包，它看起来像你的那个。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

likely.example: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella with you.
likely.exampleZh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

likewise.example: She works hard, and her brother works likewise every single day.
likewise.exampleZh: 她工作努力，她的弟弟每天也同样努力。

limb.example: The bird sat on a high limb and sang a sweet song.
limb.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在高处的树枝上，唱着甜美的歌。

limit.example: Please limit your time on the phone to ten minutes.
limit.exampleZh: 请把你打电话的时间限制在十分钟以内。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn to enter.
line.exampleZh: 请排队等候，轮到你时再进去。

linen.example: She put clean linen on the bed before the guests arrived.
linen.exampleZh: 客人们到来之前，她把干净的亚麻布铺在了床上。

liner.example: The liner sailed slowly across the sea with hundreds of happy passengers on board.
liner.exampleZh: 这艘邮轮载着数百名快乐的乘客，缓缓驶过海面。

link.example: The bridge links the two small towns across the river.
link.exampleZh: 这座桥连接着河两岸的两个小镇。

lion.example: The lion is sleeping under a big tree in the sun.
lion.exampleZh: 狮子正在阳光下的一棵大树下睡觉。

lip.example: She bit her lip and said nothing to him.
lip.exampleZh: 她咬着嘴唇，什么也没对他说。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid, and ice is a solid.

list.example: Please list all the items you need on this table.
list.exampleZh: 请把所有你需要的东西列在这张表上。

listen.example: You should listen to your teacher carefully during the class.
listen.exampleZh: 上课时你应该认真听老师讲课。

literary.example: She often uses literary words that her younger sister does not understand.
literary.exampleZh: 她经常使用一些文学词汇，她妹妹听不懂。

literature.example: She studies English literature at the university and reads many old books.
literature.exampleZh: 她在大学学习英国文学，还读了许多古老的书。

litter.example: The litter from our picnic was easy to collect in one bag.
litter.exampleZh: 我们野餐产生的垃圾很容易收进一个袋子里。

little.example: We have little time left, so we must walk fast.
little.exampleZh: 我们剩下的时间不多了，所以必须快走。

live.example: I live in a small city with my family, and we often watch live sports together.
live.exampleZh: 我和家人住在一座小城市里，我们经常一起看体育直播。

lively.example: The lively music made everyone want to dance at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 欢快的音乐让每个人都想在派对上跳舞。

livestock.example: The farmer keeps livestock such as cows and sheep on his land.
livestock.exampleZh: 这位农民在自己的土地上饲养奶牛和绵羊等家畜。

load.example: Heavy trucks can load the bridge with too much weight and damage it.
load.exampleZh: 重型卡车会使桥梁承受过大的负荷，并将其损坏。

loaf.example: I bought a loaf of fresh bread for breakfast this morning.
loaf.exampleZh: 今天早上我买了一条新鲜面包当早餐。

loan.example: She took out a small loan to buy a new car.
loan.exampleZh: 她申请了一笔小额贷款来买一辆新车。

lobby.example: We waited in the hotel lobby for our room to be ready.
lobby.exampleZh: 我们在酒店大堂等待房间准备好。

local.example: The local school is near my house and has many friendly teachers.
local.exampleZh: 这所本地学校离我家很近，有很多友好的老师。

locate.example: We used a map to locate the small hotel near the river.
locate.exampleZh: 我们用地图找到了河边那家小旅馆的位置。

location.example: Please tell me the exact location of the meeting room.
location.exampleZh: 请告诉我会议室的确切位置。

lock.example: Please lock the door before you leave the office tonight.
lock.exampleZh: 今晚离开办公室前请把门锁上。

locker.example: I put my bag in a locker near the swimming pool.
locker.exampleZh: 我把包放在游泳池附近的一个寄物柜里。

lodge.example: We will lodge in a small hotel near the station this weekend.
lodge.exampleZh: 这个周末我们将暂住在车站附近的一家小旅馆。

logic.example: Her logic is clear, so everyone understands the plan.
logic.exampleZh: 她的逻辑很清晰，所以每个人都理解这个计划。

logical.example: It is logical to check the facts before you make a decision.
logical.exampleZh: 在做决定之前先核实事实，这是合乎逻辑的。

lonely.example: He lives alone in a small house and often feels lonely.
lonely.exampleZh: 他独自住在一间小屋里，常常感到孤独。

long.example: The river is very long and runs through the whole city.
long.exampleZh: 这条河很长，流经整座城市。

look.example: She looked at the old photo and smiled.
look.exampleZh: 她看着那张旧照片，笑了。

lookout.example: The sailor kept a careful lookout for rocks near the shore.
lookout.exampleZh: 水手在岸边仔细守望，留意礁石。

loose.example: My old shoes are too loose, so they slip off when I walk.
loose.exampleZh: 我的旧鞋太松了，所以我走路时它们会滑掉。

loosen.example: Please loosen the lid on this jar before you try to open it.
loosen.exampleZh: 请先松开这个罐子的盖子，然后再试着打开它。

lord.example: The lord lived in a large castle with his family and many servants.
lord.exampleZh: 这位领主和他的家人以及许多仆人住在一座大城堡里。

lorry.example: The lorry carries boxes of fruit to the city every morning.
lorry.exampleZh: 这辆卡车每天早上把一箱箱水果运到城里。

lose.example: Be careful, or you will lose your keys again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心点，不然你又会把钥匙弄丢。

loss.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
loss.exampleZh: 失去他的老狗让他非常伤心。

lot.example: She has a lot of books on her desk.

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，请把它调小一点。

loudly.example: The teacher spoke loudly so that all the students could hear her.
loudly.exampleZh: 老师大声说话，好让所有学生都能听见。

love.example: I love my family and I love reading books with them.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，也喜欢和他们一起读书。

lovely.example: The little girl has a lovely smile and everyone likes her.
lovely.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容，大家都喜欢她。

lover.example: She is a great lover of music and plays the piano every day.
lover.exampleZh: 她是一位音乐爱好者，每天都会弹钢琴。

low.example: The wall is low, so children can climb over it easily.
low.exampleZh: 这堵墙很矮，所以孩子们很容易就能爬过去。

lower.example: The lower part of the river is very quiet and calm.
lower.exampleZh: 河流的下游部分非常安静、平静。

loyal.example: A loyal friend will always stand by you when times are hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 忠诚的朋友在你困难时总会支持你。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her friends never changed, even during the hard times.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对朋友的忠诚从未改变，即使在艰难时期也是如此。

luck.example: I had good luck and found a seat on the bus.
luck.exampleZh: 我运气好，在公交车上找到了一个座位。

lucky.example: She felt very lucky to find a good job so quickly.
lucky.exampleZh: 她感到很幸运，这么快就找到了一份好工作。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the car and drove to the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 我把行李放进车里，然后开车去了机场。

lump.example: The doctor found a small lump on my neck yesterday.
lump.exampleZh: 医生昨天在我脖子上发现了一个小肿块。

lunch.example: I usually have lunch with my coworkers at noon.
lunch.exampleZh: 我通常中午和同事一起吃午饭。

lung.example: Smoking is very bad for your lungs and your heart.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏都非常有害。

luxury.example: She likes a little luxury in her life, such as good coffee and fresh flowers.
luxury.exampleZh: 她喜欢生活中有一点奢华，比如好咖啡和鲜花。

machine.example: The washing machine in our basement is very old but still works well.
machine.exampleZh: 我们地下室的那台洗衣机很旧了，但仍然运转良好。

mad.example: He went mad when he saw the broken window.
mad.exampleZh: 他看到破窗户时气疯了。

magazine.example: She reads a fashion magazine every month at the library.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月都在图书馆读一本时尚杂志。

magic.example: The children believe that magic can make their wishes come true.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信魔法能让他们的愿望成真。

magnet.example: The magnet on the fridge holds my shopping list in place.
magnet.exampleZh: 冰箱上的磁铁把我的购物清单固定住了。

magnificent.example: The old city looks magnificent when the sun goes down.
magnificent.exampleZh: 太阳落山时，这座古城显得非常壮丽。

mail.example: I will mail the letter to my friend this afternoon.
mail.exampleZh: 我今天下午会把信寄给我的朋友。

mailbox.example: I put the letter in the mailbox in front of my house.
mailbox.exampleZh: 我把信放进了我家门前的邮箱里。

main.example: The main road into town is closed because of heavy snow today.
main.exampleZh: 进入城里的主要道路今天因大雪而封闭。

mainland.example: Many people take a ferry from the island to the mainland every morning.
mainland.exampleZh: 每天早上有许多人从岛上乘渡轮到大陆。

maintain.example: We must maintain the machines well so they can run safely every day.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须好好保养这些机器，这样它们每天才能安全运转。

major.example: She chose computer science as her major and studies it every day.
major.exampleZh: 她选择了计算机科学作为专业，并且每天都学习它。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class like playing basketball after school.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

make.example: My father can make a small table for the kitchen.
make.exampleZh: 我父亲能为厨房做一张小桌子。

male.example: The male bird has bright feathers and sings every morning.
male.exampleZh: 这只雄鸟有着鲜艳的羽毛，每天早上都会鸣叫。

man.example: The man at the door asked me to move my car.
man.exampleZh: 门口的那个男人让我把车挪一下。

manage.example: She manages a small shop and works hard every day.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营一家小店，每天努力工作。

manager.example: The new manager is very friendly and helps us every day.
manager.exampleZh: 新来的经理很友好，每天都帮助我们。

mankind.example: Some people believe that all mankind should work together to protect the earth.
mankind.exampleZh: 有些人认为全人类应该共同努力保护地球。

manner.example: He always answers questions in a polite and friendly manner.
manner.exampleZh: 他总是以礼貌又友好的方式回答问题。

manual.example: The worker gave me a manual on how to use the machine.
manual.exampleZh: 那名工人给了我一本如何使用这台机器的手册。

manufacture.example: This factory manufactures small parts for cars and sells them around the world.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家工厂为汽车制造小零件，并把它们销往世界各地。

many.example: Many students in our class like to play basketball after school.
many.exampleZh: 我们班上许多学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

map.example: We need a map to find the way to the park.
map.exampleZh: 我们需要一张地图来找到去公园的路。

march.example: My birthday is in March, and the weather is usually warm.
march.exampleZh: 我的生日在三月，那时候天气通常很暖和。

mark.example: Please mark your name on the paper and put a mark next to the right answer.
mark.exampleZh: 请在试卷上写下你的名字，并在正确答案旁做一个标记。

market.example: She goes to the market every Saturday to buy fresh fruit and vegetables.
market.exampleZh: 她每周六都去市场买新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

marriage.example: Their marriage is happy because they talk and laugh together every day.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻很幸福，因为他们每天一起聊天、一起笑。

marry.example: She plans to marry her best friend next summer.
marry.exampleZh: 她打算明年夏天和她最好的朋友结婚。

mask.example: She wore a mask on the bus because the air was dirty.
mask.exampleZh: 她在公交车上戴着口罩，因为空气很脏。

mass.example: A mass of dark clouds gathered above the small town.
mass.exampleZh: 一大团乌云聚集在小镇上方。

master.example: She worked hard to master English and became a master of it.
master.exampleZh: 她努力学习英语，最终精通了这门语言，成为英语大师。

mat.example: Please wipe your muddy shoes on the mat before you come in.
mat.exampleZh: 进来之前请把泥鞋在蹭脚垫上擦干净。

match.example: This match is easy, and my skills match the team's needs.
match.exampleZh: 这场比赛很轻松，而且我的技能与球队的需求相匹配。

material.example: This material is soft and easy to cut.
material.exampleZh: 这种材料很柔软，容易裁剪。

math.example: Math is my favorite class because the teacher makes it fun.
math.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的课，因为老师把它讲得很有趣。

mathematics.example: My brother studies mathematics at university and enjoys solving difficult problems.
mathematics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学习数学，喜欢解决难题。

matter.example: It does not matter if we are a little late today.
matter.exampleZh: 我们今天稍微迟到一点没关系。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and often helps her younger brother.
mature.exampleZh: 她比同龄人成熟得多，经常帮助她的弟弟。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this small car is 120 kilometres per hour.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车的最高速度是每小时120公里。

may.example: You may go home now, and we may meet again in May.
may.exampleZh: 你现在可以回家了，我们五月可能还会再见。

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
maybe.exampleZh: 今天下午也许会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

me.example: Please give me a glass of water.

meal.example: We usually eat three meals a day at home.
meal.exampleZh: 我们通常在家一天吃三顿饭。

mean.example: I do not know what this word means, so please tell me.
mean.exampleZh: 我不知道这个词是什么意思，所以请告诉我。

meaning.example: I do not understand the meaning of this word.
meaning.exampleZh: 我不明白这个词的意思。

means.example: The bicycle is a cheap means of travel for students in small towns.
means.exampleZh: 自行车是小城镇学生出行的廉价工具。

measure.example: We need to measure the table before we buy a new cover.
measure.exampleZh: 买新桌布之前，我们需要量一下桌子的尺寸。

meat.example: I do not eat meat, but I like fish and eggs.
meat.exampleZh: 我不吃肉，但我喜欢鱼和鸡蛋。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 这位机修工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

medical.example: She is studying medical books because she wants to become a doctor.
medical.exampleZh: 她正在读医学书籍，因为她想成为一名医生。

medicine.example: I take my medicine with water every morning after breakfast.
medicine.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃完早饭后用水服药。

medium.example: He bought a medium coffee and drank it slowly on the way to work.
medium.exampleZh: 他买了一杯中杯咖啡，在上班路上慢慢喝完了。

meet.example: I will meet my old friend at the train station tomorrow.
meet.exampleZh: 我明天会去火车站接我的老朋友。

meeting.example: The meeting starts at nine in the big room.
meeting.exampleZh: 会议九点在大房间开始。

member.example: Every member of the team must attend the meeting on Friday.
member.exampleZh: 团队的每位成员都必须参加周五的会议。

membership.example: You need a membership to use the gym at our school.
membership.exampleZh: 你需要会员资格才能使用我们学校的健身房。

memory.example: I have a good memory for names and faces.
memory.exampleZh: 我记人名和长相记得很牢。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your mental and physical health.
mental.exampleZh: 规律运动对你的心理健康和身体健康都有好处。

mention.example: She did not mention the meeting in her email.
mention.exampleZh: 她在邮件里没有提到那次会议。

menu.example: The waiter gave me a menu with many Chinese dishes.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员递给我一份列有许多中国菜的菜单。

merchant.example: The merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the market every morning.
merchant.exampleZh: 这位商人每天早上在市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

mercy.example: The king showed mercy to the poor man and let him go home.
mercy.exampleZh: 国王对那个穷人发了慈悲，放他回家了。

mere.example: The mere thought of losing her made him very sad.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅想到失去她，他就非常难过。

merely.example: He is merely a friend, not my boyfriend.
merely.exampleZh: 他只不过是个朋友，不是我男朋友。

merry.example: The children were merry as they sang songs around the fire.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们围着火唱歌，个个欢快无比。

mess.example: The children made a big mess in the kitchen this morning.
mess.exampleZh: 孩子们今天早上把厨房弄得一团糟。

message.example: Please give her a message when she comes back.
message.exampleZh: 她回来后请给她带个口信。

metal.example: The box is made of metal and it feels very cold.
metal.exampleZh: 这个盒子是金属制成的，摸起来很凉。

method.example: This method is easy to learn and works very well.
method.exampleZh: 这个方法容易学习，而且效果很好。

metre.example: The room is five metres long and three metres wide.
metre.exampleZh: 这个房间长五米，宽三米。

middle.example: There is a small table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间有一张小桌子。

might.example: She might come to the party with her brother tonight.
might.exampleZh: 她今晚也许会和她哥哥一起来参加聚会。

mild.example: The weather is mild today, so we can walk outside.
mild.exampleZh: 今天天气温和，所以我们可以到外面散步。

mile.example: The school is only one mile from my house, so I walk there every day.
mile.exampleZh: 学校离我家只有一英里，所以我每天走路去那里。

military.example: The country spends a lot of money on military bases and new weapons.
military.exampleZh: 这个国家在军事基地和新武器上花费了大量资金。

milk.example: She drinks a glass of milk every morning before school.
milk.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前喝一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still makes flour for the town.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的老磨坊仍在为镇上磨面粉。

million.example: This city has more than one million people living in it.
million.exampleZh: 这座城市里住着一百多万人。

millionaire.example: The old millionaire gave most of his money to the poor children.
millionaire.exampleZh: 这位年老的百万富翁把他的大部分钱都给了穷苦的孩子们。

mind.example: Please keep an open mind when you listen to new ideas from others.
mind.exampleZh: 当你听取别人的新想法时，请保持开放的心态。

mine.example: This old mine is famous for its gold and silver.
mine.exampleZh: 这座老矿以出产金银而闻名。

mineral.example: Getting enough calcium and other minerals every day helps keep your bones strong and healthy.
mineral.exampleZh: 每天摄入足够的钙和其他矿物质有助于保持骨骼强壮和健康。

minister.example: The minister spoke to the people about the new law.
minister.exampleZh: 部长就新法律向民众发表了讲话。

minor.example: He had a minor accident last week and only hurt his hand.
minor.exampleZh: 他上周出了个小事故，只伤了手。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students came to the meeting on Friday.
minority.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生周五来参加了会议。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I write a short note.
minute.exampleZh: 请等一分钟，我写一张简短的便条。

mirror.example: The lake was like a mirror and reflected the tall green trees.
mirror.exampleZh: 湖面像一面镜子，映出了高大的绿树。

miss.example: I miss my old friends, and I do not want to miss the train.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友，我也不想错过这趟火车。

missile.example: The missile flew high over the city and landed far away.
missile.exampleZh: 导弹高高飞过城市，落在很远的地方。

mission.example: Her mission is to help poor children learn to read.
mission.exampleZh: 她的使命是帮助贫困儿童学会阅读。

mistake.example: I think I made a mistake in my homework last night.
mistake.exampleZh: 我觉得我昨晚作业里犯了一个错误。

misunderstand.example: Please do not misunderstand me when I say I need more time.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 当我说我需要更多时间时，请不要误解我。

mix.example: Mix the flour and water in a bowl before you add the eggs.
mix.exampleZh: 在加入鸡蛋之前，先把面粉和水在碗里搅拌一下。

mixture.example: The cake recipe needs a mixture of flour, sugar, and eggs.
mixture.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕食谱需要面粉、糖和鸡蛋的混合物。

mobile.example: My mobile phone is small and easy to carry in my bag.
mobile.exampleZh: 我的手机很小，容易放在包里携带。

model.example: This model of car is very popular with young families.
model.exampleZh: 这款车型非常受年轻家庭的欢迎。

modest.example: She is modest about her success and always thanks her team.
modest.exampleZh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚，总是感谢她的团队。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting starts tomorrow.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前修改这个计划。

mom.example: My mom makes breakfast for us every morning before school.
mom.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上学前给我们做早餐。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我去找你的文件。

money.example: I don't have enough money to buy a new bike this year.
money.exampleZh: 我今年没有足够的钱买一辆新自行车。

monitor.example: The class monitor helped the teacher turn on the monitor.
monitor.exampleZh: 班长帮老师打开了显示器。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed the tall tree to eat a banana.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子爬上高高的树去吃香蕉。

month.example: I will visit my grandmother next month during the summer holiday.
month.exampleZh: 我下个月暑假期间会去看望我的祖母。

monthly.example: We have a monthly meeting and she pays her rent monthly.
monthly.exampleZh: 我们每月开一次会，她每月付一次房租。

mood.example: Her good mood made everyone in the office smile all day.
mood.exampleZh: 她的好心情让办公室里的每个人一整天都面带微笑。

moon.example: The moon looks very bright and round in the sky tonight.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮在天空中看起来又亮又圆。

moral.example: The moral of the story is that honesty always wins in the end.
moral.exampleZh: 这个故事的寓意是，诚实最终总会赢。

more.example: She needs more time to finish her homework today.
more.exampleZh: 她今天需要更多时间来完成作业。

moreover.example: The room is clean and quiet; moreover, it is not expensive.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又安静，而且价格也不贵。

morning.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before work.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯咖啡。

most.example: Most of my friends like this song very much.
most.exampleZh: 我的大多数朋友都非常喜欢这首歌。

mother.example: My mother makes breakfast for the family every morning.
mother.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上为家人做早餐。

motion.example: The motion of the train made me feel sleepy.
motion.exampleZh: 火车的晃动让我感到困倦。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate their students to work hard and never give up.
motivate.exampleZh: 好的老师激励学生努力学习，永不放弃。

motor.example: The motor in this old car still works very well.
motor.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的发动机仍然运转良好。

motorcycle.example: My father rides his motorcycle to work every morning.
motorcycle.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上骑摩托车去上班。

mountain.example: We climbed the mountain and saw a beautiful view from the top.
mountain.exampleZh: 我们爬上了那座山，从山顶看到了美丽的景色。

mourn.example: Many people mourn the loss of their loved ones during the holiday season.
mourn.exampleZh: 许多人在节日期间为失去亲人而哀悼。

mouse.example: The little mouse ran under the table when it saw the cat.
mouse.exampleZh: 那只小老鼠看到猫就跑到桌子底下去了。

mouth.example: He opened his mouth wide and took a big bite of the apple.
mouth.exampleZh: 他张大嘴咬了一大口苹果。

move.example: We need to move the table to the other room today.
move.exampleZh: 我们今天需要把桌子搬到另一个房间。

movement.example: The slow movement of the clouds told us a storm was coming.
movement.exampleZh: 云朵缓慢的移动告诉我们暴风雨即将来临。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I don't have much time to finish this work today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成这项工作。

mud.example: After the heavy rain, my shoes were covered in thick mud.
mud.exampleZh: 大雨过后，我的鞋上沾满了厚厚的泥。

multiply.example: If you multiply five by three, you get fifteen.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你用五乘以三，就会得到十五。

murder.example: The police said the man who murdered his neighbor was sent to prison.
murder.exampleZh: 警方说那个谋杀邻居的男人被送进了监狱。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房锻炼，以增强肌肉力量。

museum.example: We visited a big museum with our teacher last Friday.
museum.exampleZh: 上周五我们和老师一起参观了一座大博物馆。

music.example: She listens to soft music every night before going to bed.
music.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会听轻柔的音乐。

musical.example: She is very musical and can play three instruments, and we watched a musical last night.
musical.exampleZh: 她很有音乐天赋，会演奏三种乐器，我们昨晚还看了一部音乐剧。

musician.example: The young musician plays the piano very well and wants to join a band.
musician.exampleZh: 这位年轻的音乐家钢琴弹得非常好，他想加入一个乐队。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you go out to play.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业，然后才能出去玩。

mutual.example: Good friends always show mutual respect for each other's ideas.
mutual.exampleZh: 好朋友总是对彼此的想法表现出相互尊重。

my.example: My book is on the desk near the window in my room.
my.exampleZh: 我的书在我房间里靠窗的桌子上。

myself.example: I made this cake by myself for my mother's birthday.
myself.exampleZh: 这块蛋糕是我亲手为妈妈的生日做的。

nail.example: He used a hammer to hit the nail into the wooden wall.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进木墙里。

name.example: Please write your name at the top of the paper.
name.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在试卷的顶端。

narrow.example: The road is too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条路太窄了，两辆车无法通过。

nation.example: The whole nation celebrated the great victory with songs and dancing.
nation.exampleZh: 全国人民载歌载舞庆祝这场伟大的胜利。

national.example: The national team won a big game last night.
national.exampleZh: 国家队昨晚赢得了一场重要的比赛。

nationality.example: Please write your name and nationality on this form.
nationality.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和国籍。

nationwide.example: The company launched a nationwide campaign to help students read more books.
nationwide.exampleZh: 该公司发起了一项全国性活动，帮助学生多读书。

native.example: She speaks native English and often helps visitors find their way.
native.exampleZh: 她的母语是英语，经常帮助游客指路。

natural.example: It is natural to feel nervous before a big test.
natural.exampleZh: 在大考前感到紧张是很自然的。

nature.example: It is important to protect nature for our children and their future.
nature.exampleZh: 为了保护自然，为了我们的孩子和他们的未来，这样做很重要。

naval.example: He joined the naval academy after finishing high school.
naval.exampleZh: 他高中毕业后进入了海军学院。

navy.example: My uncle joined the navy when he was eighteen years old.
navy.exampleZh: 我叔叔十八岁时加入了海军。

near.example: My new apartment is near the train station and a big park.
near.exampleZh: 我的新公寓靠近火车站和一个大公园。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby, so we often walk there.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，所以我们常去那里散步。

nearly.example: I nearly missed the bus this morning because I woke up late.
nearly.exampleZh: 今天早上我起晚了，差点没赶上公交车。

neat.example: Her room is always neat and clean, which makes her mother happy.
neat.exampleZh: 她的房间总是整洁干净，这让她妈妈很开心。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是必要的。

neck.example: The girl has a red scarf around her neck.
neck.exampleZh: 那个女孩脖子上围着一条红围巾。

need.example: You need to finish your homework before you can go out and play.
need.exampleZh: 你必须在出去玩之前完成作业。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give the child his medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给孩子打针。

negotiate.example: We need to negotiate a better price with the seller before Friday.
negotiate.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前与卖家协商一个更好的价格。

neighbor.example: My neighbor next door often helps me water the plants.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我隔壁的邻居经常帮我给植物浇水。

neighborhood.example: There is a small park in my neighborhood where children often play.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我的街区有一个小公园，孩子们经常在那里玩。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes to get up early on weekends.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢周末早起。

nephew.example: My nephew is only five years old and he loves to play football.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子只有五岁，他喜欢踢足球。

nerve.example: He did not have the nerve to tell her the truth.
nerve.exampleZh: 他没有勇气告诉她真相。

nervous.example: I always feel nervous before I speak in front of many people.
nervous.exampleZh: 在很多人面前讲话之前，我总是感到紧张。

nest.example: The birds built a small nest in the tree near our house.
nest.exampleZh: 鸟儿在我们家附近的树上筑了一个小巢。

net.example: The fisherman pulled the heavy net out of the water.
net.exampleZh: 渔夫把沉重的网从水里拉了出来。

network.example: The city has a large network of buses and trains.
network.exampleZh: 这座城市有一个庞大的公交和火车网络。

never.example: She never drinks coffee after six in the evening.
never.exampleZh: 她从不在晚上六点以后喝咖啡。

nevertheless.example: The test was very hard; nevertheless, she passed it easily.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 考试很难，然而她还是轻松通过了。

new.example: She bought a new dress for the party.
new.exampleZh: 她为聚会买了一条新裙子。

news.example: I watch the news every night to learn what is happening.
news.exampleZh: 我每天晚上看新闻，了解正在发生的事情。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: She is very nice to everyone in our class.
nice.exampleZh: 她对我们班每个人都很友好。

niece.example: My niece is coming to visit us this weekend with her parents.
niece.exampleZh: 我的侄女这周末要和她的父母一起来看我们。

night.example: The stars look very bright in the sky at night.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚天空中星星看起来非常明亮。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so I will buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我要去买一些。

noble.example: He is a noble man who always helps poor people.
noble.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助穷人。

nobody.example: Nobody in my class knew the answer to that easy question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我们班上没有人知道那个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点了点头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上嘈杂的声音让我整夜没睡着。

noisy.example: The street outside my window is very noisy at night.
noisy.exampleZh: 我窗外的街道在夜里非常吵闹。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

none.example: None of the students in my class knew the answer to that question.
none.exampleZh: 我班上没有一个学生知道那个问题的答案。

nonsense.example: Don't talk nonsense; tell me what really happened last night.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别胡说，告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

noodle.example: I eat a hot bowl of noodle soup every cold morning.
noodle.exampleZh: 每个寒冷的早晨我都会吃一碗热腾腾的汤面。

noon.example: We usually have lunch at noon on school days.
noon.exampleZh: 上学的日子我们通常中午吃午饭。

nor.example: He did not call me, nor did he send any message.
nor.exampleZh: 他没有给我打电话，也没有发任何消息。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day.
normal.exampleZh: 在漫长的一天之后感到累是正常的。

north.example: The birds fly north when winter comes every year.
north.exampleZh: 每年冬天来临时，鸟儿都会飞向北方。

northern.example: The northern part of the country is cold and snowy in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部地区冬天寒冷多雪。

nose.example: My little dog has a black nose and big brown eyes.
nose.exampleZh: 我的小狗有一个黑鼻子和一双棕色的大眼睛。

not.example: She is not ready to go to the party tonight.
not.exampleZh: 她还没准备好今晚去参加派对。

note.example: Please note the important words in your notebook before the class begins.
note.exampleZh: 请在上课前把重要的单词记在你的笔记本里。

notebook.example: I write all my new ideas in a small notebook.
notebook.exampleZh: 我把所有的新想法都写在一个小笔记本里。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so we can put our books there.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么也没有，所以我们可以把书放在那里。

notice.example: I did not notice the small notice on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的那张小布告。

novel.example: She wrote a novel about a young girl who travels across the sea.
novel.exampleZh: 她写了一部关于一个漂洋过海的年轻女孩的小说。

now.example: I am busy now, so please call me later.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，请稍后打给我。

nowadays.example: Nowadays many people use their phones to read the news every morning.
nowadays.exampleZh: 如今许多人每天早上都用手机看新闻。

nowhere.example: The cat was nowhere to be found after the storm.
nowhere.exampleZh: 那场暴风雨过后，猫到处都找不到了。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us clean energy without much air pollution.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以为我们提供清洁的能源，而且不会造成太多空气污染。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这一页的顶部。

nurse.example: The nurse takes care of my grandmother every day at the hospital.
nurse.exampleZh: 这位护士每天在医院照顾我的祖母。

nut.example: I eat a nut every morning before I go to work.
nut.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会吃一颗坚果。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点钟起床。

obey.example: Students must obey the school rules and listen to their teachers.
obey.exampleZh: 学生必须遵守校规，听从老师的话。

object.example: She put the small object on the table and then objected to the plan.
object.exampleZh: 她把那个小物体放在桌上，然后反对这个计划。

observe.example: We observe the stars every clear night from our garden.
observe.exampleZh: 每个晴朗的夜晚，我们都会在花园里观察星星。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台获得一张免费地图。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: This is a good occasion to say thank you to my parents.
occasion.exampleZh: 这是一个向我父母道谢的好时机。

occupy.example: The big desk occupies most of the space in my small room.
occupy.exampleZh: 那张大书桌占据了我小房间的大部分空间。

occur.example: Accidents often occur when people are in a hurry.
occur.exampleZh: 人们匆忙时常常会发生事故。

ocean.example: The ocean is very deep and many strange fish live in it.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋非常深，里面生活着许多奇怪的鱼。

october.example: My birthday is in October, so we often eat cake together.
october.exampleZh: 我的生日在十月，所以我们经常一起吃蛋糕。

of.example: The door of my room is made of wood.
of.exampleZh: 我房间的门是木头做的。

off.example: Please turn off the lights before you leave the office.
off.exampleZh: 离开办公室前请把灯关掉。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with that joke.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用那个笑话冒犯你。

offer.example: She decided to offer her old bike to a neighbor for free.
offer.exampleZh: 她决定把她的旧自行车免费送给一位邻居。

office.example: She works in a small office near the train station.
office.exampleZh: 她在火车站附近的一间小办公室里工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the old man find his way home.
officer.exampleZh: 那名警官帮助那位老人找到了回家的路。

official.example: The official report says the new road will open next month.
official.exampleZh: 官方报告称这条新路将于下个月开通。

often.example: I often walk to the park after lunch with my dog.
often.exampleZh: 午饭后我常常带着我的狗去公园散步。

oil.example: Please add some oil to the pan before you cook the eggs.
oil.exampleZh: 煎鸡蛋之前，请往锅里加一些油。

old.example: My grandfather is old, but he still walks to the park every day.
old.exampleZh: 我爷爷年纪大了，但他每天仍然步行去公园。

on.example: The book is on the desk, so please pick it up.
on.exampleZh: 那本书在桌上，请把它拿起来。

once.example: I have only been to Paris once, but I want to go again.
once.exampleZh: 我只去过巴黎一次，但我想再去一次。

one.example: She has one brother and two sisters in her family.
one.exampleZh: 她家里有一个哥哥和两个姐妹。

oneself.example: It is important to take care of oneself when living alone.
oneself.exampleZh: 独自生活时，照顾好自己很重要。

onion.example: My mother put an onion in the soup and it tasted very good.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一个洋葱，汤的味道非常好。

only.example: This is the only key that opens the old front door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开那扇旧前门的钥匙。

open.example: The door is open, so please come in and sit down.

opening.example: The opening of the new store drew a large crowd.
opening.exampleZh: 这家新店的开张开业吸引了一大群人。

operate.example: When you operate this machine, please follow the safety rules.
operate.exampleZh: 操作这台机器时，请遵守安全规则。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation went well and she can go home soon.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很成功，她很快就可以回家了。

operator.example: The operator answered my call and helped me find the right number.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了我的电话，并帮我找到了正确的号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is good for young readers.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书对年轻读者很有好处。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the new plan because it is too expensive.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这个新计划，因为它太贵了。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.

optimistic.example: She is optimistic about finding a new job soon.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对很快找到新工作持乐观态度。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but not both.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，但不能两样都要。

oral.example: Our teacher gave us an oral test instead of a written one.
oral.exampleZh: 老师给我们做了一次口头测试，而不是笔试。

orange.example: I eat an orange every morning and my sister likes orange juice.
orange.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃一个橙子，我妹妹喜欢橙汁。

order.example: The teacher gave us an order to line up in the right way.
order.exampleZh: 老师命令我们按正确的方式排队。

orderly.example: She keeps her desk orderly so she can find things quickly.
orderly.exampleZh: 她把书桌收拾得整整齐齐，这样就能很快找到东西。

ordinary.example: This is just an ordinary day for most people in the town.
ordinary.exampleZh: 对镇上的大多数人来说，这只是普普通通的一天。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体中一个重要的器官。

organic.example: She buys organic vegetables at the small market near her home.
organic.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的小市场买有机蔬菜。

organization.example: Our school organization plans many fun events for students every year.
organization.exampleZh: 我们学校的组织每年为学生策划许多有趣的活动。

organize.example: She helped organize a small party for her best friend.
organize.exampleZh: 她帮忙为最好的朋友筹办了一个小型聚会。

origin.example: The origin of this old song is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这首老歌的由来对我们来说仍然是个谜。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the other one is a copy.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作，另一幅是复制品。

other.example: I have one book here, but my other books are at school.
other.exampleZh: 我这里有一本书，但我的其他书在学校。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late for the school bus.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们赶不上校车了。

ought.example: You ought to call your parents and tell them you are safe.
ought.exampleZh: 你应该给父母打个电话，告诉他们你平安无事。

our.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework today.
our.exampleZh: 我们老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

ours.example: This house is ours, but we share the garden with our neighbors.
ours.exampleZh: 这栋房子是我们的，但我们和邻居共用一个花园。

ourselves.example: We should learn to take care of ourselves when we travel alone.
ourselves.exampleZh: 独自旅行时，我们应该学会照顾好自己。

out.example: My father went out early this morning and came back late.
out.exampleZh: 我父亲今天一早就出去了，很晚才回来。

outdoor.example: We enjoy outdoor games with our friends on warm sunny days.
outdoor.exampleZh: 在温暖晴朗的日子里，我们和朋友们一起玩户外游戏。

outdoors.example: The children like to play outdoors when the weather is nice.
outdoors.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer walls of the old house are painted white.
outer.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的外墙被漆成了白色。

output.example: The factory increased its output by ten percent last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的产量增长了百分之十。

outside.example: The children are playing outside in the garden while their mother cooks dinner.
outside.exampleZh: 妈妈做晚饭的时候，孩子们在外面花园里玩。

over.example: The plane flew over the mountains and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越群山，然后安全降落。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己在公众面前讲话的恐惧。

owe.example: I owe my sister twenty dollars because she paid for my lunch today.
owe.exampleZh: 我欠我姐姐二十美元，因为今天的午饭是她付的钱。

own.example: She wants to start her own small shop next year.
own.exampleZh: 她想明年开一家自己的小店。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop is very friendly to everyone.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主对每个人都很友好。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace so the children could follow.
pace.exampleZh: 他走得很慢，好让孩子们能跟上。

pack.example: I need to pack my clothes and books before the trip.
pack.exampleZh: 旅行前我需要把衣服和书打包好。

package.example: The postman left a small package at my front door this morning.
package.exampleZh: 今天早上邮递员把我的一个小包裹留在了前门。

page.example: He turned the page and began to read the next story.
page.exampleZh: 他翻过这一页，开始读下一个故事。

pain.example: His back pain was so bad that he could not sleep last night.
pain.exampleZh: 他的背痛得很厉害，昨晚都睡不着。

painful.example: It was a painful experience, but I learned a lot from it.
painful.exampleZh: 那是一次痛苦的经历，但我从中学到了很多。

paint.example: We paint the kitchen walls white every summer.
paint.exampleZh: 我们每年夏天都把厨房的墙刷成白色。

painting.example: The painting on the wall is very old and beautiful.
painting.exampleZh: 墙上的那幅画很旧，也很美。

pair.example: She bought a new pair of shoes for the trip.
pair.exampleZh: 她为这次旅行买了一双新鞋。

palace.example: The old king lived in a large palace near the river.
palace.exampleZh: 这位老国王住在河边一座巨大的宫殿里。

pale.example: Her face turned pale when she heard the bad news.
pale.exampleZh: 她听到那个坏消息时脸色变得苍白。

pan.example: She put the eggs in a hot pan and cooked them for breakfast.
pan.exampleZh: 她把鸡蛋放进热平底锅里，煎了当早餐。

panic.example: The loud noise caused a panic among the people in the building.
panic.exampleZh: 巨大的响声在楼里的人群中引起了恐慌。

paper.example: I need a piece of paper to write down the teacher's phone number.
paper.exampleZh: 我需要一张纸来写下老师的电话号码。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of this page and answer the question below.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请阅读这一页的第一段，并回答下面的问题。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路彼此平行延伸了好几英里。

parent.example: My parent always helps me with my homework after dinner.
parent.exampleZh: 我的家长总是在晚饭后帮我做作业。

park.example: We can park the car near the park and walk to the shops.
park.exampleZh: 我们可以把车停在公园附近，然后步行去商店。

parking.example: Parking is free for customers at this shopping mall.
parking.exampleZh: 这家购物中心的顾客可以免费停车。

part.example: She played an important part in building this small school.
part.exampleZh: 她在这所小学校舍的建设中发挥了重要作用。

participate.example: Many students participate in sports and music clubs after school.
participate.exampleZh: 许多学生放学后参加体育和音乐社团。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea in the morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她早上泡茶有一套特别的方法。

particularly.example: I particularly like this small café because the coffee is cheap and good.
particularly.exampleZh: 我特别喜欢这家小咖啡馆，因为咖啡又便宜又好喝。

partly.example: The sky is partly cloudy, so we can still go for a walk.
partly.exampleZh: 天空局部多云，所以我们还是可以去散步。

partner.example: She is my partner in this small business.
partner.exampleZh: 她是我在这家小生意中的合作伙伴。

party.example: My sister joined a new political party last year.
party.exampleZh: 我姐姐去年加入了一个新的政党。

pass.example: We pass the old school every morning on our way to work.
pass.exampleZh: 我们每天早上上班路上都会经过那所旧学校。

passage.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
passage.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

passenger.example: The bus stopped and every passenger got off quickly.
passenger.exampleZh: 公交车停下了，每位乘客都迅速下了车。

passport.example: You must show your passport at the airport before you get on the plane.
passport.exampleZh: 你在机场登机前必须出示护照。

password.example: Please keep your password safe and do not share it with anyone.
password.exampleZh: 请保管好你的密码，不要告诉任何人。

past.example: In the past, people walked to work every day.
past.exampleZh: 过去，人们每天步行去上班。

path.example: We walked along a small path through the quiet forest.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条穿过安静森林的小路走。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with the old man in the morning.
patient.exampleZh: 医生早上对那位老人非常有耐心。

pattern.example: I noticed a clear pattern in the way she studies every day.
pattern.exampleZh: 我注意到她每天的学习方式中有一个明显的模式。

pause.example: We pause for a short break after each lesson.
pause.exampleZh: 我们每节课后都会暂停休息一小会儿。

pay.example: I will pay for the tickets and you can pay me back tomorrow.
pay.exampleZh: 我来付门票钱，你明天还给我就行。

pe.example: We have pe on the school field every Tuesday morning.
pe.exampleZh: 我们每周二上午在学校操场上体育课。

peace.example: The village is quiet and full of peace after the long war.
peace.exampleZh: 漫长的战争过后，这个村庄安静而充满和平。

peaceful.example: The small village is very peaceful in the early morning.
peaceful.exampleZh: 清晨时分，这个小村庄非常宁静。

pear.example: My grandmother picks a ripe pear from the tree in her garden.
pear.exampleZh: 我奶奶从她花园的树上摘下一个熟梨。

pen.example: Please lend me your pen so I can write down the address.
pen.exampleZh: 请把你的钢笔借给我，我好把地址写下来。

pencil.example: I use a pencil to draw a small picture in my book.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用铅笔在我的书里画一幅小画。

penny.example: I only have one penny in my pocket today.
penny.exampleZh: 今天我的口袋里只有一便士。

pension.example: After forty years of work, he now lives on a small monthly pension.
pension.exampleZh: 工作四十年后，他现在靠一份微薄的月度养老金生活。

people.example: Many people in my town like to walk in the park after work.
people.exampleZh: 我们镇上的很多人喜欢下班后在公园里散步。

pepper.example: I like to put black pepper on my eggs at breakfast.
pepper.exampleZh: 我喜欢在早餐时在鸡蛋上撒黑胡椒。

per.example: The bus comes every ten minutes, and we pay two dollars per ride.
per.exampleZh: 公交车每十分钟来一趟，我们每程付两美元。

percent.example: About twenty percent of the students in our class walk to school every day.
percent.exampleZh: 我们班大约百分之二十的学生每天步行上学。

percentage.example: A large percentage of students pass the exam every year.
percentage.exampleZh: 每年有很大比例的学生通过这门考试。

perfect.example: She spent years perfecting her English, and now her speaking is almost perfect.
perfect.exampleZh: 她花了多年时间完善英语，现在她的口语几乎完美了。

perform.example: She will perform a new song at the school show tonight.
perform.exampleZh: 她今晚将在学校演出上表演一首新歌。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play was very good.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校话剧中的表演非常出色。

perhaps.example: Perhaps we can go to the park after lunch today.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许我们可以在今天午饭后去公园。

period.example: This is a very important period in the history of our country.
period.exampleZh: 这是我们国家历史上一个非常重要的时期。

permission.example: My parents gave me permission to go to the party.
permission.exampleZh: 我父母允许我去参加聚会。

permit.example: My parents do not permit me to stay out late on school nights.
permit.exampleZh: 父母不允许我在上学的晚上在外面待到很晚。

person.example: She is a kind person who helps others every day.
person.exampleZh: 她是个善良的人，每天帮助别人。

personal.example: My personal opinion is that we should wait for a better plan.
personal.exampleZh: 我个人的看法是我们应该等待一个更好的方案。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel welcome at work.
personality.exampleZh: 她温暖的个性让每个人在工作中都感到受欢迎。

personally.example: Personally, I think this is the best choice for our team.
personally.exampleZh: 就个人而言，我认为这是我们团队的最佳选择。

persuade.example: She tried to persuade her friend to come with us.
persuade.exampleZh: 她试着说服她的朋友和我们一起去。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on the warm sofa every afternoon.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗每天下午都喜欢睡在温暖的沙发上。

petrol.example: We need to buy some petrol before we drive to the city.
petrol.exampleZh: 我们开车去城里之前需要买一些汽油。

phenomenon.example: The northern lights are a beautiful natural phenomenon that many people travel to see.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 北极光是一种美丽的自然现象，许多人专程前往观赏。

phone.example: Please phone me when you get home, because I need to ask you something important.
phone.exampleZh: 你到家后请给我打电话，因为我需要问你一些重要的事。

photo.example: I took a photo of my family at the park yesterday.
photo.exampleZh: 昨天我在公园给家人拍了一张照片。

photograph.example: Please take a photograph of the whole family in front of the house.
photograph.exampleZh: 请在那座房子前给全家人拍一张照片。

photographer.example: The photographer took many beautiful pictures at our school party last week.
photographer.exampleZh: 这位摄影师上周在我们学校的聚会上拍了很多漂亮的照片。

phrase.example: This common phrase is easy to remember and use every day.
phrase.exampleZh: 这个常用短语容易记住，也便于每天使用。

physical.example: Regular physical activity is good for both your body and your mind.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动对你的身体和心理都有好处。

physician.example: The physician told me to rest and drink more water.
physician.exampleZh: 医生让我多休息、多喝水。

physicist.example: The physicist explained how light travels through space in a simple way.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位物理学家用简单的方式解释了光如何在太空中传播。

physics.example: I find physics hard, but my teacher makes the lessons interesting.
physics.exampleZh: 我觉得物理很难，但老师让这些课变得有趣。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚做完作业后弹钢琴。

pick.example: Please pick a book from the shelf and read it.
pick.exampleZh: 请从书架上挑一本书来读。

picnic.example: We had a picnic in the park with our friends on Sunday.
picnic.exampleZh: 星期天我们和朋友在公园里野餐。

picture.example: She took a picture of the old bridge and showed it to us.
picture.exampleZh: 她拍了一张那座老桥的照片，并拿给我们看。

pie.example: My mother made an apple pie for us yesterday.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨天给我们做了一个苹果派。

piece.example: She gave me a piece of cake and a cup of tea.
piece.exampleZh: 她给了我一块蛋糕和一杯茶。

pig.example: The pig is eating corn in the small yard behind our house.
pig.exampleZh: 那头猪正在我们房子后面的小院子里吃玉米。

pile.example: There is a pile of books on my desk.

pill.example: The doctor told me to take one pill after dinner every day.
pill.exampleZh: 医生让我每天晚饭后吃一片药。

pillar.example: The old stone pillar in the square holds up the heavy roof.
pillar.exampleZh: 广场上那根古老的石柱支撑着沉重的屋顶。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head before going to sleep.
pillow.exampleZh: 睡觉前，我在头下放了一个柔软的枕头。

pilot.example: The pilot flew the small plane over the mountains before the storm came.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员在暴风雨来临前驾驶小型飞机飞越了群山。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把纸固定在公告板上。

pine.example: There is a tall pine tree in front of our house.
pine.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵高大的松树。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress to the party last night.
pink.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加派对。

pint.example: I bought a pint of milk at the small shop.
pint.exampleZh: 我在那家小商店买了一品脱牛奶。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in computer science and helped many young women.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的先驱，帮助了许多年轻女性。

pipe.example: The old man cleaned his pipe and then filled it with fresh tobacco.
pipe.exampleZh: 老人清理了他的烟斗，然后装上新鲜的烟草。

pity.example: It is a pity that you cannot come to my birthday party.
pity.exampleZh: 很遗憾你不能来参加我的生日聚会。

place.example: This is a good place to sit and read a book.
place.exampleZh: 这是一个坐下来读书的好地方。

plain.example: Please write in plain English so everyone can understand your message.
plain.exampleZh: 请用通俗易懂的英语来写，这样每个人都能看懂你的信息。

plan.example: We need a clear plan before we start the work.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始工作之前，我们需要一个清晰的计划。

plane.example: The plane flies high above the clouds on its way to Beijing.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方高高飞行，前往北京。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet we know that has life.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们所知唯一有生命的行星。

plant.example: The plant in our factory is very green and tall.
plant.exampleZh: 我们工厂里的那棵植物又绿又高。

plastic.example: This cheap bag is made of plastic and breaks very easily.
plastic.exampleZh: 这个便宜的包是塑料做的，很容易坏。

plate.example: She put the hot soup in a white plate on the table.
plate.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一个白盘子里。

platform.example: Please wait for the train on platform three.
