play.example: The children like to play games in the park after school.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在公园里玩游戏。

player.example: The young player scored two goals in the game last night.
player.exampleZh: 这位年轻选手在昨晚的比赛中进了两个球。

playground.example: The children are playing soccer in the playground after school.
playground.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在操场上踢足球。

pleasant.example: We had a pleasant afternoon at the park with our friends.
pleasant.exampleZh: 我们和朋友们在公园度过了一个愉快的下午。

please.example: Please sit down and tell me what makes you happy today.
please.exampleZh: 请坐下，告诉我今天什么让你开心。

pleasure.example: It is a great pleasure to meet you and your family today.
pleasure.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人是一件非常愉快的事。

plenty.example: There is plenty of food and water for everyone here.
plenty.exampleZh: 这里有充足的食物和水供每个人使用。

plot.example: The plot of the movie is simple but very interesting.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影的情节很简单，但非常有趣。

plug.example: Please plug the lamp into the socket near the door before it gets dark.
plug.exampleZh: 天黑之前，请把台灯插到门边的插座上。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and this fact is easy to learn.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，这个事实很容易记住。

pocket.example: He put the small key into his coat pocket and left the room.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把那把小小的钥匙放进外套口袋里，然后离开了房间。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: The poet wrote a short poem about the river near his home.
poet.exampleZh: 这位诗人写了一首关于他家附近河流的短诗。

point.example: She pointed at the map and showed me the most important point.
point.exampleZh: 她指着地图，给我指出了最重要的那一点。

poison.example: He put poison on the food to kill the rats in the old house.
poison.exampleZh: 他在食物上放了毒药，用来杀死老房子里的老鼠。

poisonous.example: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, so we should never eat them.
poisonous.exampleZh: 有些野生蘑菇是有毒的，所以我们绝不要吃它们。

pole.example: The flag hangs from a tall pole in the school yard.
pole.exampleZh: 旗帜悬挂在学校院子里的一根高杆上。

police.example: The police came quickly and helped the lost child find his parents.
police.exampleZh: 警察很快赶来，帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

policeman.example: The policeman helped the little boy find his mother in the park.
policeman.exampleZh: 警察在公园里帮助小男孩找到了他的妈妈。

policy.example: The company has a new policy about working from home.
policy.exampleZh: 公司有了一项关于居家办公的新政策。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 她在学校对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: She often talks about political problems with her friends at work.
political.exampleZh: 她经常和同事朋友谈论政治问题。

politician.example: The politician gave a short speech to the crowd outside the hall.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家在大厅外向人群做了简短的演讲。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at a good university in the north.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方一所好大学学习政治学。

pollute.example: Factories should not pollute the river with dirty water.
pollute.exampleZh: 工厂不应该用脏水污染这条河。

pollution.example: Air pollution in the city is bad for children's health.
pollution.exampleZh: 城市里的空气污染对儿童健康有害。

pond.example: There are many small fish in the pond behind our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家后面的池塘里有很多小鱼。

pool.example: The children swim in the small pool behind their house every summer.
pool.exampleZh: 每年夏天孩子们都在他们房子后面的小水池里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small old house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边一座破旧的小房子里。

pop.example: Pop music is popular with young people, and new songs pop up everywhere.
pop.exampleZh: 流行音乐在年轻人中很受欢迎，新歌到处涌现。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people in our city.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

population.example: The population of this small town grows every year.
population.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人口每年都在增长。

pork.example: My mother cooked pork with potatoes for dinner last night.
pork.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈做了猪肉炖土豆当晚餐。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early this morning.
port.exampleZh: 这艘船今天一早抵达了港口。

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry on trips.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧的便携收音机在旅行时很容易携带。

portion.example: I only ate a small portion of the cake and saved the rest for later.
portion.exampleZh: 我只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的留到以后吃。

portrait.example: She hung a portrait of her grandmother on the living room wall.
portrait.exampleZh: 她把祖母的画像挂在客厅的墙上。

position.example: She found a good position near the window and sat down.
position.exampleZh: 她在窗边找了个好位置坐了下来。

positive.example: She has a positive attitude and always helps her classmates.
positive.exampleZh: 她态度积极，总是帮助同学。

possess.example: She possesses a rare talent for making people feel welcome.
possess.exampleZh: 她拥有一种让人感到受欢迎的罕见天赋。

possession.example: He lost all his possessions in the fire last night.
possession.exampleZh: 昨晚的火灾中他失去了所有财产。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that the plan will fail.
possibility.exampleZh: 这个计划确实有失败的可能性。

possible.example: It is possible that we will arrive late tonight.

possibly.example: She will possibly arrive late because of the heavy rain.
possibly.exampleZh: 由于大雨，她可能会晚到。

post.example: She posted a short letter and started her new post at the post office.
post.exampleZh: 她寄了一封短信，然后在邮局开始了她的新岗位。

postage.example: The postage for sending this letter to another country is quite expensive.
postage.exampleZh: 把封信寄到另一个国家的邮资相当贵。

postcard.example: I sent a postcard to my friend from the beach last summer.
postcard.exampleZh: 去年夏天我从海滩给朋友寄了一张明信片。

poster.example: She put a poster of her favorite singer on the wall.
poster.exampleZh: 她把最喜欢的歌手的一张海报贴在了墙上。

postman.example: The postman brings a letter to our house every morning.
postman.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上给我们家送一封信。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting until next Monday because of the storm.
postpone.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨，我们不得不把会议推迟到下周一。

pot.example: She put the hot soup in a big pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进炉子上的大锅里。

potato.example: My mother makes a hot potato soup every cold winter evening.
potato.exampleZh: 每个寒冷的冬夜，我妈妈都会做一锅热腾腾的土豆汤。

potential.example: She has great potential, and her teachers believe she can pass the exam.
potential.exampleZh: 她很有潜力，老师们相信她能通过考试。

pound.example: My heart began to pound when I heard the heavy rain on the roof.
pound.exampleZh: 听到屋顶上的大雨声，我的心开始狂跳。

pour.example: She poured the hot water into a cup and waited for the tea.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热水倒进杯子里，等着茶泡好。

poverty.example: Many families in this small town still live in poverty today.
poverty.exampleZh: 这个小镇上的许多家庭至今仍生活在贫困之中。

powder.example: She mixed the white powder with water and made a soft paste.
powder.exampleZh: 她把白色粉末和水混合，做成了柔软的糊状物。

power.example: The new machine needs a lot of power to run.
power.exampleZh: 这台新机器运行需要大量电力。

powerful.example: This small car has a powerful engine that saves fuel.
powerful.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车有一台强劲又省油的发动机。

practical.example: Her advice is very practical and helps us save time.
practical.exampleZh: 她的建议很实用，能帮我们节省时间。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English speaking skills.
practice.exampleZh: 每日练习是提高英语口语能力的最佳方式。

practise.example: I practise English every morning before I go to school.
practise.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前练习英语。

praise.example: My teacher praised me for my hard work on the project.
praise.exampleZh: 老师表扬了我在这个项目上的努力。

pray.example: I pray for good health and happiness for my family every night.
pray.exampleZh: 我每晚都为家人的健康和幸福祈祷。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before going to bed last night.
prayer.exampleZh: 昨晚睡觉前，她轻声做了一段祷告。

precious.example: This old photo is very precious to my whole family.
precious.exampleZh: 这张旧照片对我们全家来说非常珍贵。

prefer.example: I prefer reading books at home to going out on rainy days.
prefer.exampleZh: 下雨天我更喜欢在家看书，而不是出门。

preference.example: She has a strong preference for tea over coffee in the morning.
preference.exampleZh: 她早上更偏爱茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: She is pregnant with her second child and feels very happy.
pregnant.exampleZh: 她怀着第二个孩子，感到非常幸福。

prejudice.example: We must fight prejudice and treat everyone fairly.
prejudice.exampleZh: 我们必须反对偏见，公平对待每一个人。

premier.example: The premier of the country met the premier team of doctors yesterday.
premier.exampleZh: 该国总理昨天会见了顶尖的医生团队。

preparation.example: Good preparation before the exam helps students feel calm and confident.
preparation.exampleZh: 考试前做好充分准备能让学生感到平静和自信。

prepare.example: I need to prepare dinner for my family tonight.
prepare.exampleZh: 今晚我需要为家人准备晚饭。

present.example: She was present at the meeting and gave him a small present.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并送给他一份小礼物。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old forest for our children.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护好这片古老的森林。

president.example: The president of the company gave a short speech to all the workers.
president.exampleZh: 公司总裁向所有员工做了简短的讲话。

press.example: She pressed the button and waited for the door to open.
press.exampleZh: 她按了按钮，然后等门打开。

pressure.example: Students often feel a lot of pressure before important exams at school.
pressure.exampleZh: 学生们在学校重要考试前常常感到很大的压力。

pretend.example: He likes to pretend that he is a famous singer.
pretend.exampleZh: 他喜欢假装自己是个著名歌手。

pretty.example: She is a pretty girl and her English is pretty good.
pretty.exampleZh: 她是个漂亮的女孩，她的英语也相当不错。

prevent.example: We must prevent the fire from spreading to the other houses.
prevent.exampleZh: 我们必须防止火势蔓延到其他房屋。

preview.example: The teacher gave us a short preview of the new lesson.
preview.exampleZh: 老师给我们简短地预习了新课。

price.example: The price of this red car is too high for me.
price.exampleZh: 这辆红色汽车的价格对我来说太高了。

pride.example: She takes great pride in her work and never gives up.
pride.exampleZh: 她对自己的工作深感自豪，从不放弃。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English quickly.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是为想快速学会英语的学生写的。

primary.example: Our primary goal is to help students read and write with confidence.
primary.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是帮助学生自信地阅读和写作。

prime.example: This is the prime time to ask for help from your teacher.
prime.exampleZh: 这是向老师寻求帮助的最佳时机。

prime minister.example: The prime minister gave a short speech to the people.
prime minister.exampleZh: 首相向人民发表了简短的讲话。

primitive.example: Their tools were primitive and made of stone and wood.
primitive.exampleZh: 他们的工具很原始，是用石头和木头做的。

principle.example: The principle of fairness guides all our decisions.
principle.exampleZh: 公平原则指导我们所有的决定。

print.example: Please print two copies of the report for the meeting.
print.exampleZh: 请为会议打印两份报告。

printer.example: Our new printer is fast and very easy to use.
printer.exampleZh: 我们的新打印机速度很快，而且非常容易使用。

prior.example: She had a prior meeting, so we moved our talk to Friday.
prior.exampleZh: 她之前有个会议，所以我们把谈话改到了周五。

priority.example: My top priority today is to finish the report before lunch.
priority.exampleZh: 我今天最优先的事是在午饭前完成这份报告。

prison.example: He spent three years in prison for stealing a car.
prison.exampleZh: 他因偷车在监狱里待了三年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner escaped from the old jail last night.
prisoner.exampleZh: 那名囚犯昨晚从旧监狱逃走了。

private.example: He keeps his private life secret and never talks about it at work.
private.exampleZh: 他把自己的私生活保密起来，在工作中从不谈起。

privilege.example: It is a great privilege to work with such kind and helpful people.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这样善良、乐于助人的人一起工作，是一种莫大的荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the city music contest last year.
prize.exampleZh: 她在去年的全市音乐比赛中获得了一等奖。

probable.example: It is probable that the train will arrive late today.
probable.exampleZh: 今天火车很可能晚点到达。

probably.example: It will probably rain tomorrow, so please take an umbrella with you.
probably.exampleZh: 明天很可能会下雨，所以请带上一把伞。

problem.example: We have a small problem with the new computer in our office.
problem.exampleZh: 我们办公室的新电脑出了个小问题。

procedure.example: Please follow the correct procedure before you start the test.
procedure.exampleZh: 开始测试前，请遵循正确的步骤。

proceed.example: We will proceed with the meeting after lunch.
proceed.exampleZh: 午饭后我们将继续进行会议。

process.example: The teacher explained the whole process step by step with simple examples.
process.exampleZh: 老师用简单的例子一步一步地解释了整个过程。

produce.example: Local farmers produce fresh vegetables and sell them at the town market.
produce.exampleZh: 当地农民生产新鲜蔬菜，并在镇上的市场出售。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased production of cars last year to meet demand.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年提高了汽车产量以满足需求。

profession.example: She chose teaching as her profession after college.
profession.exampleZh: 大学毕业后，她选择了教师作为自己的职业。

professional.example: She is very professional and always helps her students after class.
professional.exampleZh: 她非常专业，总是在课后帮助她的学生。

professor.example: My professor is very kind and helps us after class.
professor.exampleZh: 我的教授非常和蔼，课后还会帮助我们。

profit.example: The small shop makes a good profit every month.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店每个月都能获得不错的利润。

programme.example: The school programme includes music, sports and a short play.
programme.exampleZh: 学校的活动计划包括音乐、体育和一出短剧。

progress.example: She has made good progress in English this year.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上取得了很大进步。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next month.
project.exampleZh: 我们团队下个月将开始一个新项目。

promise.example: I promise to call you after work tonight.
promise.exampleZh: 我答应今晚下班后给你打电话。

promote.example: The company wants to promote her because she works very hard.
promote.exampleZh: 公司想提拔她，因为她工作非常努力。

pronounce.example: Can you pronounce this word for me?
pronounce.exampleZh: 你能为我读一下这个单词的发音吗？

pronunciation.example: Her English pronunciation is much better than it was last year.
pronunciation.exampleZh: 她的英语发音比去年好多了。

proof.example: Do you have any proof that he took the money?
proof.exampleZh: 你有任何证据证明他拿了那笔钱吗？

proper.example: It is important to use the proper tool for each job.
proper.exampleZh: 为每项工作使用合适的工具是很重要的。

properly.example: Please wash your hands properly before you eat dinner.
properly.exampleZh: 吃晚饭前请正确地洗手。

property.example: This old house is the most valuable property his family owns.
property.exampleZh: 这栋老房子是他家拥有的最有价值的财产。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She made a simple proposal to save money for the team.
proposal.exampleZh: 她提出了一个简单的建议，为团队省钱。

propose.example: I propose that we meet early tomorrow to plan the trip.
propose.exampleZh: 我建议我们明天早点见面来计划这次旅行。

prospect.example: The prospect of a better job keeps him hopeful.
prospect.exampleZh: 找到一份更好工作的前景让他充满希望。

protect.example: Parents should protect their children from danger at all times.
protect.exampleZh: 父母应当时刻保护孩子远离危险。

protection.example: Good protection for your skin is very important in summer.
protection.exampleZh: 在夏天，对皮肤的良好防护非常重要。

proud.example: She is proud of her little brother for finishing the race.
proud.exampleZh: 她为弟弟跑完全程而感到自豪。

prove.example: The tests prove that the new medicine is safe for children.
prove.exampleZh: 这些测试证明这种新药对儿童是安全的。

provide.example: Our school provides free books and lunch for every student.
provide.exampleZh: 我们学校为每位学生提供免费的书和午餐。

province.example: She grew up in a small town in the northern province.
province.exampleZh: 她在北方省份的一个小镇长大。

public.example: The new library is open to the public every day.
public.exampleZh: 这座新图书馆每天向公众开放。

publication.example: The publication of her new book made many young readers very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她新书的出版让许多年轻读者非常高兴。

publish.example: They will publish her new book next month in many countries.
publish.exampleZh: 他们下个月将在许多国家出版她的新书。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy door open with both hands.
pull.exampleZh: 请用双手把那扇沉重的门拉开。

pulse.example: The doctor checked my pulse and said I was healthy.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生检查了我的脉搏，说我很健康。

pump.example: She used a pump to put air into the bicycle tires.
pump.exampleZh: 她用打气筒给自行车轮胎打气。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for work and never arrives late.
punctual.exampleZh: 她上班总是很准时，从不迟到。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚在考试中作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The punishment for breaking the school rules was a week of cleaning the classroom.
punishment.exampleZh: 违反校规的惩罚是打扫教室一周。

pupil.example: The pupil raised his hand to ask the teacher a question.
pupil.exampleZh: 那个小学生举手向老师提问。

purchase.example: We decided to purchase a new car for our family.
purchase.exampleZh: 我们决定为家里购买一辆新车。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and safe to drink.
pure.exampleZh: 这个山间湖泊里的水是纯净的，可以安全饮用。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条紫色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

purpose.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan our next project.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是规划我们的下一个项目。

purse.example: She took some coins out of her purse to pay for the bus.
purse.exampleZh: 她从钱包里拿出一些硬币来付公交车费。

pursue.example: She wants to pursue a career in medicine after college.
pursue.exampleZh: 她想在大学毕业后从事医学方面的职业。

push.example: Please push the door gently and it will open by itself.
push.exampleZh: 请轻轻推门，它就会自己打开。

put.example: Please put the books on the table before you leave the room.
put.exampleZh: 请在离开房间前把书放在桌子上。

quake.example: The quake shook the whole town and broke many old windows.
quake.exampleZh: 地震震动了整个小镇，打破了许多旧窗户。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this teaching job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份教学工作所需的资格。

qualify.example: She must pass the final test to qualify for the job.
qualify.exampleZh: 她必须通过最后的测试才能胜任这份工作。

quality.example: The quality of this small shop's fresh bread is very good.
quality.exampleZh: 这家小店的鲜面包质量非常好。

quantity.example: The quantity of water in the bottle is not enough for us.
quantity.exampleZh: 瓶子里的水量不够我们用。

quarrel.example: They had a small quarrel about money last night.
quarrel.exampleZh: 昨晚他们因为钱发生了一场小小的争吵。

quarter.example: Cut the apple into four pieces, and each piece is a quarter.
quarter.exampleZh: 把苹果切成四块，每一块都是四分之一。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big old palace with her family.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人住在一座古老的大宫殿里。

question.example: I have a question about the homework, so please help me.
question.exampleZh: 我对作业有个问题，请帮帮我。

questionnaire.example: Please fill out this short questionnaire before you leave the office today.
questionnaire.exampleZh: 请今天离开办公室前填写这份简短的问卷。

queue.example: Many people queue outside the store to buy the new phone.
queue.exampleZh: 许多人在商店外排队购买这款新手机。

quick.example: Tom is a quick runner and he often wins the school race.
quick.exampleZh: 汤姆是个跑得很快的人，他经常在学校赛跑中获胜。

quickly.example: The little boy quickly ran to the door when he heard the bell.
quickly.exampleZh: 小男孩听到铃声后迅速跑向门口。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet, so please speak in a low voice.
quiet.exampleZh: 图书馆非常安静，所以请小声说话。

quilt.example: My grandmother made a warm quilt for me last winter.
quilt.exampleZh: 去年冬天我奶奶给我做了一床暖和的棉被。

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and move to another city.
quit.exampleZh: 他决定辞掉工作，搬到另一座城市去。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, so I finished it in ten minutes.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，所以我十分钟就做完了。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz on the new words today.
quiz.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们做了一次关于新单词的小测验。

quote.example: He likes to quote a famous line from his favorite movie.
quote.exampleZh: 他喜欢引用他最喜欢的电影里的一句著名台词。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit lives in a small hole near the big tree.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔住在大树附近的一个小洞里。

race.example: The boys will race each other to the big tree after school.
race.exampleZh: 放学后男孩们会比赛谁先跑到那棵大树。

racial.example: Many people are working hard to stop racial problems in schools and at work.
racial.exampleZh: 许多人正在努力制止学校和职场中的种族问题。

radiation.example: Too much radiation from the sun can hurt your skin.
radiation.exampleZh: 来自太阳的过多辐射会伤害你的皮肤。

radio.example: Every morning my grandfather listens to the news on an old radio in the kitchen.
radio.exampleZh: 每天早上，我爷爷在厨房里用一台旧收音机听新闻。

rag.example: She cleaned the dusty table with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 她用一块旧抹布擦干净了满是灰尘的桌子。

rail.example: Hold the rail while you walk down the stairs.

railway.example: The new railway connects the small town with the big city.
railway.exampleZh: 这条新铁路把小城镇和大城市连接起来。

rain.example: The rain stopped, so we walked to school together.
rain.exampleZh: 雨停了，所以我们一起走路去上学。

rainbow.example: After the storm, a colorful rainbow appeared in the sky.
rainbow.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，天空中出现了五彩缤纷的彩虹。

raise.example: The company plans to raise prices next month and hire more workers.
raise.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月提高价格并雇用更多工人。

range.example: The shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

rank.example: He reached the rank of captain after ten years in the army.
rank.exampleZh: 他在部队服役十年后晋升到上尉军衔。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs for local people.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展为当地人带来了许多新工作。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这个温暖的城市里看到雪是很罕见的。

rarely.example: She rarely eats breakfast because she is always in a hurry.
rarely.exampleZh: 她很少吃早餐，因为她总是很匆忙。

rat.example: The rat ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the old table.
rat.exampleZh: 那只老鼠跑过厨房地板，躲到了旧桌子下面。

rate.example: The rate of inflation is rising faster than most people expected this year.
rate.exampleZh: 今年的通货膨胀率上升得比大多数人预期的要快。

rather.example: The movie was rather long, but we still enjoyed it a lot.
rather.exampleZh: 这部电影相当长，但我们还是很喜欢它。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生与女生的比例是二比一。

raw.example: We bought raw fish at the market and cooked it at home.
raw.exampleZh: 我们在市场买了生鱼，然后回家煮了。

ray.example: A ray of light came through the small window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一束光线透过小窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

razor.example: My father uses a sharp razor to shave his face every morning.
razor.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上用一把锋利的剃须刀刮脸。

reach.example: We reached the small town before it got dark.
reach.exampleZh: 我们在天黑前到达了那个小镇。

react.example: People react quickly when they see danger on the road.
react.exampleZh: 人们看到路上的危险时会很快做出反应。

reaction.example: Her reaction to the news was calm and very quiet.
reaction.exampleZh: 她对这个消息的反应平静而十分安静。

read.example: I like to read a book before I go to sleep.
read.exampleZh: 我喜欢在睡觉前读一本书。

reader.example: This book is a good reader for young children.
reader.exampleZh: 这本书是一本适合幼儿的好读物。

reading.example: My father enjoys reading the newspaper every morning before breakfast.
reading.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢每天早饭前读报纸。

ready.example: I am always ready to help my friends with their work.
ready.exampleZh: 我总是乐意帮助朋友们做他们的工作。

real.example: Is this a real gold ring or just a cheap copy?
real.exampleZh: 这是一枚真金戒指，还是只是廉价的仿制品？

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan if we want to finish this work on time.
realistic.exampleZh: 如果我们想按时完成这项工作，就需要一个现实的计划。

reality.example: We must accept the reality of our situation and find a new plan.
reality.exampleZh: 我们必须接受我们处境的现实，并找到一个新的计划。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until my mother called me.
realize.exampleZh: 直到妈妈打电话给我，我才意识到已经这么晚了。

really.example: I really like this small book because it is easy to read.
really.exampleZh: 我真的很喜欢这本小书，因为它读起来很容易。

reason.example: There is a good reason for his decision to leave early.
reason.exampleZh: 他提早离开的决定有一个充分的理由。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for a small break after two hours of work.
reasonable.exampleZh: 工作两小时后要求短暂休息一下是合理的。

recall.example: I cannot recall the name of the book you lent me.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起你借给我的那本书的名字了。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt in case you want to return the shoes.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以防你想退鞋。

receive.example: I receive many emails from my new friends every day.
receive.exampleZh: 我每天都会收到新朋友们发来的许多电子邮件。

recent.example: Her recent trip to Japan made her want to study the language.
recent.exampleZh: 她最近的日本之行让她想学这门语言。

recently.example: I have recently started learning to cook simple meals at home.
recently.exampleZh: 我最近开始在家学习做简单的饭菜。

reception.example: The hotel reception is on the first floor near the main door.
reception.exampleZh: 酒店接待处位于一楼，靠近大门。

recite.example: In class, she had to recite a short poem from memory.
recite.exampleZh: 课堂上，她必须凭记忆背诵一首短诗。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him at first because he looked so different.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出他，因为他看起来变化太大了。

recommend.example: I recommend this book to all my friends.
recommend.exampleZh: 我把这本书推荐给我所有的朋友。

record.example: She keeps a record of every book she reads at school.
record.exampleZh: 她记录下自己在学校读过的每一本书。

recorder.example: She put a small recorder on the table to record the meeting.
recorder.exampleZh: 她在桌上放了一个小录音机，用来录制会议。

recover.example: She is slowly recovering from a bad cold and will return to work soon.
recover.exampleZh: 她正慢慢从重感冒中康复，很快就能回去上班。

recovery.example: The doctor said her full recovery would take a few more weeks.
recovery.exampleZh: 医生说她完全康复还需要几个星期。

red.example: She wore a bright red dress to the party last night.
red.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条鲜红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

reduce.example: We should reduce the amount of sugar we eat every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们应该减少每天摄入的糖量。

refer.example: Please refer to the dictionary if you do not know this word.
refer.exampleZh: 如果你不认识这个单词，请查阅词典。

reference.example: She gave me a useful reference for my new job.
reference.exampleZh: 她为我的新工作给了我一封有用的推荐信。

reflect.example: The calm lake reflects the mountains and the sky very clearly.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面非常清晰地映出群山和天空。

reflection.example: The reflection of the trees in the lake looked very clear this morning.
reflection.exampleZh: 今天早上湖面上树木的倒影看起来非常清晰。

reform.example: The new leader wants to reform the old tax system soon.
reform.exampleZh: 这位新领导人希望很快改革旧的税收制度。

refresh.example: A cold drink will refresh you after a long walk.
refresh.exampleZh: 走很长一段路后，一杯冷饮会让你恢复精力。

refrigerator.example: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator after you use it.
refrigerator.exampleZh: 用完牛奶后请把它放回冰箱里。

refuse.example: She refused to eat the food and threw it in the trash.
refuse.exampleZh: 她不肯吃那些食物，把它扔进了垃圾桶。

regard.example: I regard her as a good friend and trust her advice.
regard.exampleZh: 我把她看作好朋友，并信任她的建议。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding the new class schedule.
regarding.exampleZh: 关于新的课程安排，我有一个问题。

regardless.example: We will go outside regardless of the rain tomorrow.
regardless.exampleZh: 不管明天是否下雨，我们都会出去。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and beautiful mountains.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以茶叶和美丽的山而闻名。

register.example: Please register for the class at the front desk before you enter.
register.exampleZh: 进入前请在前台登记报名这个课程。

regret.example: I regret not calling her before she left the city.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在她离开这座城市之前没有给她打电话。

regular.example: She takes regular exercise and eats simple, healthy food every day.
regular.exampleZh: 她每天进行有规律的锻炼，吃简单健康的食物。

regularly.example: She regularly walks to school with her younger brother every morning.
regularly.exampleZh: 她每天早上都定期和弟弟一起步行去学校。

reject.example: The manager decided to reject our plan because it cost too much money.
reject.exampleZh: 经理决定拒绝我们的计划，因为它的成本太高。

relate.example: I can relate this story to my own life.
relate.exampleZh: 我能把这个故事和我自己的生活联系起来。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries has become much better in recent years.
relation.exampleZh: 近年来，两国之间的关系已经好多了。

relationship.example: She has a good relationship with her parents and her teachers at school.
relationship.exampleZh: 她和父母以及学校里的老师关系都很好。

relative.example: My relative from another city will stay with us for a few days.
relative.exampleZh: 我的一位来自另一个城市的亲戚将和我们一起住几天。

relatively.example: This book is relatively easy, so you can finish it in two days.
relatively.exampleZh: 这本书相对容易，所以你两天内就能读完。

relax.example: After a long day at work, I like to relax with some soft music.
relax.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，我喜欢听些轻音乐来放松一下。

relaxation.example: I listen to soft music for relaxation after a long day at work.
relaxation.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，我听轻音乐来放松。

release.example: The band will release their new album next Friday.
release.exampleZh: 乐队下周五将发行他们的新专辑。

relevant.example: Please give me all the relevant information about this job.
relevant.exampleZh: 请把与这份工作有关的全部信息都给我。

reliability.example: The reliability of this old car makes it a good choice for long trips.
reliability.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的可靠性使它成为长途旅行的好选择。

reliable.example: She is a reliable friend who always helps me when I need it.
reliable.exampleZh: 她是个可靠的朋友，我需要时她总会帮我。

relief.example: After the exam, she felt great relief and smiled at her friends.
relief.exampleZh: 考试结束后，她感到如释重负，对着朋友们笑了。

relieve.example: A hot bath can relieve the pain in your back after a long day.
relieve.exampleZh: 辛苦一天后，洗个热水澡能减轻你背部的疼痛。

religion.example: For many people, religion is a big part of daily life.
religion.exampleZh: 对许多人来说，宗教是日常生活中很重要的一部分。

religious.example: Her family is very religious and goes to church every Sunday.
religious.exampleZh: 她的家人非常虔诚，每个星期天都去教堂。

rely.example: You can rely on this simple map when you travel.
rely.exampleZh: 旅行时你可以依靠这张简单的地图。

remain.example: Only a few old houses remain in the village today.
remain.exampleZh: 如今村子里只剩下几座老房子了。

remark.example: His remark about the meeting made everyone stop and think.
remark.exampleZh: 他对会议的那句评论让每个人都停下来思考。

remarkable.example: Her progress in English this year has been truly remarkable.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上的进步确实非常显著。

remember.example: I still remember the first day I met my best friend.
remember.exampleZh: 我仍然记得遇见我最好的朋友的第一天。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tonight.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我今晚给妈妈打电话。

remote.example: He lives in a small remote village far from the city.
remote.exampleZh: 他住在一个远离城市的偏僻小村庄里。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you walk into the room.

render.example: The teacher will render the difficult poem into simple English for us.
render.exampleZh: 老师会为我们把这首难懂的诗翻译成简单的英语。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before Friday.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在星期五之前续借我的图书馆书籍。

rent.example: We rent a small apartment near the office and pay the rent monthly.
rent.exampleZh: 我们在办公室附近租了一间小公寓，每月付租金。

repair.example: My father helped me repair my old bike after school yesterday.
repair.exampleZh: 昨天放学后，我父亲帮我修好了我的旧自行车。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone in the room can hear it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，让房间里的每个人都能听见。

repeatedly.example: He asked the same question repeatedly, but no one gave him an answer.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 他一再问同一个问题，但没有人给他答案。

replace.example: We need to replace the old computer with a new one.
replace.exampleZh: 我们需要用一台新电脑更换那台旧电脑。

reply.example: She did not reply to my email about the meeting.
reply.exampleZh: 她没有回复我那封关于会议的邮件。

report.example: The teacher asked us to report the accident to the school office today.
report.exampleZh: 老师让我们今天把这件事报告给学校办公室。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the man some questions about the fire.
reporter.exampleZh: 记者就那场火灾问了那名男子一些问题。

represent.example: The red rose represents love in many famous old stories.
represent.exampleZh: 在许多著名的古老故事中，红玫瑰代表爱情。

representative.example: She is a good representative of our class and speaks for all the students.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们班的好代表，为所有学生发言。

republic.example: The country became a republic many years ago after the old king left.
republic.exampleZh: 多年前，老国王离开后，这个国家成为了一个共和国。

reputation.example: The hotel has a good reputation for clean rooms and friendly service.
reputation.exampleZh: 这家酒店以房间干净和服务友好而享有良好声誉。

request.example: She made a simple request for help with her homework.
request.exampleZh: 她简单地请求帮助她做作业。

require.example: The job requires you to work on weekends sometimes.
require.exampleZh: 这份工作需要你有时候周末上班。

requirement.example: Good English skills are a basic requirement for this job.
requirement.exampleZh: 良好的英语能力是这份工作的基本要求。

rescue.example: The firemen worked all night to rescue the family from the burning house.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员整夜工作，把一家人从着火的房子里救了出来。

research.example: She does research on how young children learn new words.
research.exampleZh: 她研究幼儿如何学习新单词。

researcher.example: She is a researcher who studies how children learn languages.
researcher.exampleZh: 她是一名研究儿童如何学习语言的研究人员。

resemble.example: Many people say that I closely resemble my older sister.
resemble.exampleZh: 很多人说我和我姐姐长得很像。

reservation.example: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant tonight.
reservation.exampleZh: 我今晚在那家餐厅预订了两个人的位子。

reserve.example: We reserve a table for six every Friday night.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上都预订一张六人桌。

resist.example: She tried hard to resist the urge to laugh during the meeting.
resist.exampleZh: 她努力忍住开会时想笑的冲动。

resolve.example: We must resolve this problem before the meeting starts tomorrow.
resolve.exampleZh: 我们必须在明天会议开始前解决这个问题。

resort.example: When problems arise, we should not resort to violence but talk instead.
resort.exampleZh: 当问题出现时，我们不应诉诸暴力，而应进行沟通。

resource.example: We do not have enough resource to finish this big project.
resource.exampleZh: 我们没有足够的资源来完成这个大项目。

respect.example: We should respect our teachers and listen to them carefully.
respect.exampleZh: 我们应该尊敬老师，认真听他们说话。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email, so I called her.
respond.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

response.example: Her quick response to my email made the whole process much easier.
response.exampleZh: 她对我邮件的快速回复让整个流程轻松了许多。

responsibility.example: It is my responsibility to take care of my little brother.
responsibility.exampleZh: 照顾我的小弟弟是我的责任。

responsible.example: She is responsible for the new project and works very hard.
responsible.exampleZh: 她负责这个新项目，工作非常努力。

rest.example: You need to rest after a long day of work.
rest.exampleZh: 工作一整天后你需要休息。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near our hotel last night.
restaurant.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在酒店附近的一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old building next year.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们明年将重建这座老建筑。

result.example: The result of the test made everyone very happy.
result.exampleZh: 测试的结果让每个人都很高兴。

retell.example: Please retell the story in your own words after class.
retell.exampleZh: 请你在课后用自己的话复述这个故事。

retire.example: My father plans to retire from his job next year.

return.example: Please return the book to the library before Friday.
return.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把书归还给图书馆。

reunion.example: Our family reunion is at Grandma's house this Saturday.
reunion.exampleZh: 我们家的团聚活动这周六在奶奶家举行。

review.example: I need to review my notes before the exam tomorrow.
review.exampleZh: 明天考试前我需要复习我的笔记。

revision.example: I need to do a quick revision of my notes before the exam.
revision.exampleZh: 考试前我需要快速复习一下笔记。

revolution.example: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in how people communicate.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网的发明引发了人们沟通方式的一场革命。

reward.example: She got a small reward for finding the lost dog.
reward.exampleZh: 她因为找到了那只走失的狗而得到了一小笔报酬。

rhythm.example: I like the steady rhythm of the rain on the roof.
rhythm.exampleZh: 我喜欢雨点打在屋顶上那稳定的节奏。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她用一条红丝带把礼盒系了起来。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: His family is very rich, and they own a big house.
rich.exampleZh: 他家非常富有，他们拥有一栋大房子。

rid.example: We must get rid of the old rules.
rid.exampleZh: 我们必须摆脱那些旧规则。

riddle.example: The old man asked me a riddle that I could not answer.
riddle.exampleZh: 老人问了我一个我无法回答的谜语。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天骑自行车去学校。

right.example: You are right, and everyone has the right to speak.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，而且每个人都有说话的权利。

rigid.example: The rigid rules of the old school never change for anyone.
rigid.exampleZh: 那所旧学校的严格规定从不因任何人而改变。

ring.example: She wore a gold ring and heard the phone ring in the hall.
ring.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚金戒指，听到走廊里电话铃响了。

rise.example: The sun rises early in summer, and prices rise too.
rise.exampleZh: 夏天太阳升起得早，物价也会上涨。

risk.example: Driving too fast in the rain is a big risk for everyone.
risk.exampleZh: 在雨中开得太快对每个人来说都是很大的风险。

river.example: The river runs through our town and many fish live in it.
river.exampleZh: 这条河穿过我们的小镇，里面生活着许多鱼。

road.example: The road to the small village is narrow but very safe.
road.exampleZh: 通往那个小村庄的路很窄，但非常安全。

roast.example: My mother likes to roast chicken with potatoes for Sunday dinner.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日晚餐时用土豆烤鸡。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank on Main Street yesterday.
rob.exampleZh: 昨天两名男子试图抢劫主街上的那家小银行。

robot.example: The robot in the factory can lift heavy boxes all day.
robot.exampleZh: 工厂里的这个机器人能整天搬起重箱子。

rock.example: The children like to rock the small boat and sing rock songs.
rock.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢摇晃小船并唱摇滚歌曲。

role.example: Teachers play an important role in helping students learn new things.
role.exampleZh: 教师在帮助学生学习新事物方面发挥着重要作用。

roll.example: The ball rolled down the hill and stopped near the tree.

romantic.example: He planned a romantic dinner for her on their anniversary.
romantic.exampleZh: 他在他们的纪念日为她安排了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

roof.example: The rain fell hard on the roof of our old house last night.
roof.exampleZh: 昨晚大雨重重地打在我们老房子的屋顶上。

room.example: There is not enough room in this car for all of us.
room.exampleZh: 这辆车里没有足够的空间容纳我们所有人。

root.example: The roots of the old tree grow deep into the ground.
root.exampleZh: 这棵老树的根深深扎进土里。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the dock with a strong rope.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根结实的绳子把船拴在码头上。

rose.example: She gave him a red rose on his birthday.
rose.exampleZh: 她在他生日那天送了他一朵红玫瑰。

rough.example: The road was rough, so we drove slowly and carefully.
rough.exampleZh: 路很崎岖，所以我们开得很慢、很小心。

roughly.example: The trip took roughly three hours by train.
roughly.exampleZh: 坐火车这趟行程大约花了三个小时。

round.example: The children sat round the table and played a fun game.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围着桌子坐着，玩一个有趣的游戏。

rouse.example: The loud noise will rouse the sleeping dog from the floor.
rouse.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音会把睡在地板上的狗惊醒。

route.example: We took the shortest route to the airport this morning.
route.exampleZh: 今天早上我们走了去机场最短的路线。

routine.example: My morning routine includes a quick walk and a cup of coffee.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨例行公事包括快速散步和一杯咖啡。

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boats row slowly across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着船只慢慢划过湖面。

royal.example: The royal family lives in a large old palace near the river.
royal.exampleZh: 王室成员住在河边一座又大又古老的宫殿里。

rubber.example: The tires on my bike are made of strong black rubber.
rubber.exampleZh: 我自行车上的轮胎是用结实的黑色橡胶制成的。

rubbish.example: Please put the rubbish in the bin outside the door.
rubbish.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放进门外面的垃圾桶里。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet place.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的场所大声打电话是不礼貌的。

rugby.example: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends at school.
rugby.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周六和朋友们在学校打橄榄球。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic and forced everyone to go home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐，迫使大家提前回家。

rule.example: Every player must follow the rules of the game.
rule.exampleZh: 每个球员都必须遵守比赛规则。

ruler.example: The ruler of the small country lived in a big old house.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国的统治者住在一栋又大又旧的房子里。

run.example: She runs a small coffee shop and runs every morning before work.
run.exampleZh: 她经营一家小咖啡店，每天早上上班前都会跑步。

rush.example: I had to rush to catch the last bus after work.
rush.exampleZh: 下班后我不得不匆忙赶去坐最后一班公交车。

russia.example: Russia is the largest country in the world by area.
russia.exampleZh: 俄罗斯是世界上面积最大的国家。

russian.example: My friend is learning Russian because she wants to travel to Moscow next year.
russian.exampleZh: 我的朋友正在学俄语，因为她想明年去莫斯科旅行。

rust.example: The old gate was covered with rust after many years of rain.
rust.exampleZh: 多年的雨水之后，那扇旧大门上布满了锈。

sack.example: They filled the sack with fresh apples and carried it home.
sack.exampleZh: 他们把麻袋装满新鲜苹果，然后把它搬回了家。

sacred.example: This old temple is a sacred place for the local people.
sacred.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对当地人来说是一个神圣的地方。

sacrifice.example: She had to sacrifice her free time to help her family.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 她不得不牺牲自己的空闲时间来帮助家人。

sad.example: The movie was so sad that I cried for a long time.
sad.exampleZh: 那部电影太令人难过了，我哭了很久。

saddle.example: He put a new leather saddle on his horse before the long ride.
saddle.exampleZh: 长途骑行前，他在马上装了一个新皮马鞍。

safe.example: Please keep your passport in a safe place when you travel abroad.
safe.exampleZh: 出国旅行时，请把护照放在安全的地方。

sail.example: They will sail across the sea in a small boat tomorrow.
sail.exampleZh: 明天他们将乘小船横渡大海。

sailor.example: The sailor works hard on a big ship every day.
sailor.exampleZh: 这位水手每天在一艘大船上努力工作。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, you should stop smoking and rest more.
sake.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，你应该戒烟并多休息。

salad.example: I like to eat a fresh salad with tomatoes for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 我午饭喜欢吃有西红柿的新鲜色拉。

salary.example: Her new job offers a higher salary and better working hours.
salary.exampleZh: 她的新工作提供更高的薪水和更好的工作时间。

sale.example: The store has a big sale on winter coats this week.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店本周冬季外套大减价。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 请在端上汤之前往里面加一点盐。

salute.example: They salute the flag every morning before class.
salute.exampleZh: 他们每天早上上课前向国旗敬礼。

same.example: We go to the same school and we are in the same class.
same.exampleZh: 我们去同一所学校，而且在同一个班。

sample.example: The doctor took a blood sample and sent it to the lab.
sample.exampleZh: 医生取了一份血样，送到实验室去了。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand on the beach all afternoon.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在海滩上温暖的沙子里玩。

sandwich.example: She made a cheese sandwich and put it in her bag.
sandwich.exampleZh: 她做了一个奶酪三明治，放进了包里。

satellite.example: The satellite sends pictures of the earth back to scientists.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星把地球的照片传回给科学家。

satisfaction.example: Her face showed great satisfaction when she saw the exam results.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 看到考试成绩时，她脸上露出了极大的满足感。

satisfy.example: The new teacher tries hard to satisfy her students with clear lessons.
satisfy.exampleZh: 新老师努力用清晰的课程让学生满意。

sausage.example: I ate two eggs and a sausage for breakfast this morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 今天早上我吃了两个鸡蛋和一根香肠当早餐。

savage.example: The savage dog scared the children away from the park.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗把孩子们吓得离开了公园。

save.example: He tried to save money, but everyone came to the party save his brother.
save.exampleZh: 他努力省钱，但除了他哥哥，大家都来参加了聚会。

saving.example: Buying used books is a good way to make a saving.
saving.exampleZh: 买二手书是省钱的好办法。

say.example: Please say your name slowly so everyone can hear it clearly.
say.exampleZh: 请慢慢说出你的名字，让大家都能听清楚。

saying.example: My grandfather often repeats an old saying about hard work and patience.
saying.exampleZh: 我祖父经常重复一句关于努力和耐心的老话。

scale.example: The scale on this map shows that one inch equals ten miles.
scale.exampleZh: 这张地图上的刻度表明一英寸等于十英里。

scan.example: I scan the page quickly to find the main idea.
scan.exampleZh: 我快速浏览页面，找出主要意思。

scar.example: The scar on his arm is still easy to see.
scar.exampleZh: 他手臂上的伤疤仍然很容易看见。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in some parts of the world.
scarce.exampleZh: 在世界的一些地区，干净的水很稀缺。

scare.example: The loud noise scared the little dog, and it ran away.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的响声吓到了那只小狗，它跑开了。

scarf.example: She wears a red scarf around her neck on cold winter days.
scarf.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬日，她脖子上围着一条红色的围巾。

scatter.example: The wind will scatter the dry leaves across the whole yard.
scatter.exampleZh: 风会把干树叶撒得满院子都是。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene of the accident very quickly.
scene.exampleZh: 警察很快赶到了事故现场。

scent.example: The scent of fresh bread filled the small kitchen.
scent.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在小厨房里。

sceptical.example: I am sceptical about his plan because it sounds too good.
sceptical.exampleZh: 我对他的计划持怀疑态度，因为那听起来太好了。

schedule.example: I check my schedule every morning before I start work.
schedule.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会看一下我的时间表。

scheme.example: The team came up with a new scheme to save money.
scheme.exampleZh: 团队想出了一个省钱的新方案。

scholar.example: My father is a famous scholar at a small university.
scholar.exampleZh: 我父亲是一所小型大学的著名学者。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study music at a big university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她赢得了一笔奖学金，去一所大型大学学习音乐。

school.example: My little sister walks to school with her friends every morning.
school.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和朋友们一起走路去学校。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and answer many everyday questions.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界，并回答许多日常问题。

scissors.example: I need a pair of scissors to cut this paper.
scissors.exampleZh: 我需要一把剪刀来剪这张纸。

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 我妈妈因为我昨晚回家晚了而训斥了我。

score.example: She kept the score on a small piece of paper.
score.exampleZh: 她把比分记在一小片纸上。

scratch.example: The cat likes to scratch the old sofa with its sharp claws.
scratch.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢用锋利的爪子抓那张旧沙发。

scream.example: She began to scream when she saw the snake in the garden.
scream.exampleZh: 她在花园里看到那条蛇时开始尖叫。

screen.example: The teacher will screen a short film on the big screen.
screen.exampleZh: 老师将在大屏幕上放映一部短片。

screw.example: Please use a screw to fix the shelf to the wall.
screw.exampleZh: 请用一颗螺丝把架子固定到墙上。

sea.example: The sea is very calm and blue today.
sea.exampleZh: 今天的大海非常平静，一片蔚蓝。

seal.example: The seal swam near the boat and looked at us.
seal.exampleZh: 那只海豹游到船边，看着我们。

search.example: We searched the whole house for the lost keys.
search.exampleZh: 我们搜遍了整座房子找丢失的钥匙。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season because the days are long and sunny.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，因为白天又长又晴朗。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the show begins and remain quiet.
seat.exampleZh: 请在演出开始前就座，并保持安静。

second.example: He finished second in the race and waited a second before smiling.
second.exampleZh: 他在比赛中获得第二名，等了片刻才露出笑容。

secret.example: She kept her secret from everyone for many years.
secret.exampleZh: 她把她的秘密瞒了所有人很多年。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and took a message for her boss.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并为她的老板记下了一条留言。

section.example: This section of the book is about how plants grow.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的这一部分讲的是植物如何生长。

secure.example: We feel secure because our doors are strong and locked.
secure.exampleZh: 我们感到安全，因为我们的门很坚固并且上了锁。

security.example: The airport checks every bag to keep passengers safe and maintain security.
security.exampleZh: 机场检查每个行李，以保障乘客安全并维护治安。

see.example: I can see the tall trees from my window every morning.
see.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能从窗户看见那些高大的树。

seed.example: She planted a small seed in the garden and watered it every day.
seed.exampleZh: 她在花园里种下一颗小种子，每天给它浇水。

seek.example: We seek a quiet place to rest after the long walk.
seek.exampleZh: 长途步行之后，我们寻找一个安静的地方休息。

seem.example: You seem tired today, so please go to bed early.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，所以请早点睡觉。

seize.example: The police seized the thief when he tried to run away.
seize.exampleZh: 小偷想逃跑时，警察抓住了他。

seldom.example: My brother seldom eats breakfast because he wakes up late.
seldom.exampleZh: 我弟弟很少吃早饭，因为他起床很晚。

select.example: Please select one book from this small table for your class.
select.exampleZh: 请从这张小桌子上挑选一本书供你的班级使用。

self.example: You should take some time to understand your true self.
self.exampleZh: 你应该花些时间去了解你真正的自我。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯和其他孩子分享玩具。

sell.example: We sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the small shop near the station.
sell.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的小店里卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: I will take five classes this semester and study hard.
semester.exampleZh: 这个学期我将选五门课并努力学习。

send.example: Please send this letter to your teacher today.
send.exampleZh: 请今天把这封信寄给你的老师。

senior.example: My senior brother is very kind to me at school.
senior.exampleZh: 我的学长在学校里对我很好。

sense.example: I have a strong sense that she is not telling the truth.
sense.exampleZh: 我强烈地感觉到她没有说实话。

sensitive.example: She is very sensitive to noise when she is studying.
sensitive.exampleZh: 她学习时对噪音非常敏感。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence him in court tomorrow morning.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将在法庭上对他宣判。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.
separate.exampleZh: 洗之前请把白色衣服和彩色衣服分开。

series.example: This book is the first in a new series about ancient China.
series.exampleZh: 这本书是关于古代中国的新系列中的第一本。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must fix it today.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须今天就解决它。

servant.example: The old servant has worked in this house for thirty years.
servant.exampleZh: 这位老仆人在这个家里已经工作了三十年。

serve.example: The waiter will serve our food in a few minutes.
serve.exampleZh: 服务员几分钟后就会给我们上菜。

service.example: The bus service in this city runs late at night.
service.exampleZh: 这座城市的公交服务运营到深夜。

set.example: She set the cup on the table and sat down.
set.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在桌上，然后坐了下来。

settle.example: After two years of traveling, they decided to settle in a small quiet village.
settle.exampleZh: 旅行了两年之后，他们决定在一个安静的小村庄定居下来。

seven.example: My little sister is seven years old and she starts school this year.
seven.exampleZh: 我妹妹七岁了，她今年开始上学。

several.example: Several of my friends came to the party last night.
several.exampleZh: 昨晚我的几个朋友来参加了聚会。

sew.example: My grandmother can sew a new dress for me in one day.
sew.exampleZh: 我奶奶一天就能给我缝制一条新连衣裙。

sex.example: Please write your name, age and sex on the form.
sex.exampleZh: 请在表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shade.example: The big tree gives cool shade on hot summer days.
shade.exampleZh: 这棵大树在炎热的夏日里提供凉爽的阴凉。

shadow.example: The tree cast a long shadow on the grass in the afternoon sun.
shadow.exampleZh: 午后的阳光下，那棵树在草地上投下一道长长的影子。

shake.example: She gave the bottle a good shake before opening it.
shake.exampleZh: 她打开瓶子前把它好好摇了一下。

shall.example: Shall we go to the park after lunch today?
shall.exampleZh: 我们今天午饭后去公园好吗？

shallow.example: The river is shallow here, so young children can play in it safely.
shallow.exampleZh: 这里的河很浅，小孩子可以在里面安全地玩耍。

shame.example: It is a shame that we cannot stay longer.
shame.exampleZh: 我们不能待更久，真是遗憾。

shape.example: The clay is soft, so you can shape it into any form.
shape.exampleZh: 黏土很软，所以你可以把它塑造成任何形状。

share.example: She likes to share her lunch with friends at school every day.
share.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天在学校和朋友们分享她的午餐。

sharp.example: Be careful with that knife because the blade is very sharp.
sharp.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，因为刀刃非常锋利。

shave.example: He shaves his face every morning before he goes to work.
shave.exampleZh: 他每天早上上班前都会刮脸。

she.example: She is my best friend at school.
she.exampleZh: 她是我在学校最好的朋友。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small green hill.
sheep.exampleZh: 农夫在他那座绿色的小山上养了许多绵羊。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed before her mother arrived.
sheet.exampleZh: 在母亲到来之前，她在床上铺了一条干净床单。

shelf.example: Please put the heavy books on the bottom shelf.
shelf.exampleZh: 请把这些沉重的书放在最下面的架子上。

shell.example: The child picked up a white shell on the beach.
shell.exampleZh: 那个孩子在沙滩上捡起了一个白色的贝壳。

shelter.example: We found shelter under a big tree when the rain started.
shelter.exampleZh: 下雨时我们在一棵大树下找到了遮蔽之处。

shine.example: The sun shines brightly in the sky on a clear summer day.
shine.exampleZh: 晴朗的夏日里，太阳在天空中明亮地照耀着。

ship.example: The ship carried fresh fruit and rice to the small island.
ship.exampleZh: 这艘船把新鲜水果和大米运到了那个小岛。

shirt.example: He wears a clean white shirt to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 他每天穿一件干净的白色衬衫去上班。

shock.example: The news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: I put on my new shoes before I went out this morning.
shoe.exampleZh: 今天早上出门前我穿上了我的新鞋。

shoot.example: He likes to shoot photos of birds in the park near his home.
shoot.exampleZh: 他喜欢在家附近的公园里拍摄鸟类的照片。

shop.example: We shop for food at the small shop near our home every Saturday.
shop.exampleZh: 我们每周六都在家附近的小商店买食物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and looked at the small boats.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着岸边散步，看着那些小船。

short.example: The blue dress is too short for me to wear to work.
short.exampleZh: 这条蓝色连衣裙太短了，我穿不了去上班。

shortage.example: There is a serious shortage of fresh water in that small town.
shortage.exampleZh: 那个小镇严重缺乏淡水。

shortly.example: She will be back shortly after lunch.
shortly.exampleZh: 她午饭后不久就会回来。

should.example: You should tell your teacher the truth about the broken window.
should.exampleZh: 你应该把打破窗户的事告诉老师。

shoulder.example: She carried the heavy bag on her shoulder and never complained to anyone.
shoulder.exampleZh: 她把沉重的包背在肩上，从未向任何人抱怨。

shout.example: She had to shout to be heard over the loud music.
shout.exampleZh: 她不得不大声喊叫，才能盖过吵闹的音乐被人听见。

show.example: Please show me the photos from your trip to Japan last week.
show.exampleZh: 请给我看看你上周去日本旅行的照片。

shower.example: I take a shower every morning before I go to work.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会洗个淋浴。

shut.example: Please shut the door quietly when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请轻轻地关上门。

shuttle.example: The weaver quickly passed the shuttle through the threads on the loom.
shuttle.exampleZh: 织工迅速地把梭子穿过织机上的线。

shy.example: The shy boy stood behind his mother and did not say a word.
shy.exampleZh: 那个害羞的男孩站在妈妈身后，一句话也没说。

sick.example: My brother is sick today, so he cannot go to school.
sick.exampleZh: 我弟弟今天生病了，所以他不能去上学。

side.example: Please stand on this side of the table with me.
side.exampleZh: 请和我一起站在这张桌子的这一边。

sidewalk.example: Children ride their bikes on the sidewalk in front of our house.
sidewalk.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们房子前的人行道上骑自行车。

sigh.example: She looked at the old photo and gave a long sigh.
sigh.exampleZh: 她看着那张旧照片，长长地叹了一口气。

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still walks in the park every day.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失去了视力，但他仍然每天在公园里散步。

sign.example: The sign on the door says the shop is closed today.
sign.exampleZh: 门上的招牌写着这家店今天关门。

signal.example: The teacher gave us a signal to start the test.
signal.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个开始考试的信号。

silence.example: The silence in the old house made me feel afraid.
silence.exampleZh: 老房子里的寂静让我感到害怕。

silk.example: The dress is made of soft silk and feels very smooth.
silk.exampleZh: 这条连衣裙是柔软丝绸做的，摸起来很光滑。

silly.example: It was silly of me to forget my keys again.
silly.exampleZh: 我又忘了带钥匙，真是太傻了。

silver.example: She wore a silver ring on her finger and smiled.
silver.exampleZh: 她的手指上戴着一枚银戒指，微笑着。

similar.example: My sister and I have similar hobbies, so we often spend time together.
similar.exampleZh: 我和姐姐有相似的爱好，所以我们经常一起度过时光。

simple.example: This book is simple and easy for all young students to read.
simple.exampleZh: 这本书很简单，所有年轻学生都容易读懂。

since.example: I have not seen him since he moved to another city last year.
since.exampleZh: 自从他去年搬到另一个城市后，我就没见过他了。

sincere.example: She gave me a sincere smile and thanked me for my help.
sincere.exampleZh: 她给了我一个真诚的微笑，并感谢我的帮助。

sing.example: She likes to sing her favorite songs in the shower.
sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢在洗澡时唱她最喜欢的歌。

singe.example: Be careful with the hot iron, or it will singe your shirt.
singe.exampleZh: 小心那个热熨斗，否则它会烫焦你的衬衫。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink slowly into the cold dark water.
sink.exampleZh: 那条旧船开始慢慢沉入冰冷黑暗的水中。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the station is?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我车站在哪里吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我和我妹妹每天早上一起走路去学校。

sit.example: She likes to sit by the window and read books.

site.example: This site is a good place for a new school.
site.exampleZh: 这个地点是建新学校的好地方。

situation.example: The situation is difficult, but we can solve it together.
situation.exampleZh: 情况很困难，但我们可以一起解决。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁了，今年开始上学。

size.example: Can you tell me the size of this shirt?
size.exampleZh: 你能告诉我这件衬衫的尺码吗？

skate.example: I like to skate on the ice in winter with my friends.
skate.exampleZh: 冬天我喜欢和朋友们一起在冰上滑冰。

sketch.example: She made a quick sketch of the garden before planting the flowers.
sketch.exampleZh: 种花之前，她先画了一张花园的草图。

ski.example: My friends and I learn to ski on the small hill near our town.
ski.exampleZh: 我和朋友们在我们镇附近的小山坡上学滑雪。

skill.example: Learning a new skill takes time and a lot of practice.
skill.exampleZh: 学习一项新技能需要时间和大量练习。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker and can fix many machines.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，能修理许多机器。

skin.example: The baby's skin feels soft and warm after the bath.
skin.exampleZh: 婴儿洗完澡后，皮肤摸起来又软又暖。

skirt.example: She wore a long skirt to the party and later skirted the busy road.
skirt.exampleZh: 她穿着一条长裙去参加聚会，后来又绕开了繁忙的马路。

sky.example: We lay on the grass and looked up at the blue sky.
sky.exampleZh: 我们躺在草地上，抬头望着蓝天。

slave.example: The slaves worked all day in the fields without any rest.
slave.exampleZh: 奴隶们整天在田里干活，没有任何休息。

sleep.example: I usually sleep for eight hours every night after a long day.
sleep.exampleZh: 在漫长的一天之后，我通常每晚睡八个小时。

sleepy.example: The little boy felt sleepy after playing in the park all afternoon.
sleepy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在公园玩了一下午后感到很困。

slice.example: Please cut me a thin slice of cake for the party.
slice.exampleZh: 请为聚会给我切一片薄薄的蛋糕。

slide.example: The kids like to slide down the hill in the snow.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在雪地里从山坡上滑下来。

slight.example: There is a slight difference between these two blue shirts.
slight.exampleZh: 这两件蓝色衬衫之间有轻微的差别。

slim.example: The slim young man walks to work every morning.
slim.exampleZh: 那个苗条的年轻人每天早上步行去上班。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the door.
slip.exampleZh: 小心，别在门附近湿滑的地板上滑倒。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, so we walk to school.
slow.exampleZh: 那辆旧公交车很慢，所以我们步行去学校。

small.example: This small room has one bed and a desk.
small.exampleZh: 这个小小的房间里有一张床和一张书桌。

smart.example: She is smart and always finds quick answers to hard problems.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能很快找到难题的答案。

smell.example: I can smell fresh bread from the kitchen every morning.
smell.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能从厨房闻到新鲜面包的气味。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said good morning.
smile.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑，并说了声早上好。

smoke.example: The smoke from the kitchen fire made everyone cough and run outside.
smoke.exampleZh: 厨房火灾冒出的烟让每个人都咳嗽着跑到外面。

smooth.example: The table has a smooth surface and is easy to clean.
smooth.exampleZh: 这张桌子表面光滑，很容易清洁。

snake.example: I saw a long green snake near the river yesterday.
snake.exampleZh: 昨天我在河边看见了一条长长的绿蛇。

snow.example: The snow is very deep on the road today, so we will stay home.
snow.exampleZh: 今天路上的雪很深，所以我们会待在家里。

so.example: It was so cold outside that we stayed home all day.
so.exampleZh: 外面太冷了，因此我们整天都待在家里。

soap.example: Please wash your hands with soap before you eat dinner.
soap.exampleZh: 吃晚饭前请用肥皂洗手。

social.example: Social media is very popular among young people today.
social.exampleZh: 社交媒体在今天的年轻人中非常流行。

society.example: We all need to work together to make our society better.
society.exampleZh: 我们都需要共同努力，让我们的社会变得更好。

sock.example: I put on a clean pair of socks before I go to work.
sock.exampleZh: 我上班前穿上一双干净的短袜。

sofa.example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa in the living room.
sofa.exampleZh: 猫正在客厅的沙发上睡觉。

soft.example: Her voice is soft and calm when she talks to the baby.
soft.exampleZh: 她和婴儿说话时，声音轻柔又平静。

software.example: Our team uses new software to finish the work faster.
software.exampleZh: 我们团队使用新软件来更快地完成工作。

soil.example: The soil in this garden is dark and good for growing vegetables.
soil.exampleZh: 这个花园里的土壤颜色深，适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: Solar energy can help us save money and protect the environment.
solar.exampleZh: 太阳能可以帮助我们省钱并保护环境。

soldier.example: The soldier carried a heavy bag and walked slowly down the long road.
soldier.exampleZh: 那名士兵背着一个沉重的包，沿着长长的路慢慢走着。

solid.example: This table is very solid and it will not break easily.
solid.exampleZh: 这张桌子很结实，不容易坏。

solution.example: We found a simple solution to the problem at school today.
solution.exampleZh: 我们今天在学校找到了这个问题的简单解决办法。

solve.example: We must solve this problem before the meeting starts.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前解决这个问题。

some.example: I bought some apples and bread at the small store near my home.
some.exampleZh: 我在家附近的小商店买了一些苹果和面包。

somebody.example: Somebody left a bag on the chair this morning.
somebody.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把包落在椅子上了。

someone.example: Someone left a bag on the chair by the door.
someone.exampleZh: 有人把一个包落在了门边的椅子上。

something.example: I have something important to tell you before the meeting.
something.exampleZh: 开会前我有一件重要的事要告诉你。

sometime.example: Please come to see me sometime next week if you are free.
sometime.exampleZh: 如果你有空，请下周找个时间来见我。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school with my sister when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时和妹妹一起走路去学校。

somewhere.example: I think I left my keys somewhere near the front door.
somewhere.exampleZh: 我想我把钥匙落在前门附近的某个地方了。

son.example: My son likes to play football with his friends after school.
son.exampleZh: 我儿子喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

song.example: She sang a beautiful song for us at the party last night.
song.exampleZh: 昨晚在聚会上她为我们唱了一首优美的歌。

soon.example: The bus will come soon, so please wait here.
soon.exampleZh: 公交车很快就到，请在这里等。

sore.example: My throat is sore, so I will drink some warm water.
sore.exampleZh: 我的喉咙很痛，所以我要喝些温水。

sorry.example: I am sorry for being late to your party yesterday.
sorry.exampleZh: 很抱歉我昨天参加你的聚会迟到了。

sort.example: Please sort the books by size and put them on the shelf.
sort.exampleZh: 请按大小把书分类，然后放到书架上。

soul.example: She believes that a kind soul is more important than money.
soul.exampleZh: 她相信一颗善良的心灵比金钱更重要。

sound.example: The sound of the rain makes me feel calm and sleepy.
sound.exampleZh: 雨声让我感到平静又有睡意。

soup.example: My mother makes hot soup for us on cold winter days.
soup.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬日里，妈妈会给我们做热汤。

source.example: The river has its source high in the mountains.
source.exampleZh: 这条河的源头位于高山之上。

south.example: We drove south for three hours to visit our grandparents.
south.exampleZh: 我们向南开了三个小时的车去看望祖父母。

southern.example: The southern part of the country is warm and sunny all year.
southern.exampleZh: 这个国家的南部地区全年温暖且阳光充足。

space.example: There is not enough space in this small room for a big table.
space.exampleZh: 这个小镇房间里没有足够的空间放一张大桌子。

spare.example: I always keep a spare key in my bag for emergencies.
spare.exampleZh: 我总是在包里放一把备用钥匙以防万一。

speak.example: She can speak three languages and often speaks at school events.
speak.exampleZh: 她会说三种语言，并且经常在学校活动上演讲。

special.example: This is a special day for my whole family.
special.exampleZh: 这对我们全家来说是特殊的一天。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example of your idea.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个你想法中的具体例子。

speech.example: His speech at the meeting was clear and easy to understand.
speech.exampleZh: 他在会上的演讲清晰易懂。

speed.example: The car moved at a high speed down the empty road.
speed.exampleZh: 那辆车以很高的速度沿着空荡的道路行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.exampleZh: 你能为我拼一下你的姓吗？

spelling.example: My teacher says my spelling is getting better every week.
spelling.exampleZh: 老师说我的拼写每周都在进步。

spend.example: I spend two hours reading books every evening after dinner.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后花两个小时读书。

spin.example: The wheels began to spin faster and faster on the wet road.
spin.exampleZh: 车轮在湿滑的路面上开始越转越快。

spirit.example: Her spirit was high even after the long, hard day.
spirit.exampleZh: 即使经历了漫长辛苦的一天，她的精神依然高涨。

spiritual.example: She finds peace through spiritual practice, not through money or things.
spiritual.exampleZh: 她通过精神修习获得平静，而不是通过金钱或物质。

spit.example: Please do not spit on the street; it is very dirty.
spit.exampleZh: 请不要在街上吐唾沫，那样很不卫生。

splendid.example: The garden looks splendid in the early morning sun.
splendid.exampleZh: 花园在清晨的阳光下显得十分壮丽。

split.example: The group split into two teams after a serious disagreement about the plan.
split.exampleZh: 在就计划产生严重分歧后，这个小组分裂成了两队。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
spoil.exampleZh: 雨水过多会在我们采摘之前就使水果腐烂。

spoke.example: One spoke of the bicycle wheel was bent after the accident.
spoke.exampleZh: 事故后自行车轮的一根轮辐弯了。

sponsor.example: The company will sponsor the school sports day this year.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家公司今年将赞助学校的运动会。

spoon.example: Please use a spoon to eat your soup before it gets cold.
spoon.exampleZh: 请在汤变凉之前用勺子喝汤。

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，我每个周末都和朋友一起打。

spot.example: I found a red spot on my shirt this morning.
spot.exampleZh: 今天早上我发现衬衫上有一个红点。

spray.example: The gardener will spray the young trees with water this afternoon.
spray.exampleZh: 园丁今天下午会给小树喷水。

spread.example: News of the fire spread quickly through the small town.
spread.exampleZh: 火灾的消息迅速传遍了整个小镇。

spring.example: The water from this spring is very cold, even in summer.
spring.exampleZh: 这眼泉水的温度很低，即使在夏天也是如此。

spy.example: The spy watched the man from behind a tree and wrote everything down.
spy.exampleZh: 那名间谍躲在树后监视那个男人，并把一切都记了下来。

square.example: Our new apartment is near a large square with many trees.
square.exampleZh: 我们的新公寓靠近一个有許多树的广场。

squeeze.example: The child tried to squeeze the juice from the orange.
squeeze.exampleZh: 那个孩子试着从橙子里挤出果汁。

stable.example: The old wooden stable is stable and safe for the horses.
stable.exampleZh: 那座旧木马厩很稳固，对马来说是安全的。

stadium.example: The new stadium can hold sixty thousand people.
stadium.exampleZh: 新体育场能容纳六万人。

staff.example: The hotel staff were very kind and helped us find our room.
staff.exampleZh: 酒店员工非常友善，帮我们找到了房间。

stage.example: The singer walked onto the stage and began her first song.
stage.exampleZh: 歌手走上舞台，开始唱她的第一首歌。

stair.example: She walked slowly up the stairs to her room.
stair.exampleZh: 她慢慢地走上楼梯回到自己的房间。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the envelope and mailed it.
stamp.exampleZh: 她在信封上贴了一张邮票，然后把它寄了出去。

stand.example: We had to stand in line for an hour at the ticket booth.
stand.exampleZh: 我们不得不在售票亭排队站了一个小时。

standard.example: The hotel room was clean and met our standards.
standard.exampleZh: 酒店房间很干净，达到了我们的标准。

star.example: The bright star shines in the sky every clear night.
star.exampleZh: 那颗明亮的星星在每个晴朗的夜晚闪耀在天空中。

stare.example: She stared at the painting for a long time without saying anything.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那幅画看了很久，什么也没说。

start.example: We start work at nine every morning and finish at six.
start.exampleZh: 我们每天早上九点开始工作，下午六点结束。

starve.example: Many people in that poor country starve every year because there is not enough food.
starve.exampleZh: 那个贫困国家的许多人每年都因为食物不足而挨饿。

state.example: The state of the room was clean and quiet.
state.exampleZh: 这个房间的状态干净又安静。

statement.example: The police asked him to make a short statement about the accident.
statement.exampleZh: 警察要求他就这起事故作一个简短的陈述。

station.example: I will wait for you at the bus station after school.
station.exampleZh: 放学后我会在公交车站等你。

statue.example: There is a stone statue of a lion in the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园里有一座石狮子雕像。

status.example: Her new job gave her a higher status in the company.
status.exampleZh: 她的新工作让她在公司里获得了更高的地位。

stay.example: Please stay here and wait for me.

steady.example: The old table is not very steady, so please do not put the glass on it.
steady.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子不太稳，所以请不要把玻璃杯放在上面。

steak.example: My father likes to eat steak with potatoes for dinner on Fridays.
steak.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在周五晚餐时吃牛排配土豆。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bag on the bus yesterday.
steal.exampleZh: 昨天有人在公交车上试图偷我的包。

steam.example: Hot steam rose from the pot of boiling water on the stove.
steam.exampleZh: 热蒸汽从炉子上那锅沸水中升起。

steel.example: The bridge is made of strong steel and can hold heavy trucks.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢铁制成，能够承受重型卡车。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop.
step.exampleZh: 请向前迈一步，然后停下。

stick.example: Please stick this note on the door and stick to your plan.
stick.exampleZh: 请把这张便条贴在门上，并坚持你的计划。

still.example: She is still very tired, but her hands are still.
still.exampleZh: 她仍然很累，但她的双手静止不动。

stocking.example: She hung a small gift in her Christmas stocking by the fireplace.
stocking.exampleZh: 她把一个小礼物挂在壁炉旁的长袜里。

stomach.example: My stomach feels full after I eat a big lunch.
stomach.exampleZh: 吃完一顿丰盛的午餐后，我的肚子感觉很饱。

stone.example: The little boy picked up a smooth stone and put it in his pocket.
stone.exampleZh: 小男孩捡起一块光滑的石头，放进了口袋里。

stop.example: The bus stopped at the station, and we got off quickly.
stop.exampleZh: 公交车停在了车站，我们很快下了车。

store.example: Please store the extra food in a cool, dry place.
store.exampleZh: 请把多余的食物储存在阴凉干燥的地方。

storm.example: The storm was very strong and it broke many trees in our garden.
storm.exampleZh: 暴风雨非常猛烈，把我们花园里的许多树都折断了。

story.example: My grandmother tells me a funny story every night before I sleep.
story.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天晚上睡觉前都会给我讲一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: She put the pot on the stove and waited for the water to boil.
stove.exampleZh: 她把锅放在炉子上，等水烧开。

straight.example: Please go straight down this road and turn left at the bank.
straight.exampleZh: 请沿着这条路一直走，然后在银行那里左转。

strait.example: The ship sailed through the narrow strait between the two islands.
strait.exampleZh: 那艘船穿过了两座岛屿之间的狭窄海峡。

strange.example: It is strange that my new neighbor never says hello to anyone.
strange.exampleZh: 奇怪的是，我的新邻居从不跟任何人打招呼。

stranger.example: Do not open the door to a stranger at night.
stranger.exampleZh: 晚上不要给陌生人开门。

strategic.example: Good strategic planning helps small companies use their limited money wisely.
strategic.exampleZh: 良好的战略规划能帮助小公司明智地使用有限的资金。

strategy.example: Our company needs a new strategy to sell more products.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们公司需要一项新战略来销售更多产品。

stream.example: A small stream runs through the green fields behind our old house.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪穿过我们老房子后面的绿色田野。

street.example: I walk down this busy street to school every morning.
street.exampleZh: 我每天早上都沿着这条繁忙的街道走去学校。

strength.example: Her greatest strength is her ability to stay calm under pressure.
strength.exampleZh: 她最大的强项是在压力下保持冷静的能力。

stress.example: Too much stress at work can make you feel very tired.
stress.exampleZh: 工作压力太大可能会让你感到非常疲惫。

stretch.example: The road stretches for miles along the quiet coast.
stretch.exampleZh: 这条路沿着安静的海岸延伸数英里。

strict.example: Our teacher is strict about homework, so we always finish it on time.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对作业要求很严格，所以我们总是按时完成。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定为提高工资和改善安全条件而罢工。

string.example: She tied the box with a long piece of string.
string.exampleZh: 她用一根长绳子把盒子捆了起来。

strong.example: He is strong enough to carry the heavy box up the stairs.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能把那个沉重的箱子搬上楼。

struggle.example: Many students struggle with math, but they keep trying every day.
struggle.exampleZh: 许多学生在数学上很挣扎，但他们每天继续努力。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard before the big exam.
student.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生在重要考试前都很努力。

study.example: I study English for an hour every evening and read books in my study.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上学一小时英语，并在书房里读书。

stuff.example: There is too much stuff in my small bag.
stuff.exampleZh: 我的小包里东西太多了。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to leave my keys at home today.
stupid.exampleZh: 我今天把钥匙落在家里了，真是太傻了。

style.example: Her simple style makes her clothes easy to wear every day.
style.exampleZh: 她简约的风格让她的衣服每天都易于穿着。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject, but I am subject to my teacher's rules.
subject.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目，但我要听从老师的规矩。

submit.example: Please submit your homework before Friday so the teacher can check it.
submit.exampleZh: 请在周五之前提交你的作业，这样老师才能检查。

subscribe.example: I subscribe to two magazines and a newspaper every month.
subscribe.exampleZh: 我每个月订阅两本杂志和一份报纸。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that every living thing needs.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种简单的物质，每个生物都需要它。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力工作，你最终会成功。

success.example: Her hard work and patience finally brought great success to the small team.
success.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心最终给这个小团队带来了巨大的成功。

successful.example: She worked hard for many years and became a very successful doctor.
successful.exampleZh: 她努力了很多年，成为了一名非常成功的医生。

such.example: I never saw such a big dog in my life.
such.exampleZh: 我这辈子从没见过这么大的狗。

suck.example: The baby likes to suck milk from a bottle every morning.
suck.exampleZh: 这个宝宝喜欢每天早上从奶瓶里吸牛奶。

sudden.example: There was a sudden change in the weather this afternoon.
sudden.exampleZh: 今天下午天气突然发生了变化。

suddenly.example: It suddenly started to rain and we ran home.
suddenly.exampleZh: 天突然下起雨来，我们就跑回家了。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches after a long day at work.
suffer.exampleZh: 很多人在漫长的一天工作后会头痛。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient food and water for the whole trip.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供整个旅程使用。

sugar.example: Too much sugar in your coffee is not good for your teeth.
sugar.exampleZh: 咖啡里放太多糖对你的牙齿不好。

suggest.example: The doctor suggests that I should rest at home for two days.
suggest.exampleZh: 医生建议我在家休息两天。

suggestion.example: Her suggestion was very helpful and we used it in our project.
suggestion.exampleZh: 她的建议非常有用，我们把它用在了项目里。

suit.example: This dark suit fits him well, but the long lawsuit does not suit his plans.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色套装很适合他，但这场漫长的诉讼并不适合他的计划。

suitable.example: This movie is suitable for children and their parents.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影适合孩子和他们的父母观看。

suitcase.example: I put my clothes in the suitcase and closed it.
suitcase.exampleZh: 我把衣服放进手提箱里，然后把它合上了。

sum.example: The sum of five and three is eight.

summarize.example: Please summarize the main ideas of this article in three sentences.
summarize.exampleZh: 请用三句话概括这篇文章的主要观点。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the report before Friday.
summary.exampleZh: 请在周五前写一份这份报告的简短摘要。

summer.example: We like to swim in the lake every summer.
summer.exampleZh: 我们喜欢每年夏天在湖里游泳。

sun.example: The sun is very bright today, so we stay inside.
sun.exampleZh: 今天阳光很强烈，所以我们待在室内。

sunlight.example: The morning sunlight comes through my bedroom window and makes the room warm.
sunlight.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光透过卧室窗户照进来，让房间变得温暖。

sunny.example: It is a sunny day, so we will play outside.
sunny.exampleZh: 今天是个晴朗的日子，所以我们要去外面玩。

sunrise.example: We woke up early to watch the sunrise over the mountains.
sunrise.exampleZh: 我们早早起床，在山上看日出。

sunset.example: We watched the sunset from the beach and then walked home together.
sunset.exampleZh: 我们在海滩上看日落，然后一起走回了家。

sunshine.example: The children played in the warm sunshine all afternoon.
sunshine.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在温暖的阳光下玩耍。

super.example: This is a super hotel with clean rooms and very friendly staff.
super.exampleZh: 这是一家极好的酒店，房间干净，员工也非常友好。

superior.example: My new phone is much better than the old one, so it is superior in many ways.
superior.exampleZh: 我的新手机比旧的好得多，所以在很多方面都更优越。

supply.example: The farm supplies fresh vegetables to all the schools in our town.
supply.exampleZh: 这个农场向我们镇上所有的学校供应新鲜蔬菜。

support.example: My parents always support my decision to study English abroad.
support.exampleZh: 我父母一直支持我出国学英语的决定。

suppose.example: I suppose he is still at home, but I am not sure.
suppose.exampleZh: 我猜他还在家，但我不确定。

sure.example: I am sure this is the right way to the station.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信这是去车站的正确路线。

surface.example: The boat moved slowly across the calm surface of the lake.
surface.exampleZh: 小船缓缓驶过平静的湖面。

surprise.example: The gift was a big surprise, and it made everyone smile.
surprise.exampleZh: 这份礼物是一个大惊喜，它让每个人都笑了。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake near our school.
surround.exampleZh: 我们学校附近的小湖四周环绕着高大的树木。

survey.example: The teacher asked us to survey the students about their reading habits.
survey.exampleZh: 老师让我们调查学生们的阅读习惯。

survive.example: Only a few small plants can survive in this dry and cold place.
survive.exampleZh: 只有少数小型植物能在这个干燥寒冷的地方存活下来。

survivor.example: The only survivor of the crash was a young boy.
survivor.exampleZh: 这场事故的唯一幸存者是一个小男孩。

suspect.example: The police suspect that the quiet man stole the money.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑那个安静的男人偷了钱。

swallow.example: She swallowed the pill with a glass of water before breakfast.
swallow.exampleZh: 她在早饭前用一杯水吞下了那片药。

swap.example: I often swap books with my friends at school.
swap.exampleZh: 我经常在学校和朋友们交换书。

swear.example: He was so angry that he began to swear at the driver.
swear.exampleZh: 他气得不行，开始咒骂那个司机。

sweep.example: I sweep the floor every morning before I go to school.
sweep.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前扫地板。

sweet.example: This cake is very sweet, and the kids love it.
sweet.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕很甜，孩子们很喜欢。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell on the stairs.
swell.exampleZh: 我从楼梯上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿了起来。

swim.example: I can swim in the pool near my house.
swim.exampleZh: 我可以在家附近的游泳池里游泳。

switch.example: Please switch off the light before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The brave knight carried a sharp sword into the dark forest.
sword.exampleZh: 勇敢的骑士带着一把锋利的剑走进了黑暗的森林。

symbol.example: The dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，鸽子是和平的象征。

sympathy.example: I felt great sympathy for the old man who lost his dog.
sympathy.exampleZh: 我对那位失去爱犬的老人深感同情。

system.example: The new computer system helps our school work much faster.
system.exampleZh: 新的电脑系统让我们的学校工作快得多。

table.example: Please put the books on the table before we start the meeting.
table.exampleZh: 请在我们开始会议前把书放在桌子上。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail when I came home from school.
tail.exampleZh: 我放学回家时，那只狗摇了摇它的尾巴。

take.example: It takes about twenty minutes to walk to the station from my house.
take.exampleZh: 从我家走到车站大约要花二十分钟。

tale.example: My grandmother told me an old tale about a brave young girl.
tale.exampleZh: 我的祖母给我讲了一个关于一个勇敢小女孩的古老故事。

talk.example: We often talk about our plans after work.
talk.exampleZh: 我们经常在下班后谈论我们的计划。

tall.example: My brother is very tall and he plays basketball well.
tall.exampleZh: 我哥哥很高，他篮球打得很好。

tank.example: The old car's tank was almost empty after the long drive.
tank.exampleZh: 长途驾驶后，那辆旧车的油箱几乎空了。

tap.example: She gave the door a gentle tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人回应。

tape.example: He put all the old songs on a tape for his mother.
tape.exampleZh: 他把所有老歌录到一盘磁带上给妈妈。

target.example: The arrow hit the target in the middle.
target.exampleZh: 箭射中了靶子的正中心。

task.example: My first task today is to clean the kitchen.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是打扫厨房。

taste.example: Please taste this soup and tell me if it needs more salt.
taste.exampleZh: 请尝一下这汤，告诉我是否需要再加点盐。

tax.example: The government will tax the rich more to pay for new schools.
tax.exampleZh: 政府将对富人征收更多税，以支付新建学校的费用。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My mother teaches English at a small school near our home.
teach.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一所小学校教英语。

team.example: Our team works hard every day to finish the new project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们团队每天努力工作，以按时完成新项目。

tear.example: She wiped a tear from her eye and tore the old letter in half.
tear.exampleZh: 她擦去眼角的一滴眼泪，把旧信撕成两半。

technical.example: She has strong technical skills and can fix most computer problems.
technical.exampleZh: 她有很强的技术能力，能解决大多数电脑问题。

technique.example: She learned a new technique to make bread at home.
technique.exampleZh: 她学会了一种在家做面包的新方法。

technology.example: Modern technology makes it easy for students to learn at home.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让学生在家学习变得容易。

telephone.example: I called her on the telephone to say good night.

television.example: My family watches television together after dinner every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我们一家人每天晚饭后一起看电视。

tell.example: Please tell me the way to the train station.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我去火车站的路。

temperature.example: The doctor checked her temperature and said she needed to rest.
temperature.exampleZh: 医生量了她的体温，说她需要休息。
