temple.example: The old temple on the hill is very quiet in the morning.
temple.exampleZh: 山上的那座古庙在早晨非常安静。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary job for the summer.
temporary.exampleZh: 这只是夏天的一份临时工作。

tend.example: People tend to feel tired after a long day at work.
tend.exampleZh: 人们在漫长的一天工作后往往会感到疲倦。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to talk too much in meetings.
tendency.exampleZh: 他在会议上往往话太多。

tennis.example: My friend and I play tennis in the park every Sunday.
tennis.exampleZh: 我和朋友每周日都在公园打网球。

tent.example: We put up a tent near the lake and slept there last night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在湖边搭了一个帐篷，昨晚就睡在那里。

term.example: We will learn many new terms in this term.
term.exampleZh: 这个学期我们将学习许多新术语。

terminal.example: The train stopped at the terminal, and all the passengers got off.
terminal.exampleZh: 火车停在了终点站，所有乘客都下了车。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

terrify.example: The loud thunder at night can terrify small children and even some adults.
terrify.exampleZh: 夜里巨大的雷声会吓到小孩子，甚至一些成年人。

test.example: We will have a math test in class tomorrow morning.
test.exampleZh: 明天上午我们班上会有一场数学测验。

text.example: She read the text on the page and smiled.
text.exampleZh: 她读了页面上的文本，然后笑了。

than.example: She runs faster than her brother does.

thank.example: I want to thank you for your help with my homework.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你帮我做作业。

that.example: That is the book I told you about yesterday.
that.exampleZh: 那就是我昨天跟你提到的那本书。

the.example: The book on the table is mine.
the.exampleZh: 桌子上的那本书是我的。

theatre.example: We went to the theatre last night to see a funny new play.
theatre.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去剧院看了一部有趣的新剧。

their.example: The students put their books on the desk before class.
their.exampleZh: 学生们上课前把他们的书放在桌子上。

them.example: I called them yesterday, but they did not answer the phone.
them.exampleZh: 我昨天给他们打了电话，但他们没有接。

theme.example: The theme of today's class is how to stay healthy.
theme.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题是如何保持健康。

then.example: I ate dinner and then I went to bed early.
then.exampleZh: 我吃了晚饭，然后早早上床睡觉了。

theory.example: The new theory is hard to understand without more examples.
theory.exampleZh: 如果没有更多例子，这个新理论很难理解。

there.example: Please put the box over there near the window.
there.exampleZh: 请把那个箱子放在那边靠近窗户的地方。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, and therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天都待在家里。

these.example: These books on the desk are mine, not yours.
these.exampleZh: 桌子上的这些书是我的，不是你的。

they.example: They are my good friends and we play together every day.
they.exampleZh: 他们是我的好朋友，我们每天都一起玩。

thick.example: The soup is thick and tastes very good on a cold day.
thick.exampleZh: 这汤很浓，在寒冷的日子里喝起来非常好。

thief.example: The police caught the thief who stole my bike last night.
thief.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚偷我自行车的小偷。

thin.example: This book is very thin and easy to carry in my bag.
thin.exampleZh: 这本书很薄，放在包里很容易携带。

thing.example: I have many things to do at home today.
thing.exampleZh: 我今天在家有很多事情要做。

think.example: I think this book is very interesting and easy to read.
think.exampleZh: 我认为这本书很有趣，而且容易读。

third.example: This is the third time I have read this book.
third.exampleZh: 这是我第三次读这本书。

thirsty.example: After the long run, I felt very thirsty and drank two cups of water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 长跑之后，我感到非常口渴，喝了两杯水。

thirteen.example: My little sister is thirteen years old and she loves to draw pictures.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢画画。

thirty.example: My older sister is thirty years old and works in a small bookshop.
thirty.exampleZh: 我姐姐三十岁，在一家小书店工作。

this.example: This is my new book, and I read it every day.
this.exampleZh: 这是我的新书，我每天都读它。

thorough.example: The doctor gave him a thorough check before the long trip.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生在长途旅行前给他做了彻底的检查。

those.example: Those books on the shelf are mine, not yours.
those.exampleZh: 书架上的那些书是我的，不是你的。

though.example: Though it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
though.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

thought.example: That is an interesting thought, and I want to hear more.
thought.exampleZh: 那是个有趣的想法，我想多听听。

thousand.example: There are about a thousand students in our school this year.
thousand.exampleZh: 今年我们学校大约有一千名学生。

thread.example: I lost the thread of the story and had to read the page again.
thread.exampleZh: 我丢了故事的思路，只好把这页再读一遍。

three.example: My sister has three cats and two dogs at home.
three.exampleZh: 我妹妹家里有三只猫和两只狗。

throat.example: I have a sore throat today, so I will drink warm water.
throat.exampleZh: 我今天嗓子疼，所以我会喝温水。

through.example: We walked through the park and then went home.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过公园，然后回家了。

throughout.example: The museum is free for students throughout the year.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家博物馆全年对学生们免费开放。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me and I will catch it.
throw.exampleZh: 请把球扔给我，我会接住它。

thumb.example: He cut his thumb while cooking dinner last night.
thumb.exampleZh: 他昨晚做饭时切到了拇指。

thunder.example: The thunder was very loud last night, and my dog hid under the bed.
thunder.exampleZh: 昨晚雷声很大，我的狗躲在床底下。

thus.example: He missed the last bus and thus had to walk home.
thus.exampleZh: 他错过了末班车，因此不得不步行回家。

ticket.example: I bought a train ticket at the station this morning before work.
ticket.exampleZh: 今天上班前我在车站买了一张火车票。

tide.example: The tide comes in every morning and goes out at night.
tide.exampleZh: 潮水每天早上上涨，晚上退去。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room before your friends come over this afternoon.
tidy.exampleZh: 请在你朋友今天下午来之前整理好你的房间。

tie.example: Please tie your shoes before we go out to play.
tie.exampleZh: 我们出去玩之前，请先把鞋带系好。

tiger.example: The tiger is a big wild cat that lives in the forest.
tiger.exampleZh: 老虎是一种生活在森林里的大型野生猫科动物。

tight.example: This shoe is too tight for my foot, so I need a bigger size.
tight.exampleZh: 这只鞋对我的脚来说太紧了，所以我需要大一号的。

till.example: Please wait here till I come back with the keys.
till.exampleZh: 请在这里等到我拿钥匙回来。

time.example: I don't have much time to finish this work today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成这项工作。

tiny.example: A tiny bird sat on the branch outside my window.
tiny.exampleZh: 一只小鸟停在我窗外的树枝上。

tip.example: She gave the waiter a small tip and left the restaurant.
tip.exampleZh: 她给了服务员一点小费，然后离开了餐厅。

tired.example: I felt very tired after a long day at work.
tired.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后我感到非常疲劳。

tissue.example: The doctor said the tissue in my knee was slightly damaged.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生说我的膝盖组织有轻微损伤。

title.example: The title of his new book is very long.

to.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
to.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

toast.example: She had toast and a cup of coffee for breakfast this morning.
toast.exampleZh: 她今天早上吃烤面包配一杯咖啡当早餐。

tobacco.example: My father stopped using tobacco last year because of his health.
tobacco.exampleZh: 我父亲去年因为健康原因戒烟了。

today.example: Today is a good day to start learning English.
today.exampleZh: 今天是个开始学英语的好日子。

toe.example: My little toe hurts after walking in those tight shoes all day.
toe.exampleZh: 穿那双紧鞋子走了一整天后，我的小脚趾疼。

together.example: We often cook dinner together on Sunday evenings.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常在周日晚上一起做晚饭。

toilet.example: The toilet in our new apartment is very clean and bright.
toilet.exampleZh: 我们新公寓里的厕所非常干净明亮。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一个红色的西红柿。

tomorrow.example: I will see you at school tomorrow morning.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 明天早上我会在学校见到你。

ton.example: This truck can carry about ten tons of coal every day.
ton.exampleZh: 这辆卡车每天能运大约十吨煤。

tone.example: Her gentle tone made the difficult news easier to hear.
tone.exampleZh: 她温和的语气让这个难以接受的消息听起来好受一些。

tongue.example: The doctor asked me to open my mouth and show him my tongue.
tongue.exampleZh: 医生让我张开嘴，把我的舌头给他看。

tonight.example: There is a good movie on TV tonight, so let us watch it together.
tonight.exampleZh: 今晚电视上有一部好电影，我们一起看吧。

too.example: This coat is too small for me to wear.
too.exampleZh: 这件外套对我来说太小了，穿不了。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things at home.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是家里修理东西时有用的工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I have one bad tooth and need a checkup.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我有一颗坏牙，需要做一次检查。

top.example: The book is on the top shelf, but I cannot reach it.
top.exampleZh: 那本书在最高的架子上，但我够不到它。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is how to protect the environment.
topic.exampleZh: 今天这节课的话题是如何保护环境。

torch.example: She carried a small torch to light the dark path home.
torch.exampleZh: 她拿着一把小电筒照亮回家的黑暗小路。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was more than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用超出了我们的预期。

touch.example: Her kind words touched my heart and made me smile.
touch.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语感动了我的心，让我露出了微笑。

tough.example: This old meat is too tough for the children to eat.
tough.exampleZh: 这块旧肉太硬了，孩子们咬不动。

tour.example: Last summer we took a tour of the old city and saw many famous buildings.
tour.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们游览了这座老城，看到了许多著名的建筑。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old city.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位游客拍了很多老城区的照片。

toward(s).example: She walked slowly toward the old bridge at the end of the street.
toward(s).exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝街道尽头的那座老桥走去。

towel.example: After washing my face, I dried it with a clean towel.
towel.exampleZh: 洗完脸后，我用一条干净的毛巾把脸擦干。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
tower.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔矗立在山顶上。

town.example: Our small town has a quiet park and two old churches.
town.exampleZh: 我们的小镇有一个安静的公园和两座古老的教堂。

toy.example: My little sister keeps her toy rabbit on the bed every night.
toy.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天晚上都把她的玩具兔子放在床上。

track.example: The detective followed the tracks in the snow to find the missing dog.
track.exampleZh: 侦探沿着雪地里的踪迹找到了那只走失的狗。

trade.example: Trade between the two countries has grown quickly over the past ten years.
trade.exampleZh: 过去十年里，两国之间的贸易增长迅速。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们家的传统。

traditional.example: My family always cooks traditional food for the new year.
traditional.exampleZh: 我家过年时总是做传统食物。

traffic.example: The traffic is very heavy on the main road this morning.
traffic.exampleZh: 今天早上主干道上的交通非常拥堵。

train.example: Every morning he takes the train to work and trains new staff.
train.exampleZh: 每天早上他乘火车上班，并培训新员工。

training.example: She is in training for the city race next month.
training.exampleZh: 她正在为下个月的城市赛跑进行训练。

transfer.example: I need to transfer money to my sister before she leaves.
transfer.exampleZh: 我妹妹走之前，我需要把钱转给她。

transform.example: The new teacher helped transform the quiet boy into a confident speaker.
transform.exampleZh: 新老师帮助这个安静的男孩变成了一个自信的演讲者。

translate.example: She helped me translate the letter into English.
translate.exampleZh: 她帮我把这封信翻译成了英文。

transport.example: The city needs a better transport system for its many workers.
transport.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为其众多工人提供更好的交通系统。

trap.example: The mouse was caught in a trap under the old kitchen table.
trap.exampleZh: 那只老鼠被困在旧厨房桌子下面的陷阱里。

travel.example: I want to travel to many countries with my family next year.
travel.exampleZh: 明年我想和家人一起去很多国家旅行。

treasure.example: The old man found a box of treasure under the big tree.
treasure.exampleZh: 老人在大树下发现了一箱财宝。

treat.example: The kind doctor treated the sick children with great care and patience.
treat.exampleZh: 这位善良的医生非常细心而耐心地治疗这些生病的孩子。

treatment.example: The doctor said my treatment would take about two weeks.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生说我需要大约两周的治疗。

tree.example: There is a tall tree in front of my house.
tree.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵高高的树。

tremble.example: Her hands began to tremble when she saw the big dog.
tremble.exampleZh: 当她看到那只大狗时，她的手开始发抖。

trend.example: There is a clear trend toward working from home these days.
trend.exampleZh: 如今有一个明显的趋势，那就是在家办公。

trial.example: The new medicine is still in its trial stage at the hospital.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药仍在医院进行试验阶段。

triangle.example: The roof of the small house looks like a triangle.
triangle.exampleZh: 这座小房子的屋顶看起来像一个三角形。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the old box.
trick.exampleZh: 他用一个巧妙的办法打开了那个旧箱子。

trip.example: We took a long trip to the mountains last summer with our friends.
trip.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们和朋友一起去了山里，进行了一次长途旅行。

trouble.example: Don't trouble your mother with such small problems again.
trouble.exampleZh: 不要再拿这么小的问题去烦你妈妈了。

trousers.example: These trousers are too long for me to wear.
trousers.exampleZh: 这条裤子太长了，我穿不了。

truck.example: My father drives a big truck to work every morning.
truck.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开一辆大卡车去上班。

true.example: Is this story true or did you make it up?
true.exampleZh: 这个故事是真的，还是你编的？

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always tells me the truth.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他总是对我说实话。

truth.example: She finally told her parents the truth about the broken window.
truth.exampleZh: 她终于把打破窗户的真相告诉了父母。

try.example: You should try your best to finish the work today.
try.exampleZh: 你应该尽最大努力今天完成这项工作。

tunnel.example: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

turn.example: Please turn the key and open the door for me.
turn.exampleZh: 请转动钥匙，帮我打开门。

twelve.example: My sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: There are twenty students in my class this year.
twenty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有二十名学生。

twice.example: I go to the gym twice a week with my brother.
twice.exampleZh: 我和我哥哥每周去两次健身房。

twin.example: My twin and I look the same, but we have very different personalities.
twin.exampleZh: 我和我的双胞胎长得一样，但我们的性格非常不同。

twist.example: She had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
twist.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲拧盖子才把罐子打开。

two.example: I have two cats and one small dog at home.
two.exampleZh: 我家里有两只猫和一只小狗。

type.example: I like this type of music, and I can type fast.
type.exampleZh: 我喜欢这种类型的音乐，而且我打字很快。

typical.example: This is a typical small town with a quiet main street.
typical.exampleZh: 这是一个典型的小镇，有一条安静的主街。

tyre.example: The front tyre of my bike is flat, so I must walk home today.
tyre.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮胎瘪了，所以今天我只能走回家。

ugly.example: That old building is ugly, but many people still like it.
ugly.exampleZh: 那栋旧楼很难看，但很多人仍然喜欢它。

umbrella.example: I always keep an umbrella in my bag when the weather is bad.
umbrella.exampleZh: 天气不好的时候，我总是在包里放一把雨伞。

unable.example: I am unable to come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
unable.exampleZh: 我明天早上不能来开会。

unbearable.example: The heat in the small room was unbearable for everyone.
unbearable.exampleZh: 小房间里的酷热让每个人都难以忍受。

uncertain.example: I am uncertain about the answer to this question.
uncertain.exampleZh: 我不确定这个问题的答案。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small town near the sea.
uncle.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在海边的一个小镇上。

uncomfortable.example: I feel uncomfortable when I sit in this old chair for a long time.
uncomfortable.exampleZh: 在这把旧椅子上坐久了，我会觉得不舒服。

unconscious.example: The man was unconscious after he fell and hit his head on the floor.
unconscious.exampleZh: 那个男人摔倒并撞到地板后失去了知觉。

under.example: The cat is sleeping under the table in the kitchen.
under.exampleZh: 猫正在厨房的桌子底下睡觉。

undergo.example: She had to undergo a long operation after the accident.
undergo.exampleZh: 事故之后，她不得不接受一次长时间的手术。

underground.example: The old city has many underground tunnels that tourists can visit today.
underground.exampleZh: 这座老城有许多地下隧道，游客今天可以参观。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this sentence before class.
underline.exampleZh: 请在上课前给这句话中的重要单词划线。

understand.example: I understand the question, but I need more time to answer it.
understand.exampleZh: 我理解这个问题，但我需要更多时间来回答。

understanding.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team find a simple answer.
understanding.exampleZh: 她对这个问题的理解帮助整个团队找到了简单的答案。

undertake.example: The company agreed to undertake the difficult project last year.
undertake.exampleZh: 公司去年同意承担这个艰难的项目。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate is high among young people in this city.
unemployment.exampleZh: 这座城市的年轻人失业率很高。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame the whole team for one mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为一个错误就责怪整个团队是不公平的。

unfit.example: This old chair is unfit for sitting because one leg is broken.
unfit.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子一条腿断了，不适合坐。

unfold.example: The story begins to unfold as the old man tells us the truth.
unfold.exampleZh: 当老人告诉我们真相时，故事开始展开。

unforgettable.example: The trip to the beach with my family was truly unforgettable.
unforgettable.exampleZh: 和家人一起去海滩的那次旅行真令人难忘。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that we missed the last train home.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 我们错过了回家的末班车，真不幸。

unfortunately.example: Unfortunately, I forgot my keys and could not open the door.
unfortunately.exampleZh: 不幸的是，我忘了钥匙，打不开门。

unhappy.example: She was unhappy about the long wait at the bus stop.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她对在公交车站的漫长等待感到不满意。

uniform.example: Every student in our school must wear a uniform on Monday.
uniform.exampleZh: 我们学校的每个学生周一都必须穿制服。

union.example: The workers formed a union to protect their jobs and rights.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了工会来保护他们的工作和权利。

unique.example: This old book is unique and no other copy exists.
unique.exampleZh: 这本旧书是独一无二的，没有其他副本。

unit.example: Each unit of the book has a short test at the end.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书的每个单元末尾都有一个简短测试。

unite.example: The workers decided to unite and ask for better pay.
unite.exampleZh: 工人们决定团结起来，要求更好的报酬。

united.example: The united team worked hard and won the game together.
united.exampleZh: 这个团结的团队努力拼搏，一起赢得了比赛。

universal.example: Music is a universal language that people all over the world can enjoy.
universal.exampleZh: 音乐是一种普遍的语言，全世界的人都能欣赏。

universe.example: Scientists believe our universe is still growing and holds many secrets.
universe.exampleZh: 科学家认为我们的宇宙仍在膨胀，并且藏着许多秘密。

university.example: My sister studies English at a big university in Beijing.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北京的一所大型大学学习英语。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则不能出去。

unlike.example: This city is very quiet unlike my noisy hometown.
unlike.exampleZh: 这座城市很安静，不像我那个吵闹的家乡。

unload.example: Two workers helped unload the heavy boxes from the truck.
unload.exampleZh: 两名工人帮忙把重箱子从卡车上卸下来。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达。

unusual.example: It is unusual to see snow here in summer.
unusual.exampleZh: 在这里的夏天看到雪是不寻常的。

up.example: The little boy looked up at the sky and smiled.
up.exampleZh: 小男孩抬头看着天空，笑了。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put the keys on the table.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把钥匙放在桌上。

upper.example: Put the books on the upper shelf, please.
upper.exampleZh: 请把书放在上面的架子上。

upset.example: She was upset because her best friend forgot her birthday.
upset.exampleZh: 她很难过，因为她最好的朋友忘了她的生日。

upward.example: The company's profits have shown an upward trend this year.
upward.exampleZh: 公司今年的利润呈上升趋势。

urban.example: More people move to urban areas to find work and better schools.
urban.exampleZh: 更多人搬到城市地区寻找工作和更好的学校。

urge.example: My friends urge me to try the new restaurant near our school.
urge.exampleZh: 朋友们催促我去试试学校附近那家新餐厅。

urgent.example: I got an urgent call from the hospital this morning.
urgent.exampleZh: 今天早上我接到了医院打来的紧急电话。

us.example: Please come with us to the park after school today.
us.exampleZh: 今天放学后请和我们一起去公园吧。

use.example: You can use this simple tool to fix the chair.
use.exampleZh: 你可以用这个简单的工具来修理这把椅子。

used.example: I am used to getting up early on school days.
used.exampleZh: 我已经习惯在上学的日子早起了。

useful.example: This small dictionary is very useful for learning new words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小词典对学习新单词非常有用。

usual.example: It is usual for him to walk to school every morning.
usual.exampleZh: 他每天早上步行去学校是很平常的事。

usually.example: I usually walk to school with my sister in the morning.
usually.exampleZh: 我通常早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

vacant.example: The seat next to me was vacant, so I sat down there.
vacant.exampleZh: 我旁边的座位是空的，所以我就在那里坐下了。

vacation.example: We are planning a long vacation to the beach this summer.
vacation.exampleZh: 我们正计划今年夏天去海边度一个长假。

vacuum.example: The empty room felt like a vacuum after everyone left.
vacuum.exampleZh: 所有人离开后，空荡荡的房间像一片真空。

vague.example: His answer was vague and I still do not understand the plan.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，我仍然不明白这个计划。

vain.example: His vain attempt to fix the old car wasted the whole afternoon.
vain.exampleZh: 他徒劳地试图修好那辆旧车，浪费了一整个下午。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for three days after you buy it.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票在购买后三天内有效。

valley.example: A small river runs through the valley behind our village.
valley.exampleZh: 一条小河流过我们村子后面的山谷。

valuable.example: This old book is very valuable to our family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这本旧书对我们家来说非常珍贵。

value.example: Good friends value honesty, and their friendship has great value in life.
value.exampleZh: 好朋友重视诚实，他们的友谊在生活中具有很大价值。

van.example: The van is full of boxes for the new shop.
van.exampleZh: 这辆厢式货车装满了给新店的箱子。

vanish.example: The cat ran behind the tree and vanished from our sight.
vanish.exampleZh: 那只猫跑到树后，从我们的视线中消失了。

variety.example: This shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables.
variety.exampleZh: 这家店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The store sells various kinds of fruit and vegetables.
various.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果和蔬菜。

vary.example: People's eating habits vary from country to country.
vary.exampleZh: 人们的饮食习惯因国家而异。

vast.example: The vast desert stretches for miles under a clear blue sky.
vast.exampleZh: 广阔的沙漠在晴朗的蓝天下绵延数英里。

vegetable.example: My mother buys fresh vegetables at the market every morning.
vegetable.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

vehicle.example: This vehicle can carry eight people at one time.
vehicle.exampleZh: 这辆车一次能载八个人。

version.example: This is the newest version of my favorite game.
version.exampleZh: 这是我最喜欢的游戏的最新版本。

very.example: This is a very good book for young readers.
very.exampleZh: 这是一本非常适合年轻读者的好书。

via.example: We flew to Rome via Paris and stayed there for one night.
via.exampleZh: 我们经由巴黎飞往罗马，并在那里住了一晚。

victim.example: The victim asked the police for help after the accident.
victim.exampleZh: 事故发生后，受害者向警察求助。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍全年努力拼搏，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about making bread at home.
video.exampleZh: 我看了一个关于在家做面包的短视频。

view.example: The view from our hotel room was beautiful in the morning light.
view.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光下，我们酒店房间外的景色很美。

village.example: My grandmother lives in a small village near the river.
village.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在河边的一个小村庄里。

violence.example: The movie shows too much violence, so I will not let my children watch it.
violence.exampleZh: 这部电影展现了太多暴力，所以我不会让我的孩子看。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in our old school building.
violent.exampleZh: 那场猛烈的风暴打破了我们旧校舍的许多窗户。

virtue.example: Patience is a virtue that helps us in hard times.
virtue.exampleZh: 耐心是一种在困难时期帮助我们的美德。

virus.example: A new virus made many people sick last winter.
virus.exampleZh: 去年冬天，一种新病毒让很多人病倒了。

visible.example: The tall tower is visible from my bedroom window on clear days.
visible.exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，从我家卧室的窗户可以看到那座高塔。

vision.example: Good vision helps you read small words and see far away.
vision.exampleZh: 良好的视力能帮你读清小字，也能看清远处。

visit.example: We will visit our grandparents this weekend and stay for lunch.
visit.exampleZh: 这个周末我们要去拜访祖父母，并留下吃午饭。

visitor.example: The visitor asked me where the museum was.
visitor.exampleZh: 那位参观者问我博物馆在哪里。

visual.example: The doctor said my visual skills are good for my age.
visual.exampleZh: 医生说我的视觉能力相对于我的年龄来说不错。

vital.example: Clean water is vital for the health of every child.
vital.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每个孩子的健康都至关重要。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day is a good way to build a large vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读是积累大量词汇的好方法。

voice.example: She spoke in a soft voice so the baby would not wake up.
voice.exampleZh: 她用轻柔的嗓音说话，以免吵醒宝宝。

voluntary.example: Many students do voluntary work at the old people's home on weekends.
voluntary.exampleZh: 许多学生周末在养老院做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: Many volunteers help clean the park every Sunday morning.
volunteer.exampleZh: 许多志愿者每周日早上帮助清理公园。

vote.example: In the end, most people voted for the young teacher.
vote.exampleZh: 最后，大多数人投票支持那位年轻的老师。

voyage.example: The old sailor often talks about his long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
voyage.exampleZh: 那位老水手常常谈起他横渡太平洋的漫长航行。

wage.example: His wage is low, so he works a second job at night.
wage.exampleZh: 他的工资很低，所以他晚上又打了一份工。

wait.example: Please wait here for a few minutes while I call your teacher.
wait.exampleZh: 请在这里等几分钟，我去叫你的老师。

waiter.example: The waiter brought us two cups of hot coffee this morning.
waiter.exampleZh: 今天早上，那位男服务员给我们端来了两杯热咖啡。

wake.example: I usually wake up early on school days.
wake.exampleZh: 上学日我通常醒得很早。

walk.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
walk.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

wall.example: The old picture on the wall is very beautiful.
wall.exampleZh: 墙上那幅旧画非常漂亮。

wallet.example: I left my wallet at home, so I cannot pay for lunch.
wallet.exampleZh: 我把钱包忘在家里了，所以没法付午饭的钱。

wander.example: On Sunday mornings I like to wander through the old streets near my home.
wander.exampleZh: 星期天早上，我喜欢在家附近的老街上漫步。

want.example: I want to buy some bread for breakfast tomorrow morning.
want.exampleZh: 明天早上我想买些面包当早餐。

war.example: The country tried hard to avoid a long and terrible war.
war.exampleZh: 这个国家努力避免一场漫长而可怕的战争。

warm.example: Her warm smile made every new student feel at home.
warm.exampleZh: 她热情的微笑让每个新生都感到宾至如归。

warn.example: I warn you not to swim in that river alone.
warn.exampleZh: 我警告你不要独自在那条河里游泳。

wash.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner.

waste.example: Do not waste food because many people still need it.
waste.exampleZh: 不要浪费食物，因为很多人仍然需要它。

watch.example: I watch the birds in the park every morning before work.
watch.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都在公园里观看鸟儿。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water, and I will water the plants.
water.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，然后我来给植物浇水。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave from the other side of the street.
wave.exampleZh: 她在街道对面友好地朝我挥了挥手。

way.example: She showed me a simple way to learn new words.
way.exampleZh: 她给我展示了一种学习新单词的简单方法。

we.example: We are good friends and we play together every day after school.
we.exampleZh: 我们是好朋友，每天放学后都一起玩。

weak.example: After a long illness, he still felt weak and could not walk far.
weak.exampleZh: 久病之后他仍然感到虚弱，走不了多远。

wealth.example: His wealth comes from years of hard work and careful saving.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的财富来自多年的辛勤工作和谨慎储蓄。

wealthy.example: He is a wealthy man who owns a big house.
wealthy.exampleZh: 他是一个拥有大房子的富人。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon in the man's bag.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方在那个人的包里发现了一件武器。

wear.example: I wear a warm coat and a hat in winter.
wear.exampleZh: 冬天我穿暖和的外套，戴帽子。

weather.example: The weather is very nice today, so we can go outside and play.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以到户外去玩。

web.example: I found the answer on a web page about animals.
web.exampleZh: 我在一个关于动物的网页上找到了答案。

wedding.example: My sister's wedding will be in a small church next Saturday.
wedding.exampleZh: 我姐姐的婚礼将于下周六在一座小教堂举行。

week.example: I will visit my grandparents next week and stay for three days.
week.exampleZh: 我下周会去看望我的祖父母，并住三天。

weekend.example: I usually visit my grandparents on the weekend.
weekend.exampleZh: 我通常在周末去看望我的祖父母。

weigh.example: Please weigh the apples before you put them in the bag.
weigh.exampleZh: 请你在把苹果放进袋子之前先称一下它们的重量。

weight.example: Her weight is normal for a girl of her age.
weight.exampleZh: 对于她这个年龄的女孩来说，她的体重是正常的。

welcome.example: We always welcome new students and make them feel at home.
welcome.exampleZh: 我们总是欢迎新同学，并让他们感到宾至如归。

well.example: The old well in our village still gives clean water.
well.exampleZh: 我们村子里的那口老井仍然能提供干净的水。

west.example: The sun sets in the west and the sky turns red.
west.exampleZh: 太阳在西方落下，天空变红了。

western.example: She likes western music and often listens to it at home.
western.exampleZh: 她喜欢西方音乐，经常在家听。

wet.example: My clothes are still wet because it rained this morning.
wet.exampleZh: 我的衣服还是湿的，因为今天早上下雨了。

whale.example: The whale swam slowly through the cold blue water near our boat.
whale.exampleZh: 那头鲸在我们船附近的冰冷蓝色海水中缓慢游动。

what.example: What do you want to eat for lunch today?

whatever.example: You can eat whatever you like from the table.
whatever.exampleZh: 你可以从桌上吃任何你喜欢的东西。

wheat.example: My mother buys wheat to make bread for our family.
wheat.exampleZh: 我妈妈买小麦为我们家做面包。

wheel.example: The front wheel of my bike is broken.

when.example: I always feel happy when my friends come to visit me.
when.exampleZh: 当朋友们来看我时，我总是感到开心。

whenever.example: You can call me whenever you need help with your homework.
whenever.exampleZh: 你写作业需要帮助时，随时可以打电话给我。

where.example: Where is the small book that you bought yesterday?
where.exampleZh: 你昨天买的那本小书在哪里？

wherever.example: Wherever you go, you will always find good friends there.
wherever.exampleZh: 无论你去哪里，你总能在那里找到好朋友。

whether.example: I do not know whether he will come to the party tonight.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which of these two books do you want to read first?
which.exampleZh: 这两本书中你想先读哪一本？

while.example: She read a book while I cooked dinner, and we talked for a while.
while.exampleZh: 我做饭的时候她在看书，我们聊了一会儿。

whisper.example: She leaned close to whisper a secret in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她凑近我耳边低语了一个秘密。

whistle.example: The boy likes to whistle a happy song while he walks to school.
whistle.exampleZh: 这个男孩喜欢在走路上学时吹一首欢快的歌。

white.example: She is wearing a white shirt and black shoes today.
white.exampleZh: 她今天穿着一件白衬衫和一双黑鞋。

who.example: Who is the woman standing next to your brother at the door?
who.exampleZh: 站在门口你哥哥旁边的那个女人是谁？

whole.example: The whole family went to the park after lunch on Sunday.
whole.exampleZh: 周日午饭后，全家人一起去了公园。

whom.example: Whom did you see at the party last night?
whom.exampleZh: 你昨晚在聚会上看见了谁？

whose.example: Whose bag is this on the table by the door?
whose.exampleZh: 门边桌子上的这个包是谁的？

why.example: I do not know why she is so quiet today.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道她今天为什么这么安静。

wide.example: The river is wide and deep, so we take a boat across.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河又宽又深，所以我们坐船过河。

widespread.example: This idea is now widespread among young people in many countries.
widespread.exampleZh: 这个想法现在在许多国家的年轻人中很普遍。

wife.example: My wife cooks dinner for our family every evening.
wife.exampleZh: 我妻子每天晚上为我们家做晚饭。

wild.example: The wild horse ran across the field and jumped over a small stream.
wild.exampleZh: 那匹野马跑过田野，跳过了一条小溪。

will.example: I will help you with your work if you want.
will.exampleZh: 如果你愿意，我会帮你完成工作。

willing.example: She is willing to help us with the work today.
willing.exampleZh: 她乐意今天帮我们做这项工作。

win.example: Our team played well last night and we want to win again.
win.exampleZh: 我们队昨晚打得很好，我们想再赢一次。

wind.example: The cold wind blew through the tall trees all night.
wind.exampleZh: 冷风整夜吹过那些高大的树木。

window.example: She opened the window to let some fresh air into the room.
window.exampleZh: 她打开窗户，让新鲜空气进入房间。

windy.example: It is very windy today, so we cannot fly our kite.
windy.exampleZh: 今天风很大，所以我们不能放风筝。

wine.example: My father drinks a glass of red wine with dinner every evening.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚饭时都喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly for a week.
wing.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了左翅膀，一个星期都不能飞。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and held up the small gold cup.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着举起了那个小小的金奖杯。

winter.example: We like to drink hot tea in winter.
winter.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在冬天喝热茶。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table before you put the plates on it.
wipe.exampleZh: 请在你把盘子放上去之前擦一下桌子。

wire.example: He used a long piece of wire to fix the broken fence.
wire.exampleZh: 他用一截长金属丝修好了破损的栅栏。

wisdom.example: My grandmother often shares her wisdom with us at the dinner table.
wisdom.exampleZh: 我的祖母常常在餐桌上和我们分享她的智慧。

wise.example: It is wise to ask for help when you are not sure.
wise.exampleZh: 当你不确定的时候，寻求帮助是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck with your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中一切顺利。

with.example: I often drink tea with my best friend after work.
with.exampleZh: 下班后我经常和我最好的朋友一起喝茶。

withdraw.example: She decided to withdraw some money from the bank before her trip.
withdraw.exampleZh: 她决定在旅行前从银行取一些钱。

within.example: Please finish all the work within three days so we can go home.
within.exampleZh: 请在三天内完成所有工作，这样我们就能回家了。

without.example: I cannot start my day without a cup of hot coffee.
without.exampleZh: 没有一杯热咖啡，我就无法开始新的一天。

woman.example: The woman next door often helps my mother in the garden.
woman.exampleZh: 隔壁的那位妇女经常在我家花园里帮我母亲。

wonder.example: I wonder how birds find their way home every year.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道鸟儿每年是怎么找到回家的路的。

wonderful.example: We had a wonderful time at the beach last weekend.
wonderful.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海边度过了非常愉快的时光。

wood.example: The old table is made of wood.
wood.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用木头做的。

wooden.example: She keeps her books on a small wooden shelf near the window.
wooden.exampleZh: 她把书放在窗边的一个小木架子上。

wool.example: My grandmother made a warm sweater from sheep's wool for me last winter.
wool.exampleZh: 去年冬天，我奶奶用羊毛给我做了一件暖和的毛衣。

word.example: I don't know the meaning of this word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个词的意思。

work.example: I work in a small office near my home.
work.exampleZh: 我在家附近的一间小办公室工作。

worker.example: The worker starts his job early every morning.
worker.exampleZh: 这名工人每天早上很早就开始工作。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world and meet new people.
world.exampleZh: 她想环游世界，结识新朋友。

worry.example: Don't worry about the test, you studied hard and you will do fine.
worry.exampleZh: 别担心考试，你复习得很努力，会考好的。

worse.example: My cold got worse last night, so I stayed home from work today.
worse.exampleZh: 昨晚我的感冒加重了，所以今天我待在家里没去上班。

worst.example: That was the worst day of my whole life.
worst.exampleZh: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

worth.example: This old book is worth reading again and again.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书值得反复阅读。

would.example: She said she would come to the party with us tomorrow.
would.exampleZh: 她说她明天会和我们一起去参加聚会。

wound.example: The doctor cleaned the wound on his leg and told him to rest.
wound.exampleZh: 医生清洗了他腿上的伤口，并嘱咐他休息。

wrap.example: She used a warm blanket to wrap the baby before going outside.
wrap.exampleZh: 她用一条温暖的毯子把婴儿裹好，然后才出门。

wreck.example: Divers found the wreck of an old ship at the bottom of the sea.
wreck.exampleZh: 潜水员在海底发现了一艘旧船的残骸。

wrestle.example: The two boys started to wrestle in the soft grass after school.
wrestle.exampleZh: 放学后，两个男孩在柔软的草地上开始摔跤。

write.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
write.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶端。

writer.example: The writer spent three years working on her first novel.
writer.exampleZh: 这位作家花了三年时间写她的第一部小说。

wrong.example: I think this answer is wrong, so please try again.
wrong.exampleZh: 我认为这个答案是错的，所以请再试一次。

x-ray.example: The doctor used an X-ray to look at my left arm.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生用X射线检查了我的左臂。

yard.example: The children play in the yard behind our house every afternoon.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们每天下午都在我们房子后面的院子里玩。

year.example: My sister is twelve years old and she loves reading books.
year.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

yellow.example: The yellow bus stops in front of our school every morning.
yellow.exampleZh: 那辆黄色的公交车每天早上都停在我们学校前面。

yes.example: Yes, I would like a cup of hot tea, please.

yesterday.example: I saw your brother at the bus station yesterday afternoon.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天下午在公交车站看到了你哥哥。

yet.example: She is tired, yet she keeps working on the report.
yet.exampleZh: 她很累，但仍然继续写报告。

you.example: You can sit here and wait for your friend.
you.exampleZh: 你可以坐在这里等你的朋友。

young.example: My young brother likes to play soccer with his friends after school.
young.exampleZh: 我年幼的弟弟喜欢放学后和他的朋友们踢足球。

your.example: Please bring your book and notebook to class tomorrow morning.
your.exampleZh: 请明天早上把你的书和笔记本带到课堂上。

youth.example: The youth in our town enjoy playing football in the park every weekend.
youth.exampleZh: 我们镇上的年轻人每个周末都喜欢在公园踢足球。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra at the zoo and it was very friendly.
zebra.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到一只斑马，它非常友好。

zero.example: The temperature dropped to zero degrees last night.

zip.example: My jacket has a broken zip, so I cannot close it.
zip.exampleZh: 我的夹克拉链坏了，所以我不能把它拉上。

zone.example: This area is a safe zone for children and pets.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是儿童和宠物的安全地带。

zoo.example: The children were excited to see the elephants at the zoo.
zoo.exampleZh: 孩子们在动物园看到大象很兴奋。

zoom.example: Please zoom in on the picture so I can see it clearly.
zoom.exampleZh: 请把图片放大，这样我能看清楚。
